title: Processutvecklare till Center för schemaplanering, vikariat
description:
Vill du bidra till något som verkligen är värdefullt – att skapa bättre förutsättningar för sjukvårdspersonal i alla professioner? Har du gedigen erfarenhet av schemaplanering och vill vara med och utveckla Karolinskas gemensamma arbetssätt och processer inom området? Då kan det här vara rollen för dig!
   

  

**Du erbjuds**
* att ingå i ett ambitiöst team med ansvar för att förbättra schemaplaneringsprocessen för hela Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset
* att arbeta i ett strategiskt viktigt uppdrag som bidrar till långsiktig förändring
* stora möjligheter att utvecklas i rollen som processutvecklare genom en spännande kombination av teknik, schemaplanering och förändringsledning
* möjlighet att efter introduktionen arbeta på distans 1–2 dagar i veckan efter överenskommelse.


 Självklart får du också ta del av våra generella förmåner som Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset erbjuder dig.
   

  

**Om tjänsten**
 Karolinska arbetar för att ta nästa steg inom schemaplanering genom att implementera ett gemensamt schemaplaneringsverktyg och gemensamma arbetssätt för samtliga kliniska verksamheter. Du kommer att arbeta i Center för schemaplanering, som är en del av enheten Produktion och uppföljning inom Stab Produktion.
   

  

 Tillsammans med teamet arbetar du med processutveckling och förändringsledning inom schemaplaneringsprocessen, med fokus på såväl processer och arbetssätt som verktyg.
   

  

**Dina Arbetsuppgifter Innebär Bland Annat Att**
* implementera, utbilda och ge support till vårdverksamheter i användningen av schemaplaneringsverktyget Tessa
* stödja vårdverksamheterna i att utveckla goda arbetssätt för strategisk, taktisk och operativ schemaplanering
* möjliggöra strukturerad uppföljning och driva kontinuerlig datadriven processutveckling.


 Center för schemaplanering har i uppdrag att utveckla den sjukhusövergripande schemaplaneringsprocessen samt stödja vårdverksamheterna i schemaplanering på strategisk, taktisk och operativ nivå. Målet är att skapa gemensamma arbetssätt, minska administrationen och möjliggöra enhetlig uppföljning av resursåtgång kopplad till Karolinskas uppdrag inom produktion, utbildning och forskning.
   

  

 För att verksamheten ska kunna använda ett välanpassat system arbetar vi även med systemutveckling genom att samla in och beakta verksamheternas behov, så att dessa kan prioriteras och kravställas mot systemleverantör. Uppdraget innebär även att bidra med schemaplaneringsperspektivet i sjukhusövergripande processer inom Karolinskas modell för produktions- och ekonomistyrning.
   

  

 Tjänsten är en tidsbegränsad anställning på heltid under 12 månader, med tillträde enligt överenskommelse.
   

  

**Vi söker dig som**
* har förmåga att engagera andra och skapa delaktighet i förändring
* är lösningsorienterad och mån om att hitta välfungerande lösningar för verksamheten
* är serviceinriktad, involverande och engagerad
* kommunicerar pedagogiskt och tydligt med olika målgrupper, både i tal och skrift
* är lyhörd och strukturerad.


 Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
**Krav**
* minst tre års erfarenhet av schemaplanering på strategisk, taktisk och operativ nivå
* erfarenhet av att arbeta i projekt och/eller förändringsinitiativ, alternativt genomgången utbildning i projektledningsmetodik
* erfarenhet av att arbeta i schema- och tidssystemet Tessa
* erfarenhet av att arbeta i PA-systemet Heroma
* relevant utbildning eller erfarenhet som bedöms likvärdig.


**Meriterande**
* erfarenhet av schemaplanering inom hälso- och sjukvård
* erfarenhet av arbetsuppgifter som omfattar att leda andra i förändring och nya arbetssätt
* erfarenhet av att ställa krav på systemutveckling, exempelvis genom att lämna krav till IT-avdelning och/eller systemleverantör
* erfarenhet av att arbeta i en stor och komplex organisation och i gränssnitt mellan olika verksamheter.


**Om rekryteringsprocessen**
 Urval och intervjuer kan komma att ske löpande under ansökningstiden.
   

  

 I samband med din ansökan behöver du bifoga CV. Istället för ett personligt brev ber vi dig besvara urvalsfrågor samt kort motivera varför du passar för rollen. Att besvara frågorna är en förutsättning för att din ansökan ska anses komplett.
   

  

 Varmt välkommen med din ansökan – Tillsammans är vi Karolinska!
   

  

 Inför tillsättning av befattning som innefattar vård av barn och ungdom, kontrolleras den som erbjuds tjänsten mot misstanke- och belastningsregistret. Här kan du läsa mer om rekryteringsprocessen och om vilka kontroller som utförs på Karolinska.
   

  

 Som anställd på Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset kan du komma att krigsplaceras. Läs mer om vad det innebär här.
   

  

 Om du är eller tidigare har varit anställd i Region Stockholm kommer vi att ta interna referenser från din nuvarande eller tidigare chef om du blir aktuell för anställning.
   

  

 För tillsvidaretjänster kan provanställning komma att tillämpas.
   

  

**Om Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset**
 Vi på Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset är stolta över att vi är ett av världens främsta universitetssjukhus. Förutom vårt särskilda ansvar för den högspecialiserade vården i Stockholmsregionen är huvuduppdraget att tillsammans med Karolinska Institutet utbilda framtidens vårdanställda och bedriva världsledande forskning samtidigt som vi fortsätter vårt arbete med att utveckla vården för patientens bästa. Vi arbetar inom en rad olika områden och professioner.
   

  

 Du kan läsa mer om vårt uppdrag inom vård, forskning och utbildning här.
   

  

 Vår vision - Vi ska bota och lindra imorgon det ingen kan bota och lindra idag.
   

  

 Läs gärna mer om oss på karolinska.se och följ oss på sociala medier!
   

  

**Att söka jobb i Region Stockholm**
 Vi eftersträvar jämställdhet och jämlikhet på vår arbetsplats och ser gärna sökande med olika bakgrund och förutsättningar.
   

  

 Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via detta system. Ansök genom att klicka på knappen ”Ansök”. Ansökningar per brev eller e-post beaktas inte. Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.
   

  

 Vårt rekryteringssystem kan inte hantera anonyma ansökningar eller sökande med skyddade personuppgifter. Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ber vi dig att kontakta den kontaktpersonen som finns angiven i annonsen. Din ansökan kommer då att hanteras utanför rekryteringssystemet. Du bör även vara försiktig med vilken information du lämnar i din ansökan och endast ta med information som är relevant för den aktuella befattningen.
   

  

 Region Stockholm ansvarar för hälso- och sjukvård, kollektivtrafik, regional utveckling och bidrar till kulturlivet. Varje dag, dygnet runt. I landets snabbaste växande region. Tillsammans skapar vi Europas attraktivaste storstadsregion.
   

  

 Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss i Region Stockholm (öppnas i nytt fönster)

title: Senior Kubernetes-konsult
description:
**Vill du vara med och skapa nästa generations plattformar för containerisering och automation?** 




 På Conscia hjälper vi några av Nordens mest verksamhetskritiska organisationer att bygga, modernisera och säkra sin digitala infrastruktur. Som Kubernetes-konsult arbetar du nära våra kunder med design, implementation och vidareutveckling av moderna containerplattformar och automatiserade infrastrukturlösningar.
 



  





 Du blir en del av ett specialistteam där Kubernetes, DevOps, automation och moderna plattformstjänster står i fokus. Tillsammans hjälper vi kunder att skapa skalbara, säkra och framtidssäkra lösningar som stödjer deras verksamhet och utveckling.
 



  





**Om rollen** 




 Som Kubernetes-konsult arbetar du i projekt och uppdrag där du hjälper kunder att designa, implementera och vidareutveckla containerplattformar och automatiserade infrastrukturlösningar. Rollen omfattar hela livscykeln, från implementation och automatisering till drift, optimering och vidareutveckling.
 



  





 Du arbetar nära kunder och kollegor för att skapa moderna plattformar och effektiva leveransprocesser med fokus på stabilitet, säkerhet och affärsnytta.
 



  





 Du kommer bland annat att:
 


* Designa och implementera containerplattformar som Kubernetes och OpenShift
* Bygga och vidareutveckla CI/CD-pipelines och DevOps-processer
* Automatisera infrastruktur, deployment och drift
* Arbeta med Infrastructure as Code och verktyg som Terraform och Ansible
* Hjälpa kunder att modernisera och optimera sina plattformar och arbetssätt
* Delta i projekt med fokus på teknik, effektivitet och affärsnytta



  





**Vi söker dig** 




 Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet av att arbeta med Kubernetes och moderna containerplattformar i större och komplexa miljöer. Du har ett starkt intresse för automation, DevOps och moderna infrastrukturlösningar och trivs i en konsultativ roll där du får kombinera tekniskt djup med kunddialog och rådgivning. Som person är du nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och kommunikativ. Du tycker om att samarbeta med kunder och kollegor, delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och drivs av att skapa långsiktig nytta genom teknik.
 



  





 Vi tror att du har erfarenhet och färdigheter inom flera av följande områden:
 


* Kubernetes
* OpenShift
* DevOps
* CI/CD
* Docker
* Terraform
* Ansible
* Linux
* Scripting
* Virtualiseringsplattformar, exempelvis Nutanix



  





 Det är meriterande om du även har erfarenhet av:
 


* AWS
* Microsoft Azure
* Google Cloud Platform (GCP)



  





**Därför Conscia** 




 Hos oss får du arbeta nära kunder med höga krav på säkerhet, tillgänglighet och prestanda samtidigt som du utvecklas tillsammans med kunniga och engagerade kollegor. Vi tror på kunskapsdelning, samarbete och att skapa de bästa lösningarna tillsammans.
 



  





 Hos oss får du möjlighet att:
 


* Arbeta med komplexa och verksamhetskritiska IT-miljöer
* Vara en del av ett specialistteam inom Kubernetes, DevOps och automatisering
* Utvecklas genom certifieringar, kunskapsutbyte och varierande kunduppdrag
* Bidra till att modernisera och effektivisera kunders plattformar och arbetssätt
* Arbeta i en kultur som präglas av tillit, samarbete och frihet under ansvar



  





**Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!** 




 Har du frågor om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Helena Ejdersten, Consultant Manager, på telefon +46 76 772 13 18 eller via e-post på helena.ejdersten@conscia.com.
 



  





 Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomför vi bakgrundskontroll av slutkandidaten. Ansök via länken i annonsen. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande.

title: Kraftsystemingenjör till rollen som applikationsspecialist
description:
Vill du arbeta med verksamhetskritiska system som bidrar till att hålla Sveriges kraftsystem stabilt – dygnet runt, året om? Som applikationsspecialist på Svenska kraftnät blir du en del av ett team som gemensamt ansvarar för drift, utveckling, support och förvaltning av ett av kontrollrummets viktigaste verktyg. I teamet bidrar du med kraftsystemkompetens och fungerar som en viktig länk mellan verksamheten och tekniken.
   

  

**Om tjänsten**

title: AI Engineer, Internal AI - Typescript
description:
Start: ASAP or in 1 months time
   

  

 Duration: 6 months
   

  

 Stockholm, on-site
   

  

 The team
   

  

 The Internal AI team is responsible for enabling AI-native ways of working across the organisation. The team works across several areas in parallel: building internal AI agents and tools, enabling teams to develop their own solutions, and creating the standards, access models and guardrails that allow AI to be used effectively and securely at scale.
   

  

 The team owns both the underlying AI platforms and the internal products built on top of them. This includes internal knowledge agents, AI-powered workflow automation, structured and agent-accessible knowledge bases, shared infrastructure for internally developed AI applications, and reusable AI capabilities that can be adopted across the organisation.
   

  

 The team is small, but its mandate spans the entire organisation. This means combining hands-on engineering with platform thinking, product ownership and close collaboration with different parts of the business.
   

  

 The challenge
   

  

 This is an organisation where AI adoption is already high and users are comfortable experimenting with the latest tools. The challenge is therefore not convincing people to use AI, but building solutions that are genuinely valuable, reliable and better than what individual teams could easily create themselves.
   

  

 At the same time, the organisation needs common foundations that individual teams cannot efficiently build on their own. This includes infrastructure, access and permission models, knowledge architecture, monitoring, evaluation and appropriate guardrails.
   

  

 There will not always be a detailed specification. Part of the role is understanding the underlying problem, determining what should be built and creating scalable solutions that work across the organisation.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Build internal AI agents, tools and platforms and treat them as long-term products rather than one-off projects.
* Take broad business goals, determine what is actually required and translate them into concrete technical solutions.
* Own solutions end to end, from architecture and implementation through production, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Help shape what should be built, how it should be prioritised and how the overall internal AI ecosystem should evolve.
* Design foundations including knowledge architecture, access and permissions, evaluation, monitoring and risk-based guardrails.
* Work directly with users and stakeholders across the organisation, including teams outside engineering.
* Ensure internal AI solutions are scalable, secure, reliable and genuinely useful to the people using them.


 What we are looking for
   

  

* Strong engineering fundamentals. You build robust, production-ready systems and take responsibility for delivering solutions that work in real-world environments.
* Deep experience with LLM-based systems. You have hands-on experience with agents, retrieval, evaluation and tool use. You understand where these systems can fail and know how to design for reliability and performance.
* A strong sense of ownership. You don't wait for perfect specifications. When requirements are unclear or could be improved, you challenge assumptions and propose better solutions.
* Technical, domain and business understanding. You can discuss architecture in depth while also understanding the underlying business needs and connecting the two.
* Openness and collaboration. You welcome feedback, build on other people's ideas and are comfortable changing direction when new evidence emerges.
* Comfort with ambiguity. You enjoy working in fast-moving environments where teams evolve, priorities change and decisions are revisited as new information becomes available.
* Strong TypeScript experience. You are comfortable building and maintaining modern production systems using TypeScript.
* Comfort with infrastructure. You are willing to work across the stack, including infrastructure, Terraform and cloud environments, rather than treating infrastructure as someone else's responsibility.
* AI-native development. You use AI coding agents as a natural part of your daily development workflow, not simply as an occasional experiment.

title: Back End Developer (AI Infrastructure)
description:

 What if the code you write could directly power the AI systems shaping how millions of people interact with technology? We're looking for Back End Developers in Stockholm to design, build, and optimize the server-side systems and APIs that drive cutting-edge AI products — from data pipelines and model-serving infrastructure to scalable microservices that handle real-world traffic at scale.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. Whether you're a seasoned engineer looking for meaningful project work or a strong developer ready to apply your skills to AI-adjacent infrastructure, this is your chance to build things that matter.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr

* Location: Remote

**What You'll Do**

* Build scalable, high-performance server-side architecture to support AI training and inference workloads
* Write clean, well-documented, and testable code following engineering best practices
* Integrate with databases, message queues, cloud services, and third-party APIs

* Collaborate asynchronously with distributed teams of engineers, researchers, and product leads

**Who You Are**

* Self-motivated, reliable, and effective when working asynchronously without close supervision

**Nice to Have**

* Knowledge of authentication, authorization, and security best practices
* Experience with serverless architectures or event-driven design patterns
* Contributions to open-source projects or a strong portfolio of personal/professional work


**Why Join Us**
* Work on cutting-edge AI infrastructure projects alongside leading research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — set your own hours and work from anywhere
* Freelance autonomy with access to meaningful, technically challenging work
* Build systems at the intersection of software engineering and artificial intelligence
* Collaborate with a global network of talented engineers and researchers
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: System Architect Core & Credits
description:
We are strengthening our architecture capabilities and are looking for a System Architect for Core & Credits. In this role, you will help shape the technical direction of our credit solutions while working closely with Team Credit and fellow architects across the organization. You will combine hands-on development with architectural responsibility, contributing both to day-to-day delivery and to the long-term evolution of our products.
   

  

**Personal Skills**
 We are looking for a proactive and self-driven person with strong analytical skills, integrity, and the ability to see the bigger picture. You communicate clearly, collaborate well with others, and combine a business-oriented mindset with solid technical understanding.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
 As System Architect, you will take part in both hands-on development and architectural work. You will support the team by clarifying requirements, designing technical solutions, guiding implementation, and helping ensure that our systems remain secure, maintainable, scalable, and aligned with the product roadmap.
   

  

**Define And Analyze System Requirements**
 – Define and analyze functional and non-functional system requirements in close collaboration with system users, product owners, and other stakeholders.
   

  

 – Translate requirements into clear guidance for developers and application managers through models, prototypes, guidelines, and instructions.
   

  

**Develop Technical Roadmap**
 – Develop, maintain, and communicate the technical roadmap for your area of responsibility.
   

  

 – Actively reduce existing technical debt and help prevent new technical debt from being introduced.
   

  

 – Drive system changes in line with the roadmap and help ensure that development progresses in a coordinated and sustainable way.
   

  

**Evaluate Cost and Time**
 – Assess cost, time, and value when evaluating manual routines, hardware, third-party products, existing software, or new development.
   

  

**Architectural Design and System Decomposition**
 – Design and evolve the fundamental system structure that supports ongoing product development.
   

  

 – Support developers and application managers in resolving issues in a way that is consistent with the architectural direction.
   

  

 – Make technical decisions within your area of responsibility, in alignment with the roadmap and relevant stakeholders.
   

  

 – Align with your immediate manager before decisions that may involve additional costs. Decisions of a significant nature are made by the company's Chief Architect or Management team.
   

  

 – Guide teams in evaluating both human-created and AI-assisted design or code suggestions, ensuring that solutions are sound, secure, maintainable, scalable, and aligned with the overall architecture.
   

  

**Customer and Sales Engagement**
 – Support new sales and upselling activities for both new and existing customers.
   

  

 – Help answer solution-related questions and contribute technical insight in customer dialogue.
   

  

**Desired Education And Experience**
 – University-level education in software development, or equivalent practical experience.
   

  

 – Extensive experience and strong expertise in software design and development.
   

  

 – Must have experience: working in an IBM i environment and with RPGLE as a programming language.
   

  

 – Merited experience: Working with a Java technology stack and frameworks such as Spring Boot and Spring for building production-ready environments and REST APIs.
   

  

 – Merited experience: AWS or other cloud public clouds.
   

  

* Business domain knowledge within credits is merited.
* Proficiency in agile software development.
* Proficiency in data security.
* Fluency in English is required. Swedish is desirable, and Finnish is considered a bonus.
* You have a pragmatic AI-first mindset and are positive about using AI as support for productivity and analysis, while applying professional judgment and taking ownership of the final result.


 Could this be your next step? If you are motivated by combining hands-on development with architectural responsibility, we would be happy to hear from you.
   

  

 The role can be based in either Mariehamn, Helsinki, Turku, Stockholm
   

  

 For further information, please contact Technical Development Manager Sebastian Skogman by email at sebastian.skogman@crosskey.fi or HR Manager Monika Sigmark by email at monika.sigmark@crosskey.fi We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please send your application as soon as possible, but no later than 30 September 2026.

title: Master's thesis: Does continuous use of AI-assisted development make subsequent AI-assisted development more costly or difficult?
description:
We are looking for a dedicated master’s student to join us in the Connected Intelligence Unit at RISE.
   

  

 The Connected Intelligence Unit is part of RISE Computer Science in Kista. The current research focus is on devising intelligent autonomous systems for controlling and allocating resources in future computer and communication networks. Among the group's key technologies are the Internet of Things (IoT) and Edge computing. The unit conducts projects together with industry and academic partners from Sweden and across the world.
   

  

**Background and Purpose**
 Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in software engineering to generate code, implement features, and support developers throughout the software lifecycle. However, their effectiveness may depend strongly on the structure and quality of the existing codebase. Code created with extensive AI assistance may also develop different structural characteristics than human-written code, potentially affecting future AI-assisted development.
   

  

 This raises an important question for the long-term use of AI in software engineering:
 **Does continuous use of AI-assisted development make subsequent AI-assisted development more costly or difficult?**
**Thesis Description**
 This thesis aims to investigate how the structure and development history of a software project affect the ability of LLMs to implement new features. You will select suitable open-source projects and recreate them using AI-based development tools, simulating projects built with extensive AI assistance.
   

  

 New features with clearly defined completion criteria will then be implemented using AI on both the original and AI-generated codebases. The process will be evaluated based on development time, token consumption, number of attempts, and successful completion. The results will help identify whether AI-generated code structures influence the efficiency of future AI-assisted software development.
   

  

**Terms:**
 Start Time: As soon as possible
   

  

 Scope: 30 hp
   

  

 Location: RISE Computer Science, Kista, Stockholm. Option to partially work remotely.
   

  

**Who are you?**
 We expect you to have a solid knowledge of machine learning theory, good programming skills (especially Python), and an interest in computer systems and solving complex problems. You are also currently enrolled in a masters programme.
   

  

**We are looking forward to receiving your application!**
 To know more, please contact the supervisor Mariano Scazzariello (mariano.scazzariello@ri.se). The thesis will be conducted together with the KTH Networked System Laboratory and KTH Machine-Intelligence for Networks and Distributed Systems Laboratory. Applications should include a brief personal letter, CV, recent grades, and a code excerpt. Candidates are encouraged to send in their application as soon as possible but at the latest by the 15th of October 2026. Suitable applicants will be interviewed as soon as applications are received.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Data powers every package we deliver—and as our Engineering Manager, you’ll power the team behind it.**
 At Instabee, our Data Platform team is at the heart of how we make faster, smarter decisions, from lead times and locker performance to merchant checkout analytics. We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead this team, someone who's ready to grow people, scope projects and shape deliveries, and manage stakeholders with ease.
   

  

 You should understand the product roadmap well enough to contribute to it, be comfortable facilitating discussions and unblocking the team, and bring enough high tech fluency to support the team when it's needed. You'll join our EM crew and work closely with your team's Product Manager, Staff Engineer, and business stakeholders across the company.
   

  

**Some Of The Things You'll Do**
* Lead a small, sharp team of engineers. 1:1s, coaching, hiring, and performance, all on you
* Continue build a team culture where psychological safety isn't a buzzword, it's the baseline
* Build a strong partnership with your Product Manager and Staff Engineer to clearly advocate for the team’s roadmap and constraints, while effectively bridging communication with Engineering Directors and Business Leads
* Help the team break down messy, ambiguous problems into concrete next steps
* Own delivery and team health in a lean setup. No safety net of extra support layers beneath you
* Help shape a strong EM culture by sharing what you learn (and stealing what works from others)


 Your future team
   

  

 The Data Platform team is a central team building a modern data platform on GCP and Snowflake for delivering core data products and metrics to the whole organization. It is pulling in data from everywhere, and owning everything from CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code to pipeline orchestration. The work is technical, high-impact, and essential to whether the rest of the business can actually trust its data.
   

  

 What we're looking for
   

  

 We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys leading people and isn't afraid to dive into the messy parts of building a team.
   

  

**What You'll Bring To The Table**
* A coaching mindset and passion for team dynamics: You are genuinely energized by growing people, building trust, and shaping high-performing teams.
* The courage to guide through change: You have the guts to hold hard conversations when necessary and steer the team through organizational shifts.
* Adaptive leadership: The instinct to know when to lead versus when to manage, and the wisdom to tell the difference.
* Scoping, prioritizing, and planning: Proven ability to break apart complex projects into clear, actionable steps and realistic goals.
* Ways of Working & unblocking: Expertise in agile practices, facilitating technical discussions, and clearing roadblocks to keep the team moving forward.
* Clear stakeholder communication: Strong expectation management skills across business leads and directors..
* High-level technical fluency: Enough tech background (e.g., modern data platforms, infrastructure) to earn respect, understand context, and support the team where needed.
* Product roadmap alignment: Experience contributing directly to product strategy to advocate for the team’s roadmap.
* Language skills: Spoken or written Swedish is a plus, though English is our daily working language.


 What you'll get
   

  

 We can promise you'll be challenged, grow fast, and work alongside genuinely excellent people. If you like shaking things up and building new ways of working from scratch — this is your place.
   

  

**Beyond The Usual Essentials, We've Also Got**
 👶
 **Six months' parental pay:** 
 Step away and give your little one everything they need
   

  

 🎂
 **A day off on your birthday:** 
 Because you deserve to celebrate properly
   

  

**⏰ Hybrid & Flexible:** 
 Work the way that works for you
   

  

 Diversity and inclusion matter deeply to us, and we're committed to building a workplace where every perspective is valued and everyone has room to grow.
   

  

**If leading through change, growing great engineers, and turning complex challenges into clear paths forward sounds like your kind of work, we’d love to hear from you!**
**Note on our process:** 
*As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and trustworthy workplace, all candidates applying to Instabee in Sweden will undergo a background check conducted by Svensk Bakgrundsanalys. This review examines public criminal records and is a mandatory step in our recruitment process. While the results are public information, we handle all data with the utmost confidentiality.*
 Instabee Group, with consumer-facing brands Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy, brings together years of experience in delivery. Today, Instabee Group is present in five markets, serving thousands of online merchants and millions of consumers with seamless home deliveries and convenient parcel locker deliveries, using the best fuel available. With smart technology, a strong focus on sustainability, and a secure supply chain, Instabee has become a trusted partner for online merchants and a preferred choice for consumers.

title: Senior Business Architect
description:
We at WeQuel are now looking for a Senior Business Architect in Södertälje where you'll become an important part of our client's Commercial End-to-End Architecture team, with focus on the Order-to-Cash (O2C) process. You will work in close collaboration with program stakeholders to ensure end-to-end consistency across the O2C process, alignment with other ERP processes, and the client's Commercial Target Architecture.
   

  

 As a consultant with us, you get the opportunity to work with one of our clients, a leading company within the manufacturing industry, where you contribute to optimizing processes, implementing new technology and creating sustainable solutions.
   

  

**Your responsibilities:**
* Representation and safeguarding of the O2C process within the IEB program, with focus on sales of Trucks, Buses and Power Solutions, in alignment with other core processes (Finance, Procurement, Plan & Fulfill)
* Collaboration with cross-program process streams and the Service Integrator to secure seamless end-to-end process integration across business areas
* Alignment of the O2C process for external sales with inter- and intracompany needs
* Support to Business Process Owners (BPOs) and other roles in establishing process documentation, governance and global templates
* Safeguarding of business objectives and target architecture, steering design decisions towards scalability and industry best practices
* Identification, communication and escalation of business impacts when aligning current processes with industry standard processes
* Collaboration with Process Developers, realization leads, cross-program process streams and the Service Integrator
* Alignment of the order process between SAP S/4HANA and Microsoft Dynamics 365 to create an end-to-end O2C process across the two ERP systems


 You work in a dynamic environment where you independently drive your workflow forward while collaborating across multiple interfaces within the organization.
   

  

**Requirements:**
* 8+ years of documented experience relevant to the role – business architecture and SAP S/4HANA O2C
* University degree, preferably within the domain of Computer Science
* Fluent English, both written and spoken
* Experience with process documentation and BPMN process documentation tools (ARIS is used at the client)
* Documented experience within the Order-to-Delivery domain in a manufacturing environment
* Solid understanding of sales, delivery (including export), and invoicing processes
* Significant experience working as a Business Architect in complex and global environments
* Preferably located in the Stockholm area, to support a hybrid assignment with the current requirement of presence in the Södertälje office 3 days/week
* Pragmatic and results-oriented mindset
* Strong stakeholder communication skills
* Strong collaboration and cross-functional alignment capabilities
* Ability to balance business objectives, architectural principles, and practical delivery needs


**Meriterande (Nice to have):**
* Experience from the automotive industry
* Experience working with complex, specification-based products
* Experience from multiple ERP implementation projects


**Assignment details:**
* Start date: 2026-10-05
* End date: 2027-09-30
* Workload: 100%
* Hybrid setup – onsite 3 days/week in Södertälje


**We offer:**
 At WeQuel, you become part of a consulting team that values people first – we believe success is created through engagement, collaboration and development. We offer a flat organization with short decision paths, a strong sense of community and the opportunity to influence your own development.

title: Product Owner IAM
description:
Be part of Clavister's journey to secure the digital world. We are looking for a Product Owner with the leadership, product thinking and technical judgement to help a skilled team perform at its best. You will lead a cross-functional Java development team responsible for products across authentication, identity management and digital signing, turning customer needs, business priorities and technical direction into clear outcomes for the team.
   

  

 Working closely with the Product Manager, you will actively contribute to the product vision and roadmap for our IAM portfolio. The Product Manager owns that direction; you make it actionable by owning the team backlog, creating clarity and guiding delivery. You will be supported by experienced stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Architecture and Security.
   

  

**About Clavister**
 Clavister is a European cybersecurity company founded in 1997 and headquartered in Örnsköldsvik. We develop cybersecurity solutions across network security, identity and access management, cloud security, machine learning and AI.
   

  

 Our solutions support customers in the public sector, critical infrastructure, defence and telecommunications. Together with our partners and distributors, Clavister hardware and software are deployed in more than 100 countries.
   

  

**The role**
 This role brings product ownership, people leadership and engineering delivery together. Your ability to lead, create focus, develop people and build an effective team is more important than being an IAM specialist.
   

  

 You should be comfortable working in the IAM domain, learning its concepts and discussing Java or a comparable enterprise backend ecosystem, as well as architecture, integrations, quality and engineering trade-offs with developers, architects and product stakeholders.
   

  

 The portfolio spans established on-premises products with multiple supported versions as well as SaaS offerings, requiring sound judgement when balancing product development and technical debt.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and develop a cross-functional Java product team, with responsibility for people leadership, competence development, team effectiveness and delivery practices, including constructive feedback and support for learning and professional development.
* Actively contribute customer, delivery and team perspectives to the product vision and roadmap owned by the Product Manager.
* Own and prioritise the team backlog in line with the agreed product direction, customer needs, security requirements and available capacity.
* Translate roadmap objectives into clear outcomes, requirements and acceptance criteria for authentication, identity and signing products.
* Work with Java engineers, architects and IAM domain stakeholders on system design, APIs, integrations and architectural evolution.
* Balance new capabilities and technical debt with cybersecurity, privacy, trust, quality, usability, scalability and long-term maintainability.
* Drive delivery from refinement and planning through development, automated testing and operational follow-up.
* Promote modern engineering practices, including CI/CD, DevOps, observability, code review and test automation.
* Recruit, coach and mentor team members, creating an environment where people feel trusted and supported, are comfortable asking questions and challenging ideas, and actively share and preserve critical knowledge.
* Coordinate dependencies, risks and expectations across Product, Technology, Architecture, Security and other stakeholders, drawing on their IAM expertise when needed.


**What Success Looks Like In This Role**
* The team understands what to deliver, why it matters and how success will be measured.
* Product and roadmap priorities are translated into a clear, realistic and well-managed backlog.
* The team delivers secure, reliable and maintainable Java-based products with predictable quality and flow.
* Product, engineering, security and IAM domain decisions are made collaboratively, with the right specialists involved and clear ownership maintained.
* Team members grow, take responsibility and contribute to a healthy engineering culture.


**To thrive in this role we believe you have**
* Proven experience leading and developing commercial product software teams, with a strong focus on people, performance, collaboration and delivery.
* Experience with product ownership, backlog management and agile delivery for software products.
* A hands-on background in software engineering or architecture.
* Enough technical understanding to engage confidently with Java developers and architects, supported by experience from Java or a comparable enterprise backend ecosystem.
* Experience collaborating with Product Managers and multiple stakeholders on product discovery, priorities, vision and roadmap development.
* Comfort working in the IAM domain and the curiosity to learn authentication, identity and signing concepts with support from domain specialists.
* Knowledge of secure software development, privacy and vulnerability management.
* Strong communication, coaching, stakeholder management, problem-solving and change leadership skills.
* Fluent English, both written and spoken.


**Extra points for**
* Previous experience from identity and access management, authentication, digital identity or electronic signing.
* Familiarity with IAM integrations, APIs, federation, identity lifecycle processes or trust services.
* A background in software engineering or architecture in Java, or a comparable enterprise backend ecosystem.
* Experience as a Scrum Master or in a similar role facilitating agile software teams.


**What We Offer**
* Meaningful work in a European cybersecurity company where IAM is a key component of zero-trust security and our products help organisations protect identities, control access and enable trusted digital interactions.
* The opportunity to lead and develop a brilliant Java engineering team delivering products across authentication, identity and signing.
* A collaborative and inclusive environment with close cooperation across Product, Technology and Security.
* Professional development, training and opportunities to grow your leadership career.
* Flexible working arrangements and a supportive team culture.
* Competitive salary and benefits.


**Join us**
 If you enjoy leading people, creating product clarity and bringing stakeholders together around effective delivery, we would like to hear from you. Apply and help us develop the next generation of secure authentication, identity and digital signing products.
   

  

 We review applications and interview qualified candidates continuously.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
*Passionate about making ideas a reality? Join our welcoming world of tech and let your ideas soar.*
 Do you want to help bridge the gap between today and the future — and play a key role in driving Saab’s digital transformation? It’s no longer only about how fast Saab’s products can fly, how deep they can dive or how far they can reach. It’s also about how fast they can adapt — always further, forever beyond. Saab is entering a new era of software transformation, where speed, intelligent use of data and systems that evolve as fast as the world changes are essential.
   

  

 In this transformation,
 **Common Tech** 
 and
 **Product Tech** 
 are key enablers. We build the shared platforms and components and enable Saab’s product teams to move faster, innovate more freely and shorten the time from need to real‑world capability.
   

  

 Together, we bridge the gap between current engineering practices and the capabilities required for Saab’s digital transformation — redefining how we build software, use data and deliver systems at speed.
   

  

**Your role**
 As a
 **Forward Deployed Engineer** 
 , you'll partner with product teams across Saab to solve complex technical challenges and accelerate innovation. You will build solutions, introduce new technologies and platforms, and help teams successfully adopt modern engineering practices.
   

  

 The role combines hands-on software engineering with technical leadership, enabling both technology and people to move forward. This is not a traditional developer role. It's a role for curious engineers who thrive in new environments, enjoy variety, and are motivated by creating real impact.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Work hands-on with complex technical challenges across different product areas
* Partner with product teams to understand their needs and turn them into scalable technical solutions
* Build and improve shared platforms, tools, and components that enable reuse across Saab
* Explore and apply technologies such as AI, cloud, edge computing, and real-time systems
* Enable teams to adopt and successfully apply modern technologies, platforms, and engineering practices in real product environments
* Help establish new ways of working that increase speed, quality, and collaboration
* Turn ambiguous challenges into clear, practical solutions
* Influence technical direction and long-term platform strategy


**Your profile**
 You enjoy working where technology, innovation, and real-world impact meet. You're someone who likes understanding complex systems, exploring new possibilities, and turning ideas into practical solutions. You combine strong engineering skills with curiosity and a pragmatic mindset. While your background may be in software engineering, systems engineering, data engineering, platform engineering, or a related field, what matters most is your ability to solve complex problems, navigate ambiguity, and help others move forward.
   

  

 You are comfortable taking ownership of technical challenges, collaborating with diverse stakeholders, and balancing hands-on engineering with enabling long-term success for teams and products.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
 We're looking for engineers who have built a solid foundation through experience and are ready to apply it across a variety of technical challenges.
   

  

 You likely have:
   

  

* Several years of experience working with software or systems engineering in complex product or technology environments
* Experience designing, building, or evolving technical solutions that are used by others
* Familiarity with modern engineering practices such as cloud technologies, CI/CD, automation, platform engineering, or distributed systems
* An interest in how AI, data, and emerging technologies can create practical value
* The ability to break down complex problems and turn uncertainty into clear direction
* Strong collaboration skills and an eagerness to learn from and share knowledge with others


 It's a bonus if you have experience with:
   

  

* Cloud-native platforms and infrastructure
* AI/ML applications in real-world products
* Platform engineering and reusable building blocks
* Systems architecture and technical leadership
* Real-time, safety-critical, or highly regulated environments


 We know that great engineers bring different experiences and perspectives. If this role excites you, but you don't meet every single qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Your potential, curiosity, and ability to learn are just as important as any individual technology or tool.
   

  

*This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.*
**What You Will Be Part Of**
 Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.
   

  

 Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.
   

  

 Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here

title: Transportutvecklare med inriktning mot system och digitalisering
description:
Där vården finns. Där finns vi. Vi säkerställer att vården har det som behövs när det behövs. Dygnet runt. Året om. Även när vardagen sätts på prov.
   

  





  

 Vårt uppdrag har betydelse för livet och vardagen för nästan en fjärdedel av Sveriges befolkning. Varje dag, året runt, skapar vi förutsättningar för våra kollegor i vården att utföra sitt arbete. Genom att vi exempelvis säkerställer att viktiga blodprov transporteras till analys och att produkter som provrör, operationsmaterial och skyddsutrustning finns på plats, bidrar vi till Region Stockholms livsviktiga uppdrag. Det är ett ansvar som inte alltid märks, men som är avgörande för trygg och säker vård. Utan rätt förutsättningar i rätt tid stannar vården.
   

  





  

 Hos MediCarrier är du en del av ett samhällsviktigt uppdrag, mitt i vårdens vardag. För allt det där vi kallar Livet.
   

  





**Beskrivning**




 Vi rekryterar en
 **transportutvecklare med inriktning mot system och digitalisering** 
 till MediCarriers affärsområde Transporttjänster. Rollen passar dig som vill arbeta i gränslandet mellan transportverksamhet, system och data och använda teknik för att utveckla verksamheten.
   

  





 I rollen arbetar du verksamhetsnära med att utveckla våra transportflöden, arbetssätt och systemlösningar.
   

  





 Du analyserar data och verksamhetsbehov, konfigurerar och utvecklar funktioner i våra transportsystem och omsätter behov till krav på nya eller förändrade lösningar. Det kan exempelvis handla om digitala beställningsflöden, spårbarhet, integrationer eller stöd för nya transportuppdrag.
   

  





 Du har nära kontakt med trafikledning, förare, chefer och andra användare och arbetar även tillsammans med systemleverantörer och IT.
   

  





 Rollen tillhör Transportutveckling inom affärsområdet Transporttjänster och du rapporterar till affärsområdeschef.
   

  





 Det här är inte en traditionell IT-roll. Fokus ligger inte på serverdrift, IT-infrastruktur eller programmering. System, data och teknik är verktyg för att utveckla transportverksamheten.
   

  





  
   

  





**Arbetsuppgifter i huvudsak** 



* Analysera kund-, order- och transportdata som underlag för utveckling och nya uppdrag
* Identifiera verksamhetsbehov och omsätta dem till systemlösningar och förbättrade arbetssätt
* Konfigurera och vidareutveckla funktioner i transportsystemet Opter och angränsande system
* Kravställa systemutveckling och förändringar mot leverantörer och IT
* Arbeta med integrations- och informationsflöden, exempelvis EDI och API
* Utveckla lösningar för exempelvis spårbarhet, skanning och digitala transportflöden
* Felsöka, testa och kvalitetssäkra systemfunktioner, data och integrationer
* Arbeta med verksamhetsnära teknik såsom handdatorer och mobila applikationer
* Delta i och driva utvecklingsinitiativ inom Transporttjänster



  
   

  





**Vem är du?**




 Du har ett stort intresse för både verksamhet och teknik och tycker om att förstå hur transportflöden, system och data hänger ihop. Du behöver inte vara programmerare eller systemutvecklare, men du har god teknisk förståelse och trivs med att lösa verksamhetsproblem med hjälp av system och data.
   

  





 Du är bekväm med att växla mellan dialog med användare, analys av data, teknisk felsökning och kravställning mot leverantörer.
   

  





 Som person är du analytisk, nyfiken och lösningsorienterad. Du trivs med att arbeta nära verksamheten och söker aktivt dialog med kollegor och användare för att förstå behov och hitta fungerande lösningar.
   

  





 Samtidigt är du självgående, strukturerad och har förmågan att sätta dig in i komplexa frågor och driva arbetet framåt från behov till genomförd lösning.
   

  





 För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har: 
 


* eftergymnasial utbildning inom exempelvis logistik eller systemvetenskap. Alternativt motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet
* erfarenhet av transport-, logistik- eller andra verksamhetsnära system
* erfarenhet av konfigurering, felsökning eller utveckling av systemfunktioner
* god analytisk förmåga och vana att arbeta med data
* goda kunskaper i Excel
* förmåga att förstå verksamhetsbehov och omsätta dem till praktiska lösningar
* god samarbets- och kommunikationsförmåga



 Det är meriterande om du också har:
 


* erfarenhet av transportsystem eller TMS
* erfarenhet av EDI, API eller andra integrationsflöden
* grundläggande kunskap om databaser, SQL och datauttag
* erfarenhet av kravställning, tester eller systemimplementationer
* erfarenhet av spårbarhets-, skannings- eller mobila lösningar



  
   

  





**Vad erbjuder vi dig?**




 Som ny hos oss får du en introduktion till MediCarriers olika verksamheter och vårt uppdrag inom Region Stockholm. Hur du introduceras i själva rollen anpassas efter din bakgrund, erfarenhet och kunskap. Du får en bred roll med möjlighet att påverka hur våra transportflöden, arbetssätt och digitala lösningar utvecklas framåt.
   

  





 Rollen är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med placering i Lunda/Spånga, provanställning kan komma att tillämpas. Det finns möjlighet till distansarbete ett par dagar i veckan.
   

  





 MediCarrier erbjuder bland annat friskvårdsbidrag på 5 000 kr, subventionerat SL-kort, löneväxling och företagsgym.
   

  





 Det här är ett uppdrag för dig som vill använda din tekniska och analytiska kompetens där den verkligen gör skillnad!
   

  





  
   

  





**Intresserad av att ansöka eller veta mer?**




 I denna rekrytering samarbetar MediCarrier med Poolia. Vid intresse eller
   

  





 frågor är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Jennifer Nilsson, rekryteringskonsult: Telefon: 072-079 69 88, E-post: jennifer.nilsson@poolia.se. För att ansöka, vänligen skicka in ditt CV eller ansök med LinkedIn.
   

  





****Att söka jobb i Region Stockholm****




 Vi eftersträvar jämställdhet och jämlikhet på vår arbetsplats och ser gärna sökande med olika bakgrund och förutsättningar.
   

  





 Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via detta system. Ansök genom att klicka på knappen ”Ansök”. Ansökningar per brev eller e-post beaktas inte. Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.
   

  





 Vårt rekryteringssystem kan inte hantera anonyma ansökningar eller sökande med skyddade personuppgifter. Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ber vi dig att kontakta den kontaktpersonen som finns angiven i annonsen. Din ansökan kommer då att hanteras utanför rekryteringssystemet. Du bör även vara försiktig med vilken information du lämnar i din ansökan och endast ta med information som är relevant för den aktuella befattningen.
   

  





 Region Stockholm ansvarar för hälso- och sjukvård, kollektivtrafik, regional utveckling och bidrar till kulturlivet. Varje dag, dygnet runt. I landets snabbaste växande region. Tillsammans skapar vi Europas attraktivaste storstadsregion.

title: Processutvecklare till Center för schemaplanering, vikariat
description:
Vill du bidra till något som verkligen är värdefullt – att skapa bättre förutsättningar för sjukvårdspersonal i alla professioner? Har du gedigen erfarenhet av schemaplanering och vill vara med och utveckla Karolinskas gemensamma arbetssätt och processer inom området? Då kan det här vara rollen för dig!
   

  





****Du erbjuds****



* att ingå i ett ambitiöst team med ansvar för att förbättra schemaplaneringsprocessen för hela Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset
* att arbeta i ett strategiskt viktigt uppdrag som bidrar till långsiktig förändring
* stora möjligheter att utvecklas i rollen som processutvecklare genom en spännande kombination av teknik, schemaplanering och förändringsledning
* möjlighet att efter introduktionen arbeta på distans 1–2 dagar i veckan efter överenskommelse.



 Självklart får du också ta del av våra generella förmåner som Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset erbjuder dig.
   

  





****Om tjänsten****




 Karolinska arbetar för att ta nästa steg inom schemaplanering genom att implementera ett gemensamt schemaplaneringsverktyg och gemensamma arbetssätt för samtliga kliniska verksamheter. Du kommer att arbeta i Center för schemaplanering, som är en del av enheten Produktion och uppföljning inom Stab Produktion.
   

  





 Tillsammans med teamet arbetar du med processutveckling och förändringsledning inom schemaplaneringsprocessen, med fokus på såväl processer och arbetssätt som verktyg.
   

  





 Dina arbetsuppgifter innebär bland annat att:
 


* implementera, utbilda och ge support till vårdverksamheter i användningen av schemaplaneringsverktyget Tessa
* stödja vårdverksamheterna i att utveckla goda arbetssätt för strategisk, taktisk och operativ schemaplanering
* möjliggöra strukturerad uppföljning och driva kontinuerlig datadriven processutveckling.



 Center för schemaplanering har i uppdrag att utveckla den sjukhusövergripande schemaplaneringsprocessen samt stödja vårdverksamheterna i schemaplanering på strategisk, taktisk och operativ nivå. Målet är att skapa gemensamma arbetssätt, minska administrationen och möjliggöra enhetlig uppföljning av resursåtgång kopplad till Karolinskas uppdrag inom produktion, utbildning och forskning.
   

  





 För att verksamheten ska kunna använda ett välanpassat system arbetar vi även med systemutveckling genom att samla in och beakta verksamheternas behov, så att dessa kan prioriteras och kravställas mot systemleverantör. Uppdraget innebär även att bidra med schemaplaneringsperspektivet i sjukhusövergripande processer inom Karolinskas modell för produktions- och ekonomistyrning.
   

  





 Tjänsten är en tidsbegränsad anställning på heltid under 12 månader, med tillträde enligt överenskommelse.
   

  





****Vi söker dig som****



* har förmåga att engagera andra och skapa delaktighet i förändring
* är lösningsorienterad och mån om att hitta välfungerande lösningar för verksamheten
* är serviceinriktad, involverande och engagerad
* kommunicerar pedagogiskt och tydligt med olika målgrupper, både i tal och skrift
* är lyhörd och strukturerad.



 Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.
   

  





****Kvalifikationer****




 Krav:
 


* minst tre års erfarenhet av schemaplanering på strategisk, taktisk och operativ nivå

title: AI- lösningsarkitekt inom Dynamics 365 & Power Platform
description:

 En viktig del av rollen är att hjälpa kunder att etablera och utveckla AI-funktionalitet genom Copilot Studio, AI-agenter, generativ AI och automatiserade processer samtidigt som du säkerställer governance, säkerhet, identitetshantering och efterlevnad av organisationens regelverk. * God verksamhetsförståelse inom områden som försäljning, kundservice, marknadsföring eller ekonomi.

**Om oss:** 




 Vi är ett ledande nordiskt IT-bolag som stärker våra kunders IT-förmåga i en allt mer komplex digital värld. Med bred och djup kompetens hjälper vi organisationer att skapa stabila, säkra och moderna lösningar från applikationsutveckling och integration till infrastruktur, drift och säkerhet. Vi tar ett helhetsansvar för IT och arbetar långsiktigt, både med våra kunder och med varandra. Hos oss är gemenskap, engagemang och utveckling en självklar del av vardagen. När vi trivs och växer tillsammans skapar vi också större värde.

title: Master thesis:Custom LLM Development
description:
**Join our Team**
**About This Opportunity**
 AI coding tools like Claude Code, Kiro, or Codex have become indispensable to most developers. At Ericsson, many developers work with a C-like programming language customized to program Ericsson's own silicon – Ericsson's Many-Core Architecture (EMCA). Because this language is not represented in the training data of general-purpose LLMs, coding assistance for EMCA can be inefficient, both in terms of token consumption and output quality.
   

  

 At Ericsson's System Comprehension Lab, we are training an in-house language model on EMCA source code to serve as a specialized tool for an orchestration agent. We are recruiting for two related master's thesis opportunities in this area: one on mitigating catastrophic forgetting during continued EMCA-specific training and one on tool-integrated reasoning. Both projects aim to improve the model's usefulness for EMCA development.
   

  

 Please indicate in your application which project you are most interested in. The exact focus of each project will be refined together with the student based on their interests, background, and the state of the model training team's research when the project starts. The work will be carried out with the team in Kista. You will have access to training pipelines, GPU resources, evaluation suites, and coding assistants such as Claude Code.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Direction 1: Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting
   

  

 The model has general capabilities, such as instruction following and broad coding knowledge, acquired during its original pre-training. At Ericsson, we adapt it to EMCA through continued pre-training and supervised fine-tuning on EMCA data. Additional EMCA-specific training may cause catastrophic forgetting: the model may improve on EMCA tasks while losing some of those general capabilities. This project investigates methods to improve EMCA-specific performance while preserving these capabilities.
   

  

* Establish a baseline using the current continued-pre-training and supervised-fine-tuning approach
* Implement and evaluate methods such as self-distillation, curriculum learning, model merging, or related techniques
* Measure both gains in EMCA-specific knowledge and retention of general capabilities, including instruction following and broad coding skills


 Direction 2: Tool-Integrated Reasoning
   

  

 This project explores how to extend the model with reasoning and tool interaction, potentially using reinforcement-learning-based training. Tool-integrated reasoning allows the model to invoke external tools and use their feedback during problem solving, with the aim of improving code accuracy and efficiency for complex or abstract EMCA tasks.
   

  

* Establish a baseline using the current model and standard reasoning methods
* Design, implement, and evaluate methods that enable the model to decide when to invoke tools – such as code execution, graph traversal, or vector search – interpret their feedback, and correct its reasoning when needed
* Assess improvements in EMCA task performance, code accuracy, tool-use effectiveness, token efficiency, and the ability to handle more abstract queries


**The Skills You Bring**
* You are pursuing a master's degree in computer science, engineering mathematics, physics, or a related field
* Good understanding of modern AI and machine learning, particularly generative AI and large language models
* Strong programming skills and an interest in experimental, research-oriented work
* Familiarity with deep-learning frameworks such as PyTorch
* Previous experience with LLM fine-tuning is a plus
* You are analytical, curious, and able to work independently while communicating your results clearly

title: Master Thesis: Multimodal Demo Selection
description:
**Join our Team**
**About This Opportunity**
 This master's thesis will explore Multimodal Feedback-Guided Demonstration Selection. The goal is to move beyond simple similarity-based retrieval and investigate whether demonstrations can be selected based on their actual usefulness to the model. The project will consider the complete demonstration - image, question/instruction, and answer; and will investigate how multiple complementary demonstrations can be selected efficiently.
   

  

 The topic sits at the intersection of multimodal AI, retrieval, LLMs, in-context learning, and representation learning, with opportunities for both practical system development and research-oriented experimentation.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 You will design, implement, and evaluate a demonstration-selection framework for Large Multimodal Models.
   

  

 Your work will include:
   

  

* Reviewing research on multimodal in-context learning, demonstration retrieval, vision-language models, and feedback-guided prompting
* Implementing baseline retrieval methods such as random, visual similarity, textual, and multimodal retrieval
* Building a feedback-guided retriever that learns which demonstrations are useful based on changes in LMM performance
* Representing demonstrations using their image, question/instruction, and answer, rather than visual information alone
* Investigating a selection of multiple demonstrations while considering usefulness, diversity, and redundancy
* Evaluating the impact of demonstration ordering and context size
* Conducting experiments on established multimodal benchmarks using open-source LMMs
* Performing ablation studies to understand which components contribute most to performanc
* Comparing the proposed approach with existing methods, including GRIP
* Analyzing results and documenting findings in a master's thesis and, where appropriate, a research publication


**The Skills You Bring**
* Background in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

title: Master thesis: Evaluation of multi-tool and multi-agent systems
description:
**Join our Team**
**About This Opportunity**
 Enterprises are now having many agentic systems with multiple agents interacting with each other and multiple tools being available to the agent for use. These tools are a mix of deterministic systems, vector embedding search, as well as generative models. They may be multimodal covering text, image, graph, code, etc. in both input and output.
   

  

 The main challenge is evaluation of such systems esp. given the non-deterministic nature and often the large number of tools available. Additionally, for tools which are probabilistic / vector search multiple results are returned some of which are wrong. These problems become pronounced for specific tasks, like in problems in telecommunication systems where preciseness of answer is very important.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Generate a master set of questions for agentic evaluation covering a wide range of topics, types and complexity
* Create an automated logging framework so that every tool call’s input and output is logged
* Evaluate the system input/output with multiple runs of master set of questions and observe patterns between runs and across questions
* Check on LLM-as-a-judge evaluation and see possibilities and how to calibrate scores

* Proficiency in Machine Learning and deep learning

I din roll som arkitekt samarbetar du nära utvecklingsteam, plattformsägare och affärssidan för att balansera teknisk kvalitet med affärsnytta.

 ,

**Träffa en Solitan** 




  





**Axel Lundh** 
 jobbar som Integration Architect hos oss med ansvar för att designa och bygga integrationsplattformar i Azure. Hans arbete fokuserar på att omsätta verksamhetskrav till robusta tekniska lösningar, samt skapa förutsättningar för effektiva och välfungerande utvecklingsteam.

 **Andrei** 
 som haft möjlighet att bära flera hattar som både SDM, arkitekt och kravställare i ett större projekt de senaste 3 åren.
 



  





**Att arbeta med AI som Integration Architect** 




  





 AI är en naturlig del av hur vi arbetar;

**Hur ser processen ut?** 




  





 I rekryteringsprocessen tror vi på en gedigen och effektiv process. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande. Om allt går bra tar vi oss vidare till sista steget där vi presenterar ett erbjudande och välkomnar dig som ny Solitan!

title: Master Thesis AI Efficient Compute RBS
description:
**Join our Team**
**Ericsson Overview**
 Ericsson is a world-leading provider of telecommunications equipment and services to mobile and fixed network operators. Over 1,000 networks in more than 180 countries use Ericsson equipment, and more than 40 percent of the world's mobile traffic passes through Ericsson networks. Using innovation to empower people, business and society, Ericsson is working towards Networked Society: A world connected in real time that will open up opportunities to create freedom, transform society and drive solutions to some of our planet’s greatest challenges.
   

  

 We are truly a global company, operating across borders in over 180 countries, offering a diverse, performance-driven culture and an innovative and engaging environment. As an Ericsson employee, you will have freedom to think big and the support to turn ideas into achievements. Continuous learning and growth opportunities allow you to acquire the knowledge and skills necessary to progress and reach your career goals. We invite you to join our team.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Considering the demand for new network capabilities, and requirements for high precision operations, AI/ML based solutions provide an opportunity to evolve the network in specific directions. By utilizing Graph neural network techniques, such Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs), Graph Attention Networks (GATs), Message Passing Neural Networks (MPNNs) and Graph Recurrent Networks (GRNs) network element performance can be improved.
   

  

 In this study, considering the set of technics that can be used, the study shall investigate to prioritize energy efficiency recommendations without sacrificing energy usage, and Quality of service (latency, throughput).
   

  

 The thesis is suitable for one student and would involve the following steps (can be suited adjusted to research interest of the candidate).
   

  

* Literature review: Identifying relevant concepts and algorithms for telecommunications.
* Enable a network view of all entities to secure right metrics.
* Apply: Suitable AI/ML algorithms, modeling and implementation into the network. A chosen techniques for the selected use case
* Evaluation and test: Obtain model for the considered use case from network perspective


**Qualifications**
 We are looking for a highly motivated student who seeks challenging research work with the freedom to propose and develop new ideas. To be successful in this thesis work, the candidate would need the following:
   

  

* MSc studies in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering fields or similar areas.
* Excellent programming skills in Python.
* Good knowledge of concepts in machine learning (including deep learning) and other AI technics.
