title: Staff Software Engineer, Product Engineering - EU
description:
Hi 👋🏾 I’m Abhik, Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. We’re looking for a versatile, persistent product engineer who’s not afraid to set up reusable building blocks across the stack and advocate for the time and space to do so. At Ashby, all our engineers ship features end-to-end at a high pace. Example is the best leadership. We’ll give you the room to do your best work, and you'll be our guide! If that speaks to you, read on.
   

  

 What Ashby gives you in return is the best of both early and growth-stage environments. The agency and no-nonsense of a seed startup: you write product specs, make product and design decisions, and build in an almost-no-meeting culture. While also the product-market fit and scale of a growth-stage startup: 100,000+ weekly active users who depend on your software and eagerly await your next feature.
   

  

 We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet.
   

  

 You’ve probably seen this role posted before, and it’s because we’re always expanding the team (we’re on track to double Engineering this year). We’re bubbling with ideas for how to support Talent Acquisition with software, and we recently launched Talent Management products to expand our total addressable market and become a company worth $60B+.
   

  

 We read every application and aim to respond to yours within 3-4 days (often sooner).
   

  

**About The Role And How We Work**
 Our engineering culture strives to recreate the environments where we did our best work as ICs – where we had the ownership and agency to impact our users with creative and innovative software.
   

  

 I started my career building software for artists in the Visual Effects industry. It was a formative experience for me as a software engineer because success relied on my ability to be a product manager and designer. I talked to artists to understand their needs. I came up with ideas. I did industry research, designed interfaces, and prototyped ideas. I watched artists use what I built and decided what to tackle in the next iteration. No daily stand-ups, no t-shirt sizing, no planning meetings.
   

  

 I studied computer science to solve problems, not tickets, and this felt exactly like that. I not only felt creative and fulfilled but the agency and ownership we were given as engineers powered an incredible amount of innovation.
   

  

 Innovation came differently (or not at all) at technology startups beyond the seed stage, often through an engineer’s force of will and ability to push back against culture (rather than any encouragement from it). Engineering was narrowed to implementation and delivery, partly due to the influence of other departments and partly due to the influx of "Agile" processes like sprint planning. In those companies, I felt like a JIRA jockey.
   

  

**About**
 At Ashby, we’re building an environment that is optimistic about what engineers can own and achieve. An environment that embraces innovative engineers, and, frankly, often stays out of their way. As a Product Engineer, you’ll take ownership over a large portion of one of our products and own projects end-to-end (wearing hats traditionally worn by product and design). You’ll research competitors, write product specs, make wireframes, and more. To ground it with examples, product engineers at Ashby have:
   

  

* Designed and built automated interview scheduling. This feature automates scheduling by calculating possible times from a pool of interviewers and other constraints, and then presenting these times to the candidate for selection via our responsive web app. This solves the “Calendar Tetris” problem I talk about in "What We're Building."
* Built a generalized declarative filter architecture that allows users to create complex filters for any record with a consistent UI and compile it to SQL in our backend. Many user-facing features use it.
* Specced, designed, and implemented a feature that allows users to complete signing offers entirely within Ashby. This project involved talking to customers to understand their requirements, deciding what technologies to use, building a prototype, and working with other team members to integrate the final implementation into additional features.


 What We’re Building
   

  

 As engineers, we are used to tooling that makes us
 **better** 
 at what we do. When we started Ashby, we saw the opposite with Talent Acquisition (TA) software. Recruiting teams were leveling up how they did their work, but instead of software meeting this new standard, it held them back.
   

  

 Scheduling a final round is an excellent example. Recruiting teams wanted to schedule candidates faster, track interviewer preparation and quality, and do it with half the headcount. A recruiter needed to manually collect availability from the candidate, identify qualified interviewers, perform “Calendar Tetris” to find who is available to interview the candidate, schedule on the earliest date possible, and make any last-minute adjustments as availability changed. They must do this while considering the interview load on each individual and whether interviewers need to be trained and shadowing others. 🥵 TA software didn’t help.
   

  

 As hiring managers, we know TA is a critical function, and as engineers, we know software can do better. So, we built and continue to build Ashby to give TA teams the
 *highest* 
 standard of tooling. Software that’s intelligent and powerful. Software that provides insights into where they’re failing and automates or simplifies many of the tasks they’re underwater with. We want other functions and departments to be jealous of what TA teams can do with Ashby, and today they often are!
   

  

 As we’ve set the standard for excellence in TA software, HR teams have pulled us into solving their problems in areas like onboarding and performance management.
   

  

 Why You Should or Shouldn’t Apply
   

  

 Software Engineers Come In Many Flavors, Not All Of Which Fit Our Model. Here Are Some Things To Help You Decide If This Fits You And What You’re Looking For
   

  

* You’re not afraid to tackle any part of a technology stack. You do what’s necessary to successfully deliver a feature, whether writing frontend or choosing new infrastructure. We’ll provide a supportive environment to do it successfully (e.g., design system, SRE team).
* You’ve tackled projects with a lot of product and technical ambiguity, and you thrive at the intersection of the two. We’re not building a simple CRUD app, and many of the challenges we tackle require you to use your knowledge of our customers to build powerful abstractions and flexibility in the system to solve a class of problems.
* You know how to strike the right balance between speed and quality. Ashby wasn’t built quickly. We took four years to launch publicly because convincing customers to switch required a high-quality product. However, time isn’t infinite, especially for a startup, so we still move with urgency—we’ve built the equivalent of three or more VC-backed startups with a very small team.
* You are ambitious and always looking to improve your skills. For most engineers, this role will give you more freedom and responsibilities than you’ve experienced in the past. To thrive (and level up), you’ll need to be open to feedback (and we give lots of it).
* You’re an excellent collaborator and communicator. Ownership and freedom don’t mean you work in a vacuum. You’ll need to vet your decisions with the appropriate stakeholders, keep them up to date when necessary, and work with other engineers to get your projects across the finish line. Clear and concise communication helps a lot here!
* You seek to create leverage in your work. The nature of software is that you can often automate or abstract what would be tedious, time-consuming work. Your impatience usually leads to new abstractions, tools to allow Support to debug before Engineering, new lint rules to prevent common bugs, etc.


**Put Another Way, You Shouldn’t Apply If**
* To you, a tech lead, staff, or principal engineer is someone who spends most of their time project managing or doing architecture reviews. Our most tenured engineers spend most of their time building, and we often trust them with our most challenging problems. While they lead product and technical areas and help other engineers plan their most challenging work, it’s not a requirement, nor do engineers need their sign-off.
* You need company-driven process and structure to get your projects across the finish line. Sprint planning and well-defined project management processes are things you need or look to others to lead. You’d rather focus on the technical details and challenges.
* You only want to do exciting work. We’re building a team of kind, collaborative folks. Customer issues and investigations are distributed across the team, including our high-level ICs.
* You can get lost in the details. Once you start implementation, it can be hard to take a step back and think about the project as a whole. You like everything to be planned upfront.
* You haven’t led or taken ownership of projects before. You’re used to working with tech leads and taking on tasks distributed by them.
* You want to mentor earlier-career engineers. We rely on engineers owning their projects, so we need engineers with that experience. This requires the team to be reasonably tenured. More than 90% of the team would be considered Senior or above in the industry today, so mentorship opportunities are very limited.


 Engineering Culture
   

  

 Our Engineering Culture Is Motivated By Benji’s (my Co-founder And CEO) And My Belief That a Small, Talented Team, Given The Right Environment, Can Build High-quality Software Fast (and Work Regular Hours!). We Do It Through
   

  

* Minimal process with ownership over decisions normally made by product and design
* Natural collaboration and deliberate communication
* Investing in tools and abstractions that give us leverage
* Putting effort into building a diverse team


**Minimal Process & Lots of Ownership**
 The best engineers we’ve worked with delivered reliably magical outcomes. They took customer problems and relentlessly drove them to solutions that were not only successful but often brilliant and creative. While they did this with minimal oversight, stakeholders were never in the dark as to what was going on, and no setback was a surprise.
   

  

 Traditional product-development processes aren’t meant for the best engineers. Their purpose is to create consistent outcomes regardless of the engineer’s skill. But, consistency comes at the expense of an engineer’s time and freedom—both ingredients necessary to generate those magical outcomes. As a result, process stifles the best engineers and doesn’t give others the opportunity to practice the behaviors that made the best engineers the “best.”
   

  

 At Ashby, we want to build an environment that encourages every engineer to be their best. So, at Ashby, every Engineer runs their project. Product Managers (and Designers) build strategy, do customer research, and hand off problem briefs to Engineers. Engineers take on the rest: they research the problem, write product specs, build wireframes, and implement their solution end-to-end. We rely on engineers, not process, to push information outward to the relevant folks (e.g., Product Managers) and pull folks in to help (e.g., Designers, Infra). It’s a new level of ownership for many engineers, but we’d rather an engineer fail a bit and coach up their skills than use process as a crutch. Not everyone succeeds in our culture, but those who do
 *thrive* 
 .
   

  

**Collaboration is Natural & Communication is Deliberate**
 Our engineering team consists of lifelong learners who are talented but also humble and kind (meet them here!). These attributes create an environment where collaboration happens naturally. We combine this with research, prototyping, and written proposals to see around corners and get feedback from the team across time zones. Focus time is something that we hold sacred, and, with thoughtful and deliberate communication, engineers are in <2h meetings per week (I wrote about it here).
   

  

 To Drive It Home, Here's a Recent Calendar Of An Engineer Who Has Been With Us For Over 4 Years. ~34 Hours Of Focus Time, 2.5h Of Interviews, And 3.5 Hours Of Meetings
   

  

 We also meet in person at least twice a year, once as a department and once as a company. You also have a small budget to meet up with folks in your city/region.
   

  

**Increase Leverage, not Team Size**
 We Built Ashby With The Quality, Breadth, And Depth That Many Customers Would Expect From Much Larger Teams Over Larger Time Scales. We’ve Done This Through Investment In
   

  

* Great developer tooling. Our CI/CD takes ~10m, and we deploy at least 15x a day. A debugger that works out of the box. Everyone on the team has contributed to our developer experience 💪🏾.
* Building blocks to create powerful and customizable products fast. At the core of Ashby is a set of common components (analytics modeling and query language, policy engine, workflow engine, design system) that we constantly improve. Each improvement to a common component cascades throughout our app (short video below).
* AI-powered tooling. We think of AI as a way to automate the mundane parts of building and maintaining high-quality software. We use a combination of third-party and internally built tools that, for instance, auto-triage customer issues, suggest fixes, prototype ideas, generate production-ready code, and conduct code reviews. Engineers have an unlimited token budget (but are not measured on it). We write in detail about our philosophy, current use of AI, and future plans for AI in Engineering here.


**And a Demo Of One Of These Building Blocks**
 Here’s an impromptu quote from Arjun in our company Slack of what it’s like to build a feature at Ashby:
   

  

**Put Effort into Diversity**
 Diverse teams drive innovation and better outcomes. Having seen my mother and partner build their careers as minority women in non-diverse fields, I want to make sure Ashby creates opportunities for the next generation of engineers from underrepresented groups.
   

  

 Today, 25% of engineers and 50% of our engineering leaders at Ashby are from underrepresented groups. We are taking conscious steps to improve, like sourcing diverse candidates, providing generous paid family leave, no leetcode interviews, and more.
   

  

**Work-Life Balance: It’s A Marathon, Not a Sprint**
 The intensity of work at Ashby should feel like a marathon, not a sprint (nor speed-walking). We work with urgency and ambition to build excellent software, but we don’t need to prove out a new software category or product-market fit. That requires ingenuity and thoughtfulness, and that doesn’t happen with unrealistic deadlines or sleepless nights.
   

  

 Our remote, low-meeting, high-ownership culture gives you
 *a lot* 
 of flexibility in how you structure your days and weeks. In practice, that means you keep your own hours, but there will be moments of intensity, like launching your feature at our annual user conference. We offer unlimited PTO, and you actually get to use it. Some of our most exceptional engineers take almost 30 days of vacation per year.
   

  

 This way of working allows many of us on the team to be active parents, including Benji and me. I block off 1.5 hours every morning to spend with my daughter and drop her off at school. Mujda (Product Engineer) puts it best in an article about us: “I can say that Ashby is a great place to be a mom… No one bats an eye if I have to take my kid to a doctor’s appointment or have to work weird hours because childcare fell through.”
   

  

**Interview Process**
 At Ashby, our team and interview process want to help you show your best self. We’ll dive into past projects and simulate working together via pair programming, writing product and tech specs collaboratively, and talking through decisions. There are no leetcode or whiteboard exercises.
   

  

**Our Interview Process Is Three Rounds**
* Introduction call with Hiring Manager (15 to 30m, live)
* A technical screen where we pair in our actual codebase (1h, live)
* Three non-coding interviews that focus on product thinking, technical design, and infrastructure (3h 15m, live can be split across multiple days)


 Depending on our leadership team’s bandwidth, we may start with an
 *additional* 
 30m screen with a recruiter.
   

  

 Your hiring manager will be your main point of contact and prep you for interviews. Each round will have written guidance so you know what to expect (you’ll need minimal preparation). You’ll meet 4 to 6 people in engineering (with 5-15 minutes in each interview to ask them questions). If we don’t give an offer, we’ll provide feedback!
   

  

**Your First Three Months at Ashby**
 We want an exceptional onboarding experience for every new hire. At Ashby, your dev environment is set up with a single script, you push your first product change on day one, and you spend the rest of your time shipping product changes that give you a tour of our codebase and best practices. The product changes increase in scope and ambiguity from simple copy changes to the delivery of a prominent, impactful feature. Your manager will do a 30, 60, and 90-day review to give feedback and calibrate on how we work together.
   

  

 It’s a team effort to get you successfully onboarded; you’ll have a peer paired with you to answer questions, pair program, and check in often to see if you need help. The rest of the team will run training sessions on our culture, product, engineering process, and technical architecture.
   

  

**Technology Stack**
 I’m sharing our tech stack with the caveat that we don’t require previous experience in it (but a love of typed languages is helpful 😀): TypeScript (frontend & backend), React, GraphQL API, Node.js, Postgres, Redis.
   

  

 When they joined Ashby, many of our engineers switched from other languages like Swift and Kotlin (Ben), platforms like iOS (Tom) and Windows (Adam). We care more about fundamentals (e.g., debugging, abstractions) and how fast you learn. For folks on the team who switched, it's nice seeing changes hot reload versus waiting for XCode to compile 😅.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Competitive salary and equity.
* 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
* Unlimited PTO, and we will encourage you to take it.
* A minimum of 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, covered by Ashby. For folks outside the US, it may be longer to be in line with regional requirements.
* Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
* $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.
* $250/month tool budget plus access to Claude, Cursor, and Codex with generous token budgets.
* If you’re in the US, we offer top-tier health insurance for you and your dependents, with 100% of premiums covered by Ashby. In other countries, we provide high-quality supplemental health insurance for you and your dependents, also fully covered by us.


 Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.
   

  

*Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.*
*Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.*
 Compensation Range: €154K - €250K

title: Walk-in Technician
description:
**Do you enjoy technology, troubleshooting, and solving problems directly with customers?**
 At
 **Foxway** 
 , we believe technology should be used for longer. Every day, we help organizations extend the life of IT equipment through smart, circular solutions that create value for both customers and the environment. Our purpose is simple: to make digital life easier while reducing unnecessary waste and extending the life of technology.
   

  

 We are now launching a new
 **Walk-in Service in Södertälje** 
 and are looking for a
 **Walk-in Technician** 
 to provide hands-on technical support to customers visiting the service.
   

  

****What you'll be doing****
 As a
 **Walk-in Technician** 
 , you will be the technical point of contact when customers bring devices to our Walk-in Service.
   

  

 You will assess devices, troubleshoot problems, perform device swaps and determine the right next step. Some issues you will resolve directly, while others will need to be documented and routed to the appropriate repair or service team.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Perform initial diagnostics on computers, phones and other devices.
* Troubleshoot basic hardware and software issues.
* Assess device condition and determine the appropriate next step.
* Perform device SWAPs according to established processes.
* Triage repair cases and route them for further technical handling when needed.
* Check device eligibility, warranty status and required documentation.
* Prepare and configure devices and related equipment when required.
* Explain technical findings and next steps clearly to customers.
* Document technical findings and actions accurately in relevant systems.
* Escalate more complex cases and collaborate with repair and service teams.


**Who We Are Looking For**
 You enjoy hands-on technical work but are equally comfortable interacting directly with customers. You can troubleshoot methodically, explain technical issues simply and remain service-minded when a customer arrives with an urgent problem.
   

  

**We believe you have**
* Previous experience with IT hardware, technical support, device repair, service desk or similar technical work.
* Good understanding of computers, mobile devices and common hardware/software issues.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Good attention to detail and ability to follow technical processes.
* A service-minded approach and confidence working directly with customers.
* Ability to prioritize and manage several cases in a fast-paced environment.
* Good communication skills in Swedish and English.
* Technical education and/or relevant certifications are considered a merit.


 Experience within circularity or refurbishment is
 **not required** 
 . What matters is your technical foundation, curiosity and willingness to learn.
   

  

****To succeed in this role****
* You enjoy investigating problems and finding practical solutions.
* You combine technical thinking with a customer-first mindset.
* You take ownership and work accurately.
* You can explain technical information in a simple and helpful way.
* You collaborate well with advisors, technicians and wider service teams.


****Why join Foxway?****
* Help build a new Walk-in Service in Södertälje from the beginning.
* Join a stable and growing international technology company.
* Develop your technical skills through hands-on customer-facing work.
* Work in a supportive and collaborative team environment.
* Contribute to a more sustainable and circular use of technology.


**Help us make a difference!**
 We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so if this sounds like the next step in your career, apply quickly!
   

  

**For the selected final candidate**
 Foxway will conduct a
 **background check** 
 as part of our recruitment process, in accordance with applicable local legislation and our internal screening policy. The scope of the check depends on the position and the country in which it is based. You will be informed of the details, and your approval will be requested before any check is initiated.
   

  

****How does Foxway operate?****
 Foxway is a fast-growing and dynamic organization with an international team of nearly 1,300 people. We operate across multiple countries, with key hubs across Europe.
   

  

 Within Foxway,
 **Circular Workspace Solutions (CWS)** 
 focuses on delivering sustainable workplace solutions through Device-as-a-Service, lifecycle services, and IT Asset Disposition offerings for enterprise and public sector customers.
   

  

 Our mission is to make sustainable technology accessible to everyone by extending the life of IT equipment and enabling circular business models.
   

  

 By joining us, you become part of a purpose-driven, international team that is shaping the future of sustainable workplaces and circular technology.

title: Android Developer
description:
We’re looking for an
 **Android Developer** 
 to join us.
   

  

 I’m
 **Katti Ramber, Head of Live & Events within Tech Pay TV,** 
 and I’m searching for someone ready to grow with us. We’re a supportive, forward‑thinking team focused on
 **shaping** 
**the future of entertainment.**
 The team behind
 **Telia Play** 
 are passionate experts in Streaming & TV, and we work every day to create an exceptional experience for millions of users across the Nordics. We strive to make it easier for our users to discover great content - from movies, series, programs, and linear channels to an outstanding sports experience.
   

  

**What you’ll do:**
 In this role, you’ll help shape the future of Telia Play by building high‑performing Android experiences used by millions across the Nordics.
   

  

* Develop, enhance, and maintain Telia Play for Android devices, with a strong focus on Android TV.
* Design and optimize applications for performance, scalability, automation, and smooth release flows.
* Collaborate closely within a cross‑functional team, working with designers and backend developers to implement modern architectural patterns and coding standards.
* Build with a modern Kotlin-based tech stack using Jetpack Compose, our design system, Firebase, and GraphQL.
* Create exceptional user experiences that delight and engage our customers.


**What will help you thrive in this role:**
 We’re looking for someone with strong experience in building scalable, high‑quality applications for Android TV platforms.
   

  

* You have solid proficiency in Kotlin and Compose, with a proven ability to design and implement advanced architectural patterns and performance optimization techniques.
* You are eager to drive automation and continue shaping a smooth release process, ensuring high‑quality delivery aligned with engineering best practices.
* Experience building widely used consumer apps with GraphQL and adaptive streaming protocols such as DASH and HLS is a plus.
* You are skilled in managing Git workflows, ensuring code quality, and maintaining high test coverage.
* You bring a strong problem‑solving mindset and thrive in collaborative environments.
* Bonus points if you have worked with TV‑specific hardware features such as remote controls, voice interaction, or Android accessibility tools like TalkBack.


**Join us to shape smarter living for people, businesses, and the planet**
 At Telia, we’re a team of 15 000 colleagues across the Nordics and Baltics, passionate about technology and connectivity. As a
 **Leading Telecommunications Operator** 
 &
 **Climate Leader** 
 , we drive change with large-scale, impactful projects while building a sustainable, inclusive world.
   

  

 Here, you can
 **grow your skills, lead meaningful projects, and thrive in a supportive, diverse environment.** 
 Whether you’re taking your first step or your next, Telia is a place to grow, belong, and make a real impact.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 When you join us, you'll receive a comprehensive benefits package tailored to your local market, opportunities for remote work, and more. You'll also have the chance to earn a bonus based on your performance and Telia's results.
   

  

**For Lithuanian applicants only: monthly salary range for this position – 4300-6500 EUR (gross) + annual performance bonuses** 
 . Although it may vary depending on your skills and experience.
   

  

**Ready to make better happen?**
 We look forward to receiving your application by
 **September 21.**
**Please note that due to time limitations of the process, only candidates selected for the next steps will be contacted personally.**
 If you’re selected for the next stage, you’ll be contacted by our
 **Hiring Manager or Talent Acquisition Partner** 
 . Background checks will be part of the process.
   

  

**Equal opportunities**
 At Telia, we recognize talent by
 **professional skills and growth potential.** 
 We champion diversity, ensuring every individual’s needs are met, regardless of disability, gender, age, nationality, sexual orientation, or social status. Together, we’re dedicated to fostering an inclusive work environment where
 **your uniqueness is our strength.**
**Join us and let’s make better happen - together!**

title: Information Security Officer till Handelsbanken
description:
Vill du vara med och forma Handelsbankens arbete med informationssäkerhet på koncernnivå? Vi söker dig som vill arbeta strategiskt och rådgivande i en samhällsviktig roll.
   

  

**Ditt team**
 Du blir en del av ett erfaret och specialiserat governance-team som tillsammans täcker både teknisk och verksamhetsnära kompetens inom informationssäkerhet. Teamets arbete spänner över flera områden, från att etablera och förvalta bankens ledningssystem för informationssäkerhet (ISMS) och koncernövergripande regler inom informationssäkerhet, till att tolka externa regelverk, rapportera till myndigheter och stötta initiativ både i Sverige och internationellt. Teamet ansvarar även för etablering och implementation av bankens program för säkerhetsmedvetande samt koordinering av ett internationellt nätverk med informationssäkerhetsspecialister på våra etablerade hemmamarknader.
   

  

 Arbetet sker i nära samarbete, men med stort individuellt ansvar. Rollen innebär många kontaktytor och kräver samverkan med både IT och affärsrepresentanter från hela koncernen.
   

  

 Hos oss kommer du få arbeta med många olika frågor, då vi är en viktig del i hela banken och arbetar aktivt för att stötta alla våra verksamheter. Rollen erbjuder dig en såväl personlig som professionell utveckling inom ett spännande och aktuellt område.
   

  

**Din roll**
 Som Information Security Officer ansvarar du för att utveckla, driva och förvalta bankens systematiska informationssäkerhetsarbete i linje med etablerade standarder.
   

  

 Rollen omfattar även arbete med att förbättra informationssäkerhetsprocesser, instruktioner och kontroller för att möjliggöra effektiv implementering och förvaltning i GRC-verktyg, med fokus på standardisering, automatisering och effektivitet. Du bidrar tillsammans med kollegor i teamet till att identifiera behov och kravställa funktionalitet även i andra system och verktyg som stödjer informationssäkerhetsarbetet, som exempelvis inom informationsskydd och säkerhetsrapportering.
   

  

 Du fungerar som rådgivare inom informationssäkerhet för hela organisationen och bidrar aktivt till både strategiskt och operativt arbete. Rollen ger stora möjligheter att påverka, då du planerar, leder, genomför och följer upp säkerhetsarbetet både självständigt och tillsammans med andra. Du vägleder organisationen i tolkning av regelverk, och är en viktig röst i interna och externa forum där du representerar banken i frågor som rör informationssäkerhet.
   

  

**Din profil**
 Vi söker dig med minst fem års erfarenhet av arbete inom informationssäkerhet och god vana av att arbeta med ledningssystem enligt internationella standarder som ISO/IEC 27001 eller motsvarande. Du har tidigare arbetat med att tolka och hantera externa myndighetskrav samt leda det interna arbetet för att säkerställa efterlevnad av nya regelverk.
   

  

 Du har erfarenhet av metod- och processutveckling inom informationssäkerhet, gärna med fokus på ledningssystem, riskhantering och GRC-verktyg. Du är van vid att planera, leda och genomföra informationsinsatser på både svenska och engelska. Det är meriterande om du har arbetat inom bank eller finans, och har förståelse för affärsprocesser och branschspecifika krav. Vi tror att du har relevant utbildning inom IT eller informationssäkerhet, och certifieringar som CISM, CRISC eller CISSP är en fördel.
   

  

 Vi söker dig som har en god förmåga att skapa engagemang, drivkraft och delaktighet för att nå gemensamma mål. Du tar gärna egna initiativ, är strukturerad och självständig och är tydlig och ödmjuk i din kommunikation. Du besitter förmågan att pendla mellan det korta och längre perspektivet och uppskattar den typen av arbetsklimat.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan!**
 Som ett steg i Handelsbankens rekryteringsprocess krävs en godkänd bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat, utförd av en extern part, innan anställning kan ske.
   

  

 Handelsbanken är en del av Sveriges totalförsvar och som bank fyller vi en samhällsviktig funktion tillsammans med den finansiella sektorn. Rollen kan därför komma att omfattas av krigsplacering inom Handelsbanken.
   

  

**Kontaktuppgifter**
**Rekryterande chef:** 
 Nikolina Mrzic, nikolina.mrzic@handelsbanken.se
   

  

**Talent Acquisition Partner:** 
 Alva Jonerot, alva.jonerot@handelsbanken.se
   

  

**Facklig representant Finansförbundet:** 
 Artemis Chatziparaskeva, artemis.chatziparaskeva@handelsbanken.se
   

  

**Facklig representant Akademikerföreningen:** 
 Cecilia Zielfelt, cecilia.zielfelt@handelsbanken.se

title: Lead Project Leader - Google Cloud AI Transformation
description:
**Job ID: 6347**
 Lead Project Leader – Google Cloud AI Transformation (permanent position)
   

  

 Welcome to Group Technology, where we pride ourselves on engineering solutions and direct Nordea’s transformation by providing a holistic technological view and structured understanding of the bank, and its surrounding environment to enable the Customer Vision and the Business Strategy.
   

  

 Core Technology Change & Delivery is seeking an experienced Lead Project Leader to drive strategic AI and cloud transformation initiatives on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will lead the delivery and governance of Google Cloud AI platform capabilities, establish scalable and reusable AI services, and coordinate complex dependencies across cloud foundations, security, data, architecture and engineering domains.
   

  

 You will help shape the AI platform roadmap, drive adoption of cloud-native AI capabilities and ensure that strategic AI ambitions are translated into executable delivery plans and measurable business outcomes. The role combines strategic leadership, programme governance, stakeholder management and hands-on delivery leadership across multiple technology domains.
   

  

 Nordea is a place where traditions meet tomorrow. We're not just a bank, we're a tech employer on a mission to evolve finance securely and responsibly. Together, we impact millions of people’s daily lives by ensuring they can access our solutions anytime, anywhere, while safeguarding their personal data and wealth. Join us in making an impact on the banking industry.
   

  

**About Our Team**
 Core Technology Change & Delivery is responsible for project and programme management, execution and governance of technology change initiatives. We work across business and technology teams to ensure that strategic commitments are delivered predictably, transparently and in line with the Core Technology Operating Model and Nordea Delivery Guide.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
**Main responsibilities in this role:**
* Lead end-to-end delivery of strategic GCP AI and cloud transformation programmes, from ideation and planning through implementation and value realisation.
* Drive execution of Google Cloud and AI platform roadmaps, ensuring alignment between strategic objectives, architecture direction and delivery plans.
* Coordinate dependencies across architecture, cloud engineering, security, identity and access management, network, data, platform and business teams.
* Drive delivery of shared, reusable AI platform capabilities that support scalable onboarding of use cases and teams.
* Shape and maintain programme plans, milestones, budgets, resource allocation, risks, issues and dependencies.
* Establish effective programme governance, decision forums and reporting for senior stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise architecture, security, regulatory, resilience and operational requirements.
* Support the development of a sustainable cloud operating model, including platform ownership, service management, cost transparency and operational readiness.
* Proactively identify delivery obstacles, resolve escalations and drive decisions across organisational boundaries.
* Promote a strong delivery culture based on ownership, transparency, accountability and continuous improvement.


**Who You Are**
 This role is a strong match if you are a strategic and delivery-oriented leader who can create clarity and momentum in a complex environment. You combine strong programme leadership with a solid understanding of cloud and AI technologies, communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, and are comfortable challenging assumptions, influencing decisions and driving organisational alignment.
   

  

**Your background and skills include:**
* Proven track record of leading large-scale technology programmes and strategic transformation initiatives in cloud, data or AI environments.
* Strong experience driving delivery and governance of Google Cloud Platform initiatives across multiple technology domains.
* Deep understanding of Google Cloud Platform services, cloud foundations, platform engineering and cloud operating model principles.
* Experience establishing and evolving cloud and AI platform capabilities that enable scalable adoption of AI solutions across an enterprise.
* Strong understanding of AI technologies, including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), agentic workflows, AI orchestration frameworks and emerging cloud-based capabilities.
* Ability to define and drive strategic roadmaps, translate them into executable delivery plans and ensure alignment with organisational priorities.
* Experience coordinating complex dependency landscapes across architecture, cloud engineering, security, identity and access management, network, data and business teams.
* Strong governance and leadership skills, including establishing decision forums, steering committees and executive reporting structures.
* Experience influencing senior stakeholders and driving alignment across multiple organisational units and technology domains.
* Understanding of platform-oriented delivery models, including shared services, reusable capabilities, automated onboarding and self-service enablement.
* Strong understanding of cloud security, resilience, scalability, operational readiness and cloud financial management principles.
* Proven ability to proactively identify delivery risks, resolve impediments and drive successful outcomes in complex environments.
* Very good financial and resource management skills.
* Very good analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Advanced presentation skills, especially PowerPoint and Excel.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent English skills, both spoken and written.
* Can-do attitude.


**What We Offer**
 Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.
   

  

 People are driven by many different factors. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.
   

  

 A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.
   

  

 Our way of working - We believe in bringing people together and want our offices to remain a cornerstone of the company. Our offices are where we connect, collaborate, learn from one another and build our culture. Therefore, as a principle, we work mostly from the office.
   

  

 Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.
   

  

 If this sounds like you, get in touch!
   

  

**Next steps**
 Submit your application no later than 01/10/2026.
   

  

**The recruitment process consists of the following steps:**

* Online interview with the hiring leader
* Background check


 We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.
   

  

 We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.
   

  

 We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.
   

  

 We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.
   

  

 We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. title: Technical Account Manager
description:

 Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences! We’re passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.
   

  

 We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours!
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 At Adobe, we help the world's leading brands create exceptional customer experiences. As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to some of the largest and most strategic organisations across the Nordic region.
   

  

 You will partner with customers to maximise the value of their Adobe Experience Cloud investment by driving technical readiness, solution adoption, operational excellence, and long-term business outcomes. Acting as an extension of the customer's team, you will provide proactive technical leadership, coordinate technical engagement activities, and help customers navigate complex digital transformation initiatives. As a champion for the customer, you will share personalised knowledge and business-critical insights across people, process, and technology, align Adobe teams on the customer’s behalf, and deliver consistent value across the entire customer journey.
   

  

****What You'll Do****
 As a Technical Account Manager, you will:

* Own the technical health of assigned customer accounts and proactively identify risks, opportunities, and optimisation recommendations.
* Develop and maintain Technical Readiness Roadmaps aligned to customer priorities and business objectives.
* Lead technical reviews including environment reviews, service reviews, release readiness discussions, and operational health assessments.
* Coordinate milestone-based engagements such as implementations, migrations, upgrades, integrations, go-lives, and peak-event preparation.
* Drive adoption of Adobe solutions through best-practice guidance, technical coaching, and use-case activation.
* Partner with Customer Success Managers, Solution Consultants, Product teams, Support, Engineering, and Technical Account Directors to ensure successful customer outcomes.
* Act as the customer's technical advocate within Adobe and facilitate appropriate management of blocking issues when required.
* Deliver regular business and technical insights that demonstrate customer value and support renewal readiness.
* Contribute to customer retention, growth, and long-term success through proactive engagement and careful planning.
* Connect customers with the right Adobe resources — such as Professional Services or Integrated Services — when hands-on implementation, development, or deployment work is required.


****Key Responsibilities****
**Technical Leadership**
* Provide strategic technical guidance across Adobe Experience Cloud solutions.
* Assess customer environments and recommend improvements to performance, stability, governance, and scalability.
* Support customers through major business events and digital initiatives.


**Customer Success**
* Drive measurable customer outcomes through structured technical engagements.
* Help customers realise value from existing investments and identify new opportunities for optimisation.
* Maintain a deep understanding of customer business objectives and technical priorities.


**Programme Management**
* Coordinate technical activities across multiple collaborators.
* Track customer objectives, technical achievements, and success plans.
* Ensure timely execution of agreed actions and commitments.


**Risk Management**
* Identify technical risks before they impact business outcomes.
* Develop mitigation plans and coordinate resources across Adobe teams.
* Support executive communications during critical situations when needed.


****Required Experience****
**What We're Looking For**
* Experience working in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Consulting, Solution Architecture, Professional Services, Technical Support, or a related customer-facing technology role.
* Experience managing enterprise customer relationships.
* Strong understanding of SaaS, cloud technologies, digital platforms, or enterprise software.
* Excellent communication and collaborator management skills.
* Ability to understand both business objectives and technical requirements.
* Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and coordinating multiple collaborators.


****Preferred Qualifications****
* Experience with digital marketing, customer experience platforms, analytics, personalization, ecommerce, or marketing technology ecosystems.
* Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud solutions.
* Knowledge of web technologies, APIs, integrations, data flows, and cloud architectures.
* Experience presenting to executive and senior leadership audiences.
* Project or programme management experience.
* Industry insight relevant to the customer’s sector, with the ability to translate market and technology trends into practical recommendations.


**Success in This Role**
* Build executive presence and trusted advisor relationships.
* Proactively identify risks and opportunities before customers do.
* Coordinate complex technical initiatives with confidence.
* Balance technical depth with strong business insight.
* Drive measurable customer outcomes while maintaining high customer satisfaction.
* Partner effectively across global and regional Adobe teams.


 This role sits within Adobe’s Technical Account Manager / Director (TAM/TAD) career framework, offering a clear path for growth as your scope and customer portfolio expand
   

  

 As our many awards will tell you, at Adobe you’ll be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. You’ll be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where ongoing feedback flows freely. If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog, https://blog.adobe.com/en/topics/adobe-life and explore the fantastic benefits we offer at Rewards.adobe.com.

title: Software Developer - Energy Management Systems
description:
*Do you want to write backend code that actually matters - powering energy efficiency for thousands of buildings across Europe? Are you a solid Java developer who thrives in a collaborative team, takes ownership of your work, and is excited by the idea of building scalable systems on Azure and Kubernetes that drive real sustainability impact?*
*Then you might be the Backend Developer our Mestro team in Stockholm is looking for!*
 We craft the vertical software of tomorrow, bringing sustainable impact to customers and society. At Mestro, we combine data-driven innovation with a genuine passion for energy efficiency and sustainability. As part of EG Group, we are a dedicated team of innovators and problem solvers who take responsibility for our contribution to our customers, each other, and the society we live in.
   

  

 We are now looking for a Backend Developer to join our Stockholm office on a 12-month fixed-term contract, contributing to the continued development of Mestro.
   

  

**Your Tasks: Develop, Deploy, and Drive Backend Excellence**
 As a Backend Developer, you will be part of the team that designs, develops, and maintains the backend systems powering the Mestro platform. You will work closely with product owners, architects, and frontend developers to deliver technical solutions aligned with business goals.
   

  

**You Will**
* Develop and maintain backend services for the Mestro platform.
* Contribute to architectural and technical discussions and decisions.
* Deploy, monitor, and maintain applications in Azure and Kubernetes environments.
* Write clean, well-tested code and participate in code reviews.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to refine requirements and ensure quality delivery.
* Share knowledge and support colleagues in their development.


**Your Profile: A Solid Backend Developer Who Takes Ownership**
 You are a solid backend developer who enjoys working in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. You write clean code, take ownership of your work, and are eager to keep learning.
   

  

**You Are The Ideal Candidate If You**
* Have 3–5 years of professional experience in backend development.
* Have good knowledge of Java, MS SQL, and Azure.
* Have Experience working with Kubernetes.
* Have Solid understanding of object-oriented programming and modern software architecture.
* Are Comfortable participating in code reviews.
* Have Good communication skills in English.


**Nice To Have**
* Experience with microservice architectures.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Background in energy management or data analytics domains.


**What Can You Expect from Us?**
* A product with real purpose - Mestro helps buildings across Europe reduce energy waste, so your code has tangible impact.
* A small, skilled team where your voice matters - you'll influence technical decisions, not just execute tickets.
* A modern tech stack: Java, Azure, Kubernetes, MS SQL.
* Autonomy with support - we trust you to own your work, and we've got your back when you need it.
* An office in Stockholm with a collaborative, low-ego culture.
* The stability and resources of EG Group behind a product team that still moves fast.
* Opportunities to grow - whether that's deeper into architecture, DevOps, or domain expertise in energy management.


**We look forward to hearing from you!**
 If you are interested in learning more before you apply, please contact Senior Manager Jimmy Persson jiper@eg.se or on +46 702 99 10 49. We review applications on an ongoing basis and will hire once the right candidate is found, so please send your CV and application as soon as possible. All inquiries are handled confidentially.
   

  

**At EG, we build software that makes a difference.**
 Our industry-specific software help people and businesses work smarter every day. From doctors spending more time with patients to builders running safer, more efficient projects.
   

  

 Our software is built by peers from the industry and backed by EG’s scale for stability, innovation, and security.
   

  

 If you’re ambitious, curious, and take pride in ownership, you’ll thrive here. You’ll be trusted to grow your skills, shape meaningful solutions, and make an impact together with talented colleagues across borders.
   

  

 Join us in creating software that works for people - not software that makes people work.

title: Senior Consultant Dynamics 365 Business Central Finance
description:
*Har du erfarenhet som konsult inom Business Central Finance? Vill du ha en central roll på ett framgångsrikt, modernt och innovativt företag? Ser du precis som vi enorma möjligheter för D365 Business Central och vill vara med och arbeta med marknadens bästa erbjudande för våra kunder? Då kan det här jobbet vara helt rätt för dig!*
**Väx inom Business Central på Accigo**
 Vi söker dig med erfarenhet inom finance-processer samt har arbetat med verksamhetsutveckling och digitalisering. I rollen kommer du att utveckla våra kunders affär genom att arbeta nära dem i deras affärsprocesser och bygga förtroende som konsult tillsammans med dina kollegor i teamet. Du kommer arbeta i stora och små projekt som omfattar alltifrån nya implementationer och uppgradering av Microsoft Dynamics Business Central, till löpande förbättringsarbete hos våra kunder. Våra kundrelationer är ofta långsiktiga, vilket innebär att du får följa kunder genom hela utvecklingsresan, från implementation och vidareutveckling till nästa steg i deras digitalisering.
   

  

 Just nu befinner vi oss i en spännande fas där vi fortsätter att utveckla vårt erbjudande, våra arbetssätt och teamet kring Business Central. Här kliver du inte in i en färdig organisation där allt redan är satt. Tvärtom får du möjlighet att påverka hur vi utvecklar erbjudandet, stärker teamet och tar nästa steg framåt.
   

  

 Vi söker inte bara fler konsulter. Vi söker personer som vill vara med och forma nästa kapitel för Business Central på Accigo. Samtidigt får du tillgång till specialistkompetens från hela Microsoft-ekosystemet och möjlighet att arbeta tillsammans med några av branschens främsta experter.
   

  

 Hos oss kommer du få möjlighet att påverka ditt eget arbete och att forma din roll..
   

  

**Vi vill att du har**
* Några års arbetslivserfarenhet inom Microsoft Dynamics Business Central eller NAV
* Erfarenhet av implementationer, uppgraderingar eller större förändringsprojekt
* Erfarenhet inom finansprocesser i Business Central
* God kommunikativ förmåga och vana att arbeta nära verksamhet och kund
* Erfarenhet av verksamhetsutveckling och att omsätta affärsbehov till systemstöd
* Förmåga att driva dialoger, workshops eller kravdiskussioner tillsammans med kunder
* Nyfikenhet på hur ny teknik, data och AI kan bidra till verksamhetsutveckling och affärsvärde
* Ett prestigelöst mindset, och trivs med att arbeta i team


**Meriterande**
* Innehar certifieringen Microsoft 365 Business Central Functional Consultant
* Erfarenhet av retail, e-handel, grossistverksamhet eller liknande branscher
* Erfarenhet av Power Platform, AI eller andra delar av Microsofts ekosystem
* Erfarenhet av processkartläggning, testning eller förändringsledning
* Tidigare erfarenhet av att arbeta i konsultrollen eller i andra kundnära uppdrag


 Teamet Business Central
   

  

 Teamet Business Central ingår i Accigos största affärsområde Business Applications där vi hjälper våra kunder att modernisera och utveckla verksamhetskritiska processer inom ekonomi, logistik och verksamhetsstyrning. Genom Microsoft Dynamics 365, data och AI skapar vi smartare arbetsflöden, bättre beslutsstöd och ökad effektivitet. Vi kombinerar affärsförståelse, teknik och innovation för att hjälpa organisationer att växa, anpassa sig och skapa långsiktigt affärsvärde.
   

  

 Vi utmärker oss med en unik företagskultur som värdesätter samarbete, innovation och personlig utveckling. Detta avspeglar sig hos både de medarbetare och kunder som väljer oss, vilket ger en dynamisk och rolig vardag. Vi kallar det Business Wellness.
   

  

 Accigo är en av få partners i Sverige med djup kompetens över hela Microsofts plattform (bl.a. Dynamics Partner of the Year 2024, CoPilot Jumpstart, Global AI Council etc) och kan skapa de mest innovativa och optimerade helhetslösningarna. Tillsammans med vårt systerbolag Centigo är vi en uppskattad strategisk partner för digitalt driven affärs- och verksamhetsutveckling och får naturligt en bra förankring i högsta ledningen hos våra kunder. På så sätt kan vi skapa förändring på riktigt.
   

  

 Kompensation och förmåner
   

  

 Vår förmånspolicy är utvecklad för att möta både dina professionella och personliga behov. I vårt omfattande förmånspaket ingår friskvårdsbidrag, tjänstepension och frivillig sjukvårdsförsäkring. Vår ersättningsmodell består av en konkurrenskraftig fast del och en rörlig del som ger dig möjlighet att påverka din lön baserat på din prestation och ambition. Vi erbjuder både professionell och personlig utveckling.
   

  

**Nyfiken?** 
 Vi svarar gärna på frågor, eller berättar mer om oss över en kaffe - du kan enkelt komma i kontakt med oss: amir.hosseini@accigo.se
   

  

 Läs gärna mer om oss och träffa våra medarbetare på vår karriärsida: https://karriar.accigo.se/
   

  

*Vi utvärderar ansökningar löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka din ansökan.*
 Accigo är ett konsultbolag som hjälper företag och organisationer med digital affärs- och verksamhetsutveckling med tekniken som möjliggörare. För oss handlar digitalisering till 90% om människor och 10% om teknik. Det är när samspelet mellan människa och teknik fungerar som digitaliseringens fulla styrka visar sig.
   

  

 För många handlar digitalisering mest om teknik. För oss är det så otroligt mycket större. Digitalisering kan få både människor och organisationer att våga sikta högre, följa sina drömmar och öppna dörrar som de inte ens visste fanns. Och när man ser igenom tekniken och börjar skönja vilka möjligheter som gömmer sig där bakom. Då ser man att framtiden kan vara en fantastisk plats – fylld av mänsklig energi och värme – och digitalisering är inget annat än vår superkraft för att komma dit.

title: Martech Director, Sweden
description:
**About The Job**
 At Impact Commerce, we are looking for a Martech Director to be our senior expert and trusted advisor in Data & Martech — the person clients want in the room, and the one our agency builds its credibility around.
   

  

 You will own the long-term vision for our Martech practice: standardising methodology and service offerings and driving innovation by integrating emerging technologies into our delivery model. You will identify market trends early so our offerings are adjusted proactively and stay ahead of competitor movements, working closely with our Managing Director, SE, and cross-functional teams.
   

  

**More specifically, in this role we expect you to have:**
**Client advisory & delivery**
* Define and execute data strategies aligned with client business objectives — martech stack selection and implementation, measurement frameworks, personalisation maturity.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for C-suite and VP-level stakeholders (CMO, CDO, CTO).
* Oversee delivery of complex technical projects across cross-functional teams, owning the quality and direction of deliverables.


**Commercial contribution**
* Define the value proposition for complex enterprise prospects and develop new business within existing accounts.
* Drive strong commercial engagement in both pre-sales and proposal development for Martech opportunities.
* Build long-term strategic relationships with enterprise clients.


**Thought leadership**
* Define and evolve IMPACT’s point of view on Data & Martech topics.
* Develop reusable frameworks, assessments, and methodologies the broader team can leverage.
* Raise the bar — mentoring senior consultants to build internal expertise and leadership capacity.


**Internal collaboration**
* Collaborate across practices (Commerce, Experience, Strategy) to create integrated cross-department solutions.
* Act as an internal expert resource on complex client challenges.

**Innovation and trends**

title: Technical sales specialist
description:
Vill du vara en del av landslaget i informationsteknologi?
 



  





 Våra kunders investeringar i nätverk, server- och lagringslösningar är verksamhetskritiska – och kräver supportavtal i världsklass. Nu söker vi på Atea en specialistsäljare inom Technical Services som vill arbeta med att sälja, förvalta och utveckla befintliga supportavtal. Tjänsten är placerad i Stockholm (Haga Norra)
 



  





 Se mer om kontoret i Solna här: https://www.atea.se/om-atea/vara-kontor/stockholm/
 



 Hos oss blir du en del av ett team som brinner för att bygga Sverige med IT, tar personligt ansvar och alltid sätter laget före jaget. Vi kallar oss stolt Landslaget i informationsteknologi.
 



  





**Din roll** 




 Som specialistsäljare inom Technical Services arbetar du främst med förvaltning och vidareutveckling av befintliga supportavtal, men även med viss nykundsförsäljning. I rollen har du ett tydligt Contract Manager-ansvar gentemot dina kunder, med kontinuerlig uppföljning och nära dialog.
 



  





 Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med:
 


* uppföljning och utveckling av supportavtal
* kostnadskalkylering och analyser
* upphandlingar och avtalsförhandlingar
* rådgivning och proaktiv dialog med kund



  





 Rollen kombinerar affärsmannaskap, struktur och detaljfokus med en rådgivande och relationsbyggande approach.
 



 Läs mer om serviceavtal och supporttjänster på hemsidan här: https://www.atea.se/mjukvara/serviceavtal/
 



  





**Vem är du?** 




 För att trivas hos oss behöver du gilla struktur, ha koll på detaljer och samtidigt drivas av att göra affärer. Du är lyhörd, relationsskapande och trygg i dialogen med kund. Har du dessutom ett intresse för siffror och analys – och gillar Excel och Power BI – är det ett stort plus.
 



  





 Du förstår värdet av att sälja helhet och effekt – inte bara enskilda produkter – och trivs i en roll där du får kombinera affärsmannaskap med långsiktigt kundvärde. Du gillar uppföljning och struktur, och är bekväm med att föra dialoger kring risk, SLA:er, kostnader och verksamhetens behov. Du motiveras av att agera rådgivare över tid och bygga förtroendefulla relationer, samtidigt som du är nyfiken på teknik utan att vara beroende av att vara den främsta experten.
 



  





 Vår bransch utvecklas snabbt, så vi ser gärna att du är nyfiken, orädd och vill lära nytt. Samtidigt är du aldrig ensam – vi stöttar varandra i teamet, har högt i tak och delar gärna med oss av kunskap och erfarenheter.
 



  





 Eftersom våra kunder finns över hela landet ingår resor i tjänsten.
 



  





**Vi tror att du känner igen dig i följande** 



* Du trivs i rollen som Trusted Advisor och arbetar proaktivt
* Du är lösningsorienterad och fungerar lika bra självständigt som i team
* Du är driven, noggrann och beredd att gräva djupt för att möta kundens behov
* Du skapar förtroende genom professionalitet, tydlighet och goda relationer



  





**För att lyckas i rollen som specialistsäljare tror vi att du har följande:** 



* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av B2B‑försäljning eller rådgivande roll inom IT/tech
* Teknisk förståelse inom IT‑infrastruktur och/eller IT‑tjänster (t.ex. nätverk, server, lagring, supportavtal)
* Erfarenhet av förhandling av avtal
* Vana vid kostnadskalkyler och affärsuppföljning
* Mycket god svenska och engelska i tal och skrift
* Mycket goda kunskaper i Excel



  





**Meriterande kompetens:** 



* Erfarenhet av publik sektor / LOU
* Erfarenhet av Contract Manager‑roll eller Trusted Advisor
* Power BI eller motsvarande analysverktyg



  





**Om Atea** 




 Visste du att Atea är den ledande leverantören av it-infrastruktur i Norden och Baltikum? I Sverige är vi runt 2700 medarbetare fördelade på 35 kontor runt om i hela landet. Vår styrka ligger i vår kombination av lokal närvaro, vårt omfattande och heltäckande erbjudande samt alla våra specialister. Tillsammans med våra kunder och partners bygger vi Sverige med it och förbättra vardagen för skolbarn, lärare, äldre, sjukvård och näringslivet. Hos oss får du vara en del av världens mest hållbara it-servicebolag, där vi är med och påskyndar omställningen mot en mer hållbar it-värld.
 



  





 På Atea blir du en del av en vardag och en kultur som präglas av framåtanda, laganda och humor. Vi har en vision om att vara "The Place to Be" – en plats där alla växer och trivs, med kollegor som bryr sig om dig, om kunderna och om samhället.
 



  





**Kontakt & mer information** 




 Välkommen med din ansökan! Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Carina Wildling, försäljningschef, via carina.wildling@atea.se. Vi hanterar ansökningar löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.
 



  





 Atea vill vara The Place To Be och därför värdesätter vi de kvalitéer som en jämn ålders- och könsfördelning samt etnisk och kulturell mångfald tillför verksamheten.
 



*Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!* 




  





*Atea har samlat it-branschens största hjärtan och snabbaste hjärnor. Vi finns över hela Sverige och har över 2500 kompetenta medarbetare inom alla områden. Specialister som vet vad som krävs för att skapa konkurrenskraft inom exportindustrin, specialister som vet hur it kan bidra med bättre lärande i skolan, specialister som vet hur lokala företag kan växa med it, specialister som vill vara med och skapa vård och omsorg i världsklass.*

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

* A natural leader obsessed with building the best technical team in the world

 : Build the most powerful ensemble of LLMs into lovable products.

 And always on the lookout for what's next!

title: Software Integration Engineer

title: Software Tester – Vehicle Integration Testing (SIL/HIL)

 , supporting the verification and validation of embedded electrical systems through

 testing. This role is ideal for a testing professional with a strong technical background, a passion for quality, and an analytical approach to problem-solving.
 



 The successful candidate will contribute to the full testing lifecycle, ensuring that complex embedded systems meet high standards of functionality, quality, and safety.

* Execute SIL/HIL tests for both new developments and existing functionalities.

* Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to ensure embedded systems meet quality and safety requirements.



  





 Qualifications
 


* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience in verification and validation (V&V) activities within embedded systems or related domains.
* Hands-on experience with software testing, fault analysis, and defect investigation.
* Proficiency in Python for test development, automation, or data analysis.
* ISTQB Certification (Foundation Level or higher).
* Strong analytical, communication, and teamwork skills, with a genuine interest in testing, technology, and continuous improvement.



  





 Preferred Qualifications
 


* Experience with SIL and/or HIL testing environments.
* Knowledge of complete vehicle integration testing processes.
* Experience working with electrical systems from an integration perspective.
* Experience within automotive, transportation, or embedded systems industries.
* Commercial driver's license for trucks is considered an advantage.



  





 Additional Information
 


* Focus Area: Complete Vehicle Integration Testing (SIL/HIL)

* Collaborative and technology-driven team environment.
* Opportunity to work with advanced embedded systems and contribute to high-quality, safety-critical solutions.

*Some of our clients require you to undergo and be approved according to our current security regulations. Certain positions may also require specific citizenship.*

 Astek has always been driven by a strong curiosity and a passion for technological possibilities.  We are a company where innovation, community, and professional growth are at the core. Here, you will have the opportunity to work on exciting and challenging projects in an environment where your expertise and ideas are valued. We offer:
 



 · An inspiring workplace where technology and creativity meet.
 



 · Opportunities to collaborate with leading industry players.
 



 · Professional development and career growth.
 



 · A company culture where we support each other and have fun together!
 



 · Great benefits, including 5,000 SEK in wellness allowance.
 



  





**We encourage all engineers to apply, regardless of gender, background, or life situation.**
