Memlist AB växer - ordentligt. År för år tar vi stora kliv framåt, får fler kunder, utvecklar fler funktioner och hanterar allt större mängder trafik och data. Nu söker vi en DevOps Engineer som vill vara med på nästa del av resan och bygga en teknisk plattform som är snabb, säker, stabil och redo att skala.
  
Hos oss får du inte bara förvalta en befintlig miljö. Du får vara med och påverka hur vi bygger, automatiserar, deployar och driftar våra tjänster framåt.
  
  

Om Memlist
  
Memlist AB, grundades 2014, ett svenskt techbolag som utvecklar moderna digitala lösningar för medlemsorganisationer, föreningar och andra verksamheter med höga krav på säkerhet, tillgänglighet och smidiga arbetsflöden.
  
Vi bygger vår produkt själva och gillar teknik som löser riktiga problem. När något går att automatisera vill vi automatisera det. När något kan göras snabbare, stabilare eller smartare vill vi förbättra det.
  
Och det händer mycket.
  
Vi växer kraftigt år för år och har höga ambitioner för framtiden. Det betyder fler kunder, mer data, mer trafik och nya tekniska utmaningar - vilket också gör DevOps till en allt viktigare del av vår organisation.
  
Nu söker vi dig som vill vara med och bygga infrastrukturen som gör den fortsatta tillväxten möjlig.
  
  

Rollen
  
Som DevOps Engineer hos Memlist arbetar du nära utveckling och produkt med att bygga och förbättra vår tekniska infrastruktur.
  
Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med automatisering, deployment, servrar, containers, övervakning, säkerhet och skalbarhet.
  
Vi vill att det ska vara enkelt att gå från kod till produktion - utan att kompromissa med stabilitet eller säkerhet.
  
  

**Du kommer bland annat att:**  

automatisera deployment, provisionering och återkommande driftuppgifter
  
arbeta med och vidareutveckla vår Linux-baserade infrastruktur
  
bygga och underhålla lösningar med Docker
  
skriva automation och verktyg i Bash och Python
  
arbeta med Ansible för konfiguration och automation
  
utveckla och optimera lösningar med Cloudflare Workers
  
förbättra CI/CD-flöden och våra interna utvecklarverktyg
  
arbeta med loggning, monitoring, prestanda och felsökning
  
bidra till hög tillgänglighet, säkerhet och skalbarhet
  
identifiera sådant som borde automatiseras - och sedan automatisera det
  
  

Vi söker dig som
  
Du är tekniskt nyfiken och gillar att förstå hur systemen faktiskt fungerar under huven. Du tycker om automation och ser manuella, repetitiva arbetsmoment som något som borde försvinna.
  
  

**Vi ser gärna att du har goda kunskaper inom:**  

DevOps arkitektur
  
I rollen kommer affärskritiska beslut att behöva tas, främst gällande automatisering, skalbarhet och säkerhet. Det är viktigt att du är bekväm med att dela med dig av tidigare erfarenheter och ett tekniskt know-how som förkortar resan till slutprodukt.
  
Linux
  
Du är bekväm i Linuxmiljö och har god förståelse för servrar, processer, nätverk, permissions och felsökning.
  
Bash
  
Du kan skriva scripts för automation, deployment och drift.
  
Python
  
Du kan använda Python för att bygga interna verktyg och automatisera arbetsflöden.
  
Ansible
  
Du har erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code och automatiserad konfiguration.
  
Docker
  
Du förstår containers, images, networking, volumes och hur containerbaserade miljöer fungerar i produktion.
  
Cloudflare Workers
  
Du har erfarenhet av - eller ett stort intresse för - att bygga och drifta lösningar på Cloudflares edgeplattform.
  
Det är meriterande om du dessutom har erfarenhet av exempelvis CI/CD, databaser, observability, nätverk, säkerhet eller andra delar av modern webbinfrastruktur.
  
  

Språk
  
Eftersom vi arbetar på både svenska och engelska är flytande svenska och engelska ett krav, både i tal och skrift.
  
  

Så är det att jobba hos oss
  
Vi tror på korta beslutsvägar, stort eget ansvar och människor som får möjlighet att påverka på riktigt.
  
Hos Memlist blir du en del av ett bolag där teknik är en central del av verksamheten och där idéer snabbt kan gå från diskussion till implementation.
  
Vi sitter tillsammans på vårt kontor mitt i Gamla Stan i Stockholm. Vi tror på värdet av att arbeta nära varandra och rollen är därför kontorsbaserad.
  
  

**Du får bland annat:**  

friskvårdsbidrag
  
kontor i hjärtat av Stockholm
  
stort tekniskt inflytande där högt ansvar läggs på din kunskap och beslutsförmåga
  
  

Varför Memlist?
  
För att du kommer in i ett skede där mycket redan fungerar - men där ännu mer ska byggas.
  
Vi växer, produkten utvecklas snabbt och våra tekniska krav blir större för varje år. Det skapar ett läge där rätt DevOps-person kan göra enorm skillnad.
  
Du kommer inte att vara personen som bara håller servrarna vid liv.
  
Du kommer vara med och bygga den tekniska grunden för nästa fas av Memlist.
  
Låter det som något för dig?
  
Sök till Memlist och var med och bygg nästa generation av vår plattform.

title: Staff / Principal Design Engineer, Web
description:
TL;DR - We're seeking an exceptional Design Engineer who combines strong frontend engineering fundamentals with a sharp eye for craft to execute on our website. You’ll work closely with design and marketing to build world-class web content helping empower the next generation of creators and builders.

**Why Lovable?**
----------------


Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.


We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.


Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* 10+ years of years experience, shipping websites and landing pages users genuinely love
* Portfolio demonstrating landing pages and advanced web interactions (if you don’t have a portfolio of landing pages - check out our other roles)
* Ability to make smart trade-offs between speed and polish, knowing when to ship and when to refine
* Strong fundamental understanding of modern frontend systems - React architecture, state management, performance, accessibility, and scalable UI patterns
* Experience translating scrappy explorations into production-ready experiences
* Strong design sense with an eye for detail, accessibility, and usability
* Ideally - you push the boundaries of the web with technologies like WebGL

**What you’ll do**
------------------


In one sentence: Own and elevate landing pages and web experiences that help share Lovable with the world.

* Build landing pages that delight, also designing interactions or pairing closely with designers
* Implement web interactions in React/TypeScript with obsessive attention to performance, responsiveness, and cross-browser consistency
* Drive front-end execution - pioneering new interaction patterns, micro-animations, and delightful details that elevate the entire experience
* Collaborate with marketing, helping share Lovable with the world
* Explore and iterate on visual designs with designers, translating explorations into scalable, web-native implementations
* Build and maintain reusable components that enhance consistency while enabling creativity across both product and marketing
* Reinvent how teams build for the web

**Our tech stack**
------------------


We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:

* Frontend: React, Tailwind
* Backend: Golang and Rust
* Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Many LLM providers
* DevOps & Tooling: Github Actions, Grafana, OTEL, , infra-as-code (Terraform)


And always on the lookout for what's next!

**How we hire**
---------------

* Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call with recruiter.
* Show us some of your work you’re really proud of.
* Show us how you approach problems during several technical interviews, including a technical screening where we evaluate frontend engineering fundamentals at the same level we expect from Product Engineers.
* In some cases, we may opt to do paid, trial work.

**About your application**

* Please submit your application in English - it’s our company language so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join
* We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal
* For this role, we're prioritising candidates based in New York

title: Salesforce Field Service Architect & Tech Lead
description:
**Lead the Salesforce platform behind KEYTO Group's field operations. Drive architecture, lead the team, and build scalable solutions that support growth across multiple offices.**

### **About KEYTO Group**


KEYTO Group is building the leading technology-enabled platform for home services. Through our brands, we combine operational excellence with technology to create a seamless experience for customers and employees alike.


As we continue to grow, Salesforce plays a central role in supporting our field service operations. We're now looking for a Salesforce Tech Lead & Field Service Architect to help shape the future of one of our most business-critical platforms.

### **About the role**


As Salesforce Tech Lead & Field Service Architect, you will play a key role within Group IT, helping shape the future Salesforce landscape across KEYTO Group.


While the role works closely with Servly's field operations, the mission extends beyond a single business unit. You'll be responsible for designing and evolving a scalable Salesforce Field Service platform capable of supporting multiple offices, teams, and future growth across the Group.


This role combines technical leadership, architecture, and hands-on development. You'll own the technical direction of the platform, lead the development team, and ensure Salesforce continues to evolve in line with business needs.


A key part of the role is creating a Field Service architecture that balances standardisation with flexibility, allowing local variations to be managed through configuration rather than custom solutions.

### **What you'll do**

**Own the Salesforce platform**

* Define and drive the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for Salesforce
* Ensure the platform remains secure, scalable, maintainable, and aligned with business needs
* Evaluate and adopt new Salesforce and Field Service capabilities
* Establish architectural standards, governance, and best practices

**Lead Salesforce Field Service architecture**

* Own the end-to-end design of Salesforce Field Service (FSL)
* Design solutions covering work orders, service appointments, scheduling, dispatching, mobile workforce management, territories, and skills
* Build a configurable and scalable platform that works across multiple offices and business units
* Create reusable design patterns that simplify onboarding of new offices and future growth

**Drive development and delivery**

* Lead technical implementation projects from design through deployment
* Remain hands-on with Salesforce development and configuration
* Drive DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and release management
* Ensure high quality, performance, and maintainability across all deliveries

**Lead and develop the team**

* Coach and mentor developers, administrators, and consultants
* Foster collaboration, knowledge sharing, and technical excellence
* Support the team's growth through feedback and professional development

**Partner with the business**

* Work closely with stakeholders across KEYTO Group to understand business needs
* Translate requirements into scalable technical solutions
* Drive continuous improvement of CRM and field service processes
* Contribute to strategic initiatives that maximise platform value across the organisation

### **What we're looking for**

**Required**

* Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I and/or II
* 5+ years of Salesforce development experience
* Proven experience designing and implementing Salesforce Field Service (FSL)
* Experience with scheduling, dispatching, resource management, and mobile workforce solutions
* Experience with CI/CD, version control, automated testing, and DevOps practices
* Previous experience as a Tech Lead, Lead Developer, Architect, or Manager
* Strong communication skills in English

**Meriting**

* Salesforce Field Service Consultant certification
* Salesforce Administrator, Platform App Builder, Service Cloud Consultant, or Application Architect certifications
* Experience building shared platforms across multiple offices, brands, or business units
* Experience with integrations, APIs, and middleware solutions
* Swedish language skills

### **Who you are**

* A strong technical leader who enjoys taking ownership
* Strategic in your thinking but comfortable staying hands-on
* Analytical, solution-oriented, and pragmatic
* Able to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders
* Skilled at balancing standardisation with operational flexibility
* Passionate about building scalable platforms and helping teams succeed

### **Why join us?**


This is an opportunity to influence both technology strategy and business outcomes across KEYTO Group.


You'll take ownership of a business-critical Salesforce platform, lead a skilled team, and play a central role in creating a Field Service solution that supports growth, operational excellence, and continued innovation across the organisation.


If you're excited by the combination of architecture, leadership, hands-on development, and real business impact, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior systemarkitekt
description:
**Forma robusta och skalbara system i en komplex teknisk miljö. För dig som är senior systemarkitekt och vill kombinera djup teknisk kompetens med ett långsiktigt arkitekturansvar.**


Vill du arbeta i ett uppdrag där du får vara med och forma den tekniska riktningen för system som ska fungera och utvecklas över tid? Hos vår kund får du en central roll i att skapa en hållbar systemarkitektur och säkerställa att tekniska lösningar möter både verksamhetens behov och framtida krav.


Vi söker dig som har en gedigen bakgrund inom systemutveckling och som under flera år har arbetat med arkitektur i komplexa IT-miljöer. Du trivs nära tekniken, förstår hur olika delar av ett system hänger ihop och kan omsätta krav och behov till tydliga tekniska lösningar.

**Om rollen**
-------------


I uppdraget arbetar du nära både utvecklingsteam och verksamhet och ansvarar för att ta fram och vidareutveckla systemarkitekturen. Du blir en viktig länk mellan verksamhetens behov och den tekniska implementationen och bidrar till att arkitekturen är robust, skalbar och möjlig att vidareutveckla.


Du arbetar med tekniska vägval inom bland annat backend, integrationer, API:er och molnbaserade lösningar. En viktig del av rollen är att skapa tydliga arkitekturprinciper och stötta utvecklingsteamen i hur de omsätts i praktiken. Du följer lösningarna genom utvecklingen och bidrar till att tekniska beslut håller ihop både på systemnivå och över tid.

### **Vi söker dig som har**

* Flerårig erfarenhet inom systemutveckling och arkitekturroller
* Gedigen teknisk bakgrund inom systemutveckling
* Erfarenhet av backendutveckling och komplexa systemmiljöer
* Erfarenhet av molnbaserade lösningar, exempelvis AWS, Azure eller GCP
* Erfarenhet av mikrotjänstarkitektur, API-design och integrationsmönster
* Förmåga att omsätta verksamhetsbehov och tekniska krav till hållbar systemarkitektur
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta nära utvecklingsteam och stötta dem i tekniska vägval
* Förmåga att kommunicera tekniska lösningar med både tekniska och verksamhetsnära intressenter
* Obehindrad svenska i tal och skrift

### **Meriterande**

* Erfarenhet av säkerhetskritiska eller verksamhetskritiska system
* Erfarenhet från större organisationer med komplexa IT-miljöer
* Erfarenhet av moderna DevOps- och CI/CD-miljöer
* Erfarenhet från offentlig sektor eller samhällskritisk verksamhet


Du behöver inte kunna allt. Har du gedigen erfarenhet av systemutveckling och arkitektur vill vi gärna höra från dig.

**Därför Castra**
-----------------


Vi bygger medvetet inte det största konsultbolaget, utan det bästa. Hos Castra får du stor frihet att påverka ditt arbete, din utveckling och din framtid. Du blir en del av ett starkt nätverk av seniora kollegor och får stöd av engagerade ledare och en säljorganisation som arbetar för att hitta rätt uppdrag för dig.


Castra är entreprenörsdrivet med stora möjligheter att påverka bolagets utveckling genom bland annat delägarskap och olika projektgrupper. Vi är dessutom stolta över att återkommande ha blivit utsedda till en av Sveriges och Europas bästa arbetsplatser av Great Place to Work.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer

title: Embedded Software Verification Engineer – Husqvarna Group
description:
**Last date to apply:**


07 October 2026
Are you passionate about software quality, automation, and verification? Do you enjoy working closely with development teams while helping shape the next generation of robotic lawn mowers? Then this could be the opportunity for you.


At Husqvarna Robotics R&D, we develop autonomous robotic products used by customers around the world. Our robotic lawn mowers combine software, electronics, sensors, and mechanics, creating exciting technical challenges and opportunities for innovation.


You will be part of our Technology Development organization, working closely with specialist teams in areas such as Connectivity, Positioning, Vision, Navigation, Platform Software, and Embedded Verification.

**About the Role**


As an Embedded Software Verification Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality and reliability of software delivered across multiple robotic mower platforms. Working closely with software developers, architects, and system engineers, you will help verify that new functionality integrates seamlessly while core product capabilities continue to perform as expected.


The Embedded Verification team acts as a quality gate for software developed across several product platforms. Every day, the team verifies the latest software changes, ensuring that robotic mowers can be programmed, updated, connected, and continue to perform their core functions reliably.


The role offers a combination of automation, verification, troubleshooting, and hands-on engineering, making it ideal for someone who enjoys working with both software and physical test environments.


Your responsibilities will include:

* Developing and maintaining automated test suits, verification frameworks, DevOps, and Continuous Integration environments
* Operating and improving Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) test environments
* Monitoring nightly software builds and analyzing verification results across multiple product platforms
* Investigating failures, performing root cause analysis, and working closely with developers to resolve issues
* Planning and executing robotic mower field validation activities
* Using operational data and AI-assisted tools to continuously improve software quality and verification efficiency
* Supporting development teams with software quality assurance during new product development
* Driving improvements in automation, verification methods, and quality assurance processes

**Your profile**


You enjoy working close to both software and hardware and thrive in a collaborative environment where developers and verification engineers work together to solve technical challenges.


You are proactive, analytical, and comfortable building relationships across the organization to drive issues to resolution.


While automation and scripting are important parts of the role, you also enjoy working hands-on with physical test equipment, robotic mower platforms, and verification environments to understand the complete system.

**Required Qualifications**

* Master’s or Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
* 3+ years of experience in software verification, test automation, software quality assurance, or software validation
* Experience with Python scripting
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken

**Meritorious Qualifications**

* Experience working with Continuous Integration and Azure DevOps
* Experience with Linux-based development environments
* Knowledge of C and/or C++
* Experience with embedded software development, verification, or validation
* Experience working with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) environments and automated test systems
* Experience troubleshooting complex embedded systems and collaborating closely with software developers
* Experience from robotics, automotive, or other complex embedded products
* Ability to communicate in Swedish

**Location**  

Huskvarna. We believe the best ideas happen when we are connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.

**Your application**  

Please apply with CV and Cover Letter. We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. For more questions regarding the position please contact:


Hiring Manager: Rolf Janeke, rolf.janeke@husqvarnagroup.com. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact: Recruiter: Gorjana Dubovina,gorjana.dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com.

*Processing of personal data*


When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer. For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice.

**Winning Through Culture**  

We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.


Our culture is built on three core themes:

* Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
* Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
* Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference.


Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!


Learn more about our culture *here*.

title: Product Owner IAM
description:
Be part of Clavister's journey to secure the digital world. We are looking for a Product Owner with the leadership, product thinking and technical judgement to help a skilled team perform at its best. You will lead a cross-functional Java development team responsible for products across authentication, identity management and digital signing, turning customer needs, business priorities and technical direction into clear outcomes for the team.


Working closely with the Product Manager, you will actively contribute to the product vision and roadmap for our IAM portfolio. The Product Manager owns that direction; you make it actionable by owning the team backlog, creating clarity and guiding delivery. You will be supported by experienced stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Architecture and Security.

### **About Clavister**


Clavister is a European cybersecurity company founded in 1997 and headquartered in Örnsköldsvik. We develop cybersecurity solutions across network security, identity and access management, cloud security, machine learning and AI.


Our solutions support customers in the public sector, critical infrastructure, defence and telecommunications. Together with our partners and distributors, Clavister hardware and software are deployed in more than 100 countries.

### **The role**


This role brings product ownership, people leadership and engineering delivery together. Your ability to lead, create focus, develop people and build an effective team is more important than being an IAM specialist.


You should be comfortable working in the IAM domain, learning its concepts and discussing Java or a comparable enterprise backend ecosystem, as well as architecture, integrations, quality and engineering trade-offs with developers, architects and product stakeholders.


The portfolio spans established on-premises products with multiple supported versions as well as SaaS offerings, requiring sound judgement when balancing product development and technical debt.

### **Key responsibilities**

* Lead and develop a cross-functional Java product team, with responsibility for people leadership, competence development, team effectiveness and delivery practices, including constructive feedback and support for learning and professional development.
* Actively contribute customer, delivery and team perspectives to the product vision and roadmap owned by the Product Manager.
* Own and prioritise the team backlog in line with the agreed product direction, customer needs, security requirements and available capacity.
* Translate roadmap objectives into clear outcomes, requirements and acceptance criteria for authentication, identity and signing products.
* Work with Java engineers, architects and IAM domain stakeholders on system design, APIs, integrations and architectural evolution.
* Balance new capabilities and technical debt with cybersecurity, privacy, trust, quality, usability, scalability and long-term maintainability.
* Drive delivery from refinement and planning through development, automated testing and operational follow-up.
* Promote modern engineering practices, including CI/CD, DevOps, observability, code review and test automation.
* Recruit, coach and mentor team members, creating an environment where people feel trusted and supported, are comfortable asking questions and challenging ideas, and actively share and preserve critical knowledge.
* Coordinate dependencies, risks and expectations across Product, Technology, Architecture, Security and other stakeholders, drawing on their IAM expertise when needed.

### **What success looks like in this role**

* The team understands what to deliver, why it matters and how success will be measured.
* Product and roadmap priorities are translated into a clear, realistic and well-managed backlog.
* The team delivers secure, reliable and maintainable Java-based products with predictable quality and flow.
* Product, engineering, security and IAM domain decisions are made collaboratively, with the right specialists involved and clear ownership maintained.
* Team members grow, take responsibility and contribute to a healthy engineering culture.

### **To thrive in this role we believe you have**

* Proven experience leading and developing commercial product software teams, with a strong focus on people, performance, collaboration and delivery.
* Experience with product ownership, backlog management and agile delivery for software products.
* A hands-on background in software engineering or architecture.
* Enough technical understanding to engage confidently with Java developers and architects, supported by experience from Java or a comparable enterprise backend ecosystem.
* Experience collaborating with Product Managers and multiple stakeholders on product discovery, priorities, vision and roadmap development.
* Comfort working in the IAM domain and the curiosity to learn authentication, identity and signing concepts with support from domain specialists.
* Knowledge of secure software development, privacy and vulnerability management.
* Strong communication, coaching, stakeholder management, problem-solving and change leadership skills.
* Fluent English, both written and spoken.

### **Extra points for**

* Previous experience from identity and access management, authentication, digital identity or electronic signing.
* Familiarity with IAM integrations, APIs, federation, identity lifecycle processes or trust services.
* A background in software engineering or architecture in Java, or a comparable enterprise backend ecosystem.
* Experience as a Scrum Master or in a similar role facilitating agile software teams.

### **What we offer**

* Meaningful work in a European cybersecurity company where IAM is a key component of zero-trust security and our products help organisations protect identities, control access and enable trusted digital interactions.
* The opportunity to lead and develop a brilliant Java engineering team delivering products across authentication, identity and signing.
* A collaborative and inclusive environment with close cooperation across Product, Technology and Security.
* Professional development, training and opportunities to grow your leadership career.
* Flexible working arrangements and a supportive team culture.
* Competitive salary and benefits.

### **Join us**


If you enjoy leading people, creating product clarity and bringing stakeholders together around effective delivery, we would like to hear from you. Apply and help us develop the next generation of secure authentication, identity and digital signing products.


We review applications and interview qualified candidates continuously.

title: DevOps Engineer till Handelsbanken
description:
Vill du vara med och driva automationen framåt i en av Sveriges största IT-miljöer? Vi söker nu en senior DevOps Engineer som vill ta en central roll i utvecklingen av Handelsbankens Ansible Automation Platform. Här får du kombinera djup teknisk kompetens med möjligheten att påverka hur automation används och utvecklas i hela banken.
   

  

**Ditt team**
 Du blir en del av Team Nova, ett specialistteam inom Development Platform som ansvarar för bankens centrala Ansible Automation Platform. Teamet består av erfarna specialister med djup kompetens inom automation, Linux och plattformsutveckling.
   

  

 Tillsammans utvecklar, förvaltar och driver vi bankens automationsförmåga framåt. Plattformen används både för intern automatisering och av utvecklings- och teknikteam som vill automatisera allt från serverprovisionering till applikationsdriftsättning.
   

  

 Vi är en del av tåget DEVX, där flera team tillsammans utvecklar och förvaltar bankens interna utvecklingsplattform. Vårt uppdrag är att ge utvecklingsteamen bästa möjliga förutsättningar att leverera säkra, standardiserade och effektiva lösningar, samtidigt som vi hjälper banken att ta nästa steg i sin automationsresa.
   

  

**Din roll**
 Som DevOps Engineer får du en nyckelroll i utvecklingen av bankens Ansible Automation Platform. Tillsammans med teamet ansvarar du för plattformens stabilitet, vidareutveckling och tekniska riktning, samtidigt som du aktivt identifierar nya områden där automation kan skapa värde för verksamheten.
   

  

 Rollen kombinerar plattformsansvar med ett konsultativt och utforskande perspektiv. Du arbetar nära utvecklingsteam, infrastrukturspecialister och andra intressenter för att förstå behov, omsätta idéer till lösningar och driva initiativ från idé till implementation och förvaltning.
   

  

 I rollen kommer du bland annat att:
   

  

* Förvalta och vidareutveckla bankens Ansible Automation Platform
* Utveckla nya automationslösningar och integrationsflöden
* Säkerställa stabil drift, uppgraderingar och livscykelhantering av plattformen
* Stötta team och verksamheter i deras automationsinitiativ
* Identifiera nya områden där automation kan effektivisera och skapa värde
* Bidra med rådgivning inom Ansible och Ansible Automation Platform


**Din profil**
 För att bli framgångsrik i rollen ser vi att du har:
   

  

* Flerårig erfarenhet av Linux-administration
* Flerårig erfarenhet av att arbeta med Ansible Automation Platform
* Goda kunskaper inom Git
* Erfarenhet av drift och utveckling i on-prem-miljöer
* Erfarenhet från större organisationer med höga krav på säkerhet, stabilitet och regelefterlevnad
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift


 Det är meriterande om du även har erfarenhet av att driva tekniska initiativ i större organisationer, arbete inom IT- och informationssäkerhet, plattformsarkitektur, utveckling av automationsstrategier eller arbete i Azure.
   

  

 För att trivas hos oss tror vi att du är en person som gärna lyfter blicken och ser nya möjligheter. Du är nyfiken på hur automation kan skapa värde och tar gärna initiativ till förbättringar, både i plattformen och i arbetssätten runt omkring. Samtidigt är du strukturerad och ansvarstagande, och ser till att det som påbörjas också blir genomfört. Du trivs i nära samarbete med andra, delar gärna med dig av din kompetens och uppskattar dialogen med användare och kollegor för att förstå behov och hitta de bästa lösningarna tillsammans.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan!**
 Som ett steg i Handelsbankens rekryteringsprocess krävs en godkänd bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat, utförd av en extern part, innan anställning kan ske.
   

  

 Handelsbanken är en del av Sveriges totalförsvar och som bank fyller vi en samhällsviktig funktion tillsammans med den finansiella sektorn. Rollen kan därför komma att omfattas av krigsplacering inom Handelsbanken.

title: DevOps Teamlead
description:
We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer / DevOps Team Lead for an assignment within a technically advanced software development environment focused on embedded systems.
   

  

 The DevOps team currently consists of three engineers and is responsible for developing, maintaining and continuously improving the organization’s software production environment, including development tools, infrastructure, CI/CD and automation solutions. The development environment supports both Linux and Android platforms and several engineering teams working across areas such as Embedded OS, Embedded Applications, SDK, FPGA and Production Software.
   

  

 This is a role for someone who wants to combine hands-on DevOps engineering with team leadership, taking responsibility for driving the team forward while remaining actively involved in the technical work.
   

  

**The Role**
 As Senior DevOps Engineer / DevOps Team Lead, you will play a central role in ensuring a stable, efficient and continuously evolving development environment.
   

  

 You will plan and prioritize the work of the DevOps team, coordinate activities across different stakeholders and contribute to the longer-term development of the DevOps function. At the same time, you will work hands-on with infrastructure, automation, CI/CD and internally managed systems and services.
   

  

**Your responsibilities will include:**
* Planning, prioritizing and driving the activities of the DevOps team.
* Working hands-on with DevOps, infrastructure, automation and software delivery.
* Developing and improving CI/CD pipelines, tools and development workflows.
* Ensuring operational stability and continuous improvement of internal systems and services.
* Driving initiatives related to automation, infrastructure and software delivery processes.
* Supporting and maintaining systems and services managed by the DevOps team.
* Collaborating closely with software and embedded development teams as well as global IT.
* Coordinating activities and technical initiatives across multiple stakeholders.
* Contributing to the strategic development of the DevOps function.
* Actively supporting the adoption and use of AI-assisted tools and development practices.


**Job requirements**
 We are looking for an experienced DevOps professional who is comfortable combining technical responsibility with leadership. You have worked in mature DevOps environments and are used to supporting complex software development organizations.
   

  

**To be successful in this role, we believe you have experience with:**
* Administration and support of Linux and macOS clients and servers within a software development environment.
* Python for scripting and automation.
* Development and support of cloud-based services and applications in AWS and/or Azure.
* Working in established and mature DevOps environments.
* Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery/Deployment (CI/CD), including methodologies, tools and best practices
* Integration and automation using REST APIs.
* Platforms and tools such as Bitbucket, Jenkins, Artifactory, GitLab and JIRA.
* Documentation of systems, processes, configurations and operational procedures.
* IP networking and basic network troubleshooting.
* Virtualized server environments.
* Issue management and ticketing systems.
* Practical use of AI tools and AI-assisted solutions as part of software development, including experience promoting or introducing AI-supported ways of working.
* You have previously worked in large and technically complex projects and are comfortable taking responsibility for both delivery and team coordination. Previous experience leading and developing a technical team is important for this assignment.


**Nice to Have**
 Experience with administration and operation of virtualized server environments based on VMware is considered particularly valuable.
   

  

**About You**
 You enjoy working at the intersection of technology and leadership. You are comfortable getting involved in technical challenges yourself while also providing structure, direction and support to the team.You are structured, proactive and collaborative, with the ability to coordinate different stakeholders and drive technical initiatives forward in a complex development environment.
   

  

**Application procedure**
 A Maandag® recruiter will assess your application as soon as possible to determine whether you are suitable for an open position.
   

  

**About the company** 
 If you are a good match, we would like to receive a CV in WORD format with motivation why you fit this assignment, your availability and any scheduled holidays.
   

  

 Why Maandag Nordic? With us, you’ll get the chance to really put your ideas into action. We offer a work environment where you can grow and learn through hands-on experience - trying things out, making mistakes, and improving.
   

  

 For more than 35 years, Maandag® has been at the forefront of empowering people and organisations. We not only help professionals get jobs, but also connect them with a future that matches their values, desires and ambitions. Because when people are truly in the right place, they can develop themselves, fulfil their dreams and go to work with fresh energy every day. The energy and power released in the process is a catalyst for growth for companies. We started in the Netherlands, but now we also help professionals and organisations in Belgium, Poland, Dubai and Sweden. Our extensive knowledge of different markets, coupled with our wide network, enables us to make perfect matches quickly.

title: Lead Project Leader - AI Governance & Technology Enablers (IAM, Network & Security)
description:
**Job ID: 6455**
 Lead Project Leader - AI Governance & Technology Enablers (IAM, Network & Security) (permanent position)
   

  

 Welcome to Group Technology, where we pride ourselves on engineering solutions and direct Nordea’s transformation by providing a holistic technological view and structured understanding of the bank, and its surrounding environment to enable the Customer Vision and the Business Strategy.
   

  

 Core Technology Change & Delivery is seeking an experienced Lead Project Leader to drive the delivery of critical technology capabilities enabling safe, scalable and compliant AI adoption across Nordea.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead a portfolio of interdependent initiatives spanning AI governance, Identity & Access Management, network connectivity and security. You will translate strategic AI ambitions into executable delivery plans, establish effective governance and coordinate dependencies across architecture, infrastructure, security, risk and business teams.
   

  

 You will play a key role in ensuring that foundational capabilities - including identity and privileged access, secure connectivity, network segmentation, platform controls and enterprise guardrails - are delivered in a coordinated, transparent and predictable manner.
   

  

 Nordea is a place where traditions meet tomorrow. We're not just a bank, we're a tech employer on a mission to evolve finance securely and responsibly. Together, we impact millions of people’s daily lives by ensuring they can access our solutions anytime, anywhere, while safeguarding their personal data and wealth. Join us in making an impact on the banking industry.
   

  

**About Our Team**
 Core Technology Change & Delivery team is responsible for the Project & Programme management, the delivery & execution and governance of our Change Initiatives to ensure we meet our commitments in adherence to our Core Tech Operating Model and according to Nordea Delivery Guide.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
**Main responsibilities in this role:**
* Lead end-to-end delivery of AI governance and technology-enabler initiatives across IAM, network and security domains.
* Establish and maintain integrated delivery plans covering scope, milestones, dependencies, resources, financials, risks and expected outcomes.
* Coordinate delivery across architecture, AI platform, IAM, network, security, cloud, risk, compliance and business teams.
* Translate AI platform and governance roadmaps into executable programmes and clearly sequenced delivery plans.
* Drive the implementation of foundational capabilities required for secure AI adoption, including identity federation, privileged access, connectivity, segmentation, platform security and enterprise guardrails.
* Establish governance frameworks, decision-making forums, controls and operating models supporting the adoption of emerging AI technologies.
* Facilitate governance and approval processes in line with internal policies, regulatory requirements and Nordea’s delivery framework.
* Proactively manage cross-domain dependencies, risks, issues and delivery constraints, escalating where required to maintain momentum and predictable execution.
* Drive alignment between enterprise architecture, security requirements, regulatory obligations and technology delivery roadmaps.
* Ensure operational readiness, including service ownership, support models, resilience, security controls and transition to operations.
* Provide senior stakeholders with concise, decision-oriented reporting on delivery status, financials, risks, dependencies and required actions.
* Promote a strong delivery culture based on ownership, transparency, collaboration and continuous improvement.


**Who You Are**
 This is the right role for you if: you are a collaborative, pragmatic and solution-oriented leader who can bring diverse stakeholders together, challenge constructively and create clarity in a complex delivery environment. You combine strong programme leadership with enough understanding of AI governance, identity, network and security principles to ask the right questions, manage dependencies and drive informed decisions.
   

  

**Your background and skills include:**
* Proven track record in leading complex cross-functional technology programmes.
* Strong experience coordinating initiatives spanning Identity & Access Management, Network, Security or enterprise governance functions.
* Experience establishing governance frameworks, controls and operating models supporting adoption of emerging technologies.
* Ability to manage complex dependency landscapes across infrastructure, security, architecture, risk and business stakeholders.
* Experience driving delivery of foundational technology capabilities required by strategic programmes and platforms.
* Strong understanding of security, regulatory and compliance considerations related to cloud and AI technologies.
* Experience facilitating governance forums and steering committees involving senior business and technology leaders.
* Ability to drive alignment between enterprise architecture, security requirements and technology delivery roadmaps.
* Strong understanding of identity, privileged access, connectivity, segmentation, platform security and risk management principles.
* Experience managing large-scale stakeholder ecosystems and influencing decisions across organisational boundaries.
* Very good financial and resource management skills.
* Very good analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Advanced presentation skills, especially PowerPoint and Excel.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent English skills, both spoken and written.
* Can-do attitude.


**It would be ideal if you also:**
* Have an interest in AI governance, AI platforms and emerging technology trends.
* Have experience working in highly regulated environments.
* Understand cloud platform operating models and enterprise security controls.
* Can translate strategic objectives into executable delivery plans and measurable outcomes.


**What We Offer**
 Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.
   

  

 People are driven by many different factors. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.
   

  

 A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.
   

  

 Our way of working - We believe in bringing people together and want our offices to remain a cornerstone of the company. Our offices are where we connect, collaborate, learn from one another and build our culture. Therefore, as a principle, we work mostly from the office.
   

  

 Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.
   

  

 If this sounds like you, get in touch!
   

  

**Next steps**
 Submit your application no later than 01/10/2026.
   

  

**The recruitment process consists of the following steps:**
* Preliminary CV selection
* Online interview with the hiring leader
* Background check


 We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.
   

  

 We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.
   

  

 We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.
   

  

 We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.
   

  

 We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.
   

  

 Studies show that members of underrepresented communities don’t apply for jobs unless they tick all the qualification boxes. If this is part of why you hesitate to apply, we would like you to reconsider and give it a chance. Maybe your profile fits our needs much better than you think.
   

  

**Only for candidates in Finland:**

title: ServiceNow Utvecklare
description:
*Vill du vara med och utveckla en modern ServiceNow-plattform som verkligen gör skillnad för verksamheten? Hos oss får du kombinera teknisk fördjupning med nära samarbete med beställare och användare i ett team som delar kunskap, stöttar varandra och vågar testa nytt. Här får du stort eget ansvar, möjlighet att påverka och utrymme att växa.*
**Om jobbet**
 I den här rollen blir du en central person i utvecklingen av vår ServiceNow-plattform. Du arbetar nära verksamheten för att omsätta behov till smarta, skalbara och säkra lösningar som stärker våra processer och stöttar affären. Du blir en del av ett framåtlutat och kompetent team bestående av utvecklare, business analyst, configuration manager, portal manager, produktägare och service portfolio manager – tillsammans driver ni plattformen framåt med fokus på stabilitet, användarvänlighet och ständig förbättring.
   

  

 Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat vara att:
   

  

* Ansvara för utveckling, anpassning och underhåll av ServiceNow-plattformen utifrån verksamhetens behov.
* Föra dialog med beställare och användare för att förstå behov, samla in krav och ta fram kravspecifikationer.
* Utveckla, konfigurera och implementera lösningar, applikationer, arbetsflöden och automatiseringar i ServiceNow.
* Ta fram underlag för prioritering av arbetsinsatser och löpande kommunicera status och progress till relevanta intressenter.
* Testa, verifiera och driftsätta nya lösningar så att de uppfyller krav och inte påverkar befintlig drift negativt.
* Felsöka, analysera och åtgärda incidenter och problem relaterade till plattformen för att säkerställa hög tillgänglighet.
* Implementera och underhålla integrationer mellan ServiceNow och andra system.
* Dokumentera förändringar, lösningar och processer på ett sätt som underlättar fortsatt utveckling och förvaltning.
* Säkerställa att utvecklingen följer interna riktlinjer, best practice och gällande säkerhetskrav.
* Bidra aktivt till kontinuerlig förbättring av både ServiceNow-plattformen och relaterade arbetsprocesser.


 Följande kommer göra dig framgångsrik i denna tjänst:
   

  

* Högskoleutbildning inom IT, datavetenskap eller liknande område, eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet.
* Några års erfarenhet av utveckling och konfigurering i ServiceNow eller liknande ITSM-plattformar.
* God förståelse för ITSM-processer och ramverk, exempelvis Incident, Problem och Change Management.
* Erfarenhet av integrationer mellan ServiceNow och andra system via API:er (REST/SOAP).
* Kunskap om skriptning i JavaScript och utveckling av automatiserade arbetsflöden i ServiceNow.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med arbetsflöden, automatiseringar och systemintegrationer.
* Vana vid att dokumentera tekniska lösningar och förändringar för framtida underhåll.


 Meriterande är även om du har:
   

  

* Certifiering inom ServiceNow, exempelvis ServiceNow Certified System Administrator.
* ServiceNow Certified Application Developer.
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (t.ex. ITSM, HR, CMDB, Discovery eller andra moduler).
* ITIL Foundation (gärna v3 eller v4).
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta i agila utvecklingsmetoder (t.ex. Scrum, Kanban).
* Erfarenhet av användarvänlig gränssnittsdesign (UI/UX) inom ServiceNow.
* Förmåga att analysera och optimera befintliga processer.
* Förståelse för informationssäkerhet och datahantering.
* Certifieringar inom relaterade områden, t.ex. integrationer, automatisering eller molnteknologier (Microsoft Azure, AWS eller Google Cloud).
* Tidigare erfarenhet av roller med kravhantering, teknisk problemlösning och nära samarbete med beställare/användare.


 Som person är du analytisk, nyfiken och trivs med att lösa komplexa problem på ett strukturerat och noggrant sätt. Du är kommunikativ och samarbetar gärna med både tekniska och icke-tekniska kollegor, samtidigt som du är självständig och tar ansvar för att driva ditt arbete framåt. Du har ett starkt servicefokus och god förståelse för användarnas behov, är flexibel och anpassningsbar när förutsättningar förändras och motiveras av att leverera resultat med hög kvalitet. Hos oss kommer du att trivas om du uppskattar självledarskap, gillar att lära dig nytt och vill utveckla din fulla potential i ett team där alla stöttar varandras utveckling.
   

  

**Kontaktpersoner**
 Rekryterande chef: Farhad.Tabari@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Forena: Jessica.loow@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Akademikerföreningen: Lisa-Maria.Carensjo@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

*Låter det spännande? Då vill vi veta mer om dig! Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag. Vi arbetar löpande med denna rekrytering och kan komma att tillsätta tjänsten innan sista ansökningsdag.*
**Observera att rekryteringsprocessen pågår under sommaren. På grund av semesterperioden kan återkoppling och handläggningstider vara något längre än vanligt. Vi tackar för ditt tålamod och ser fram emot din ansökan.**

 Digital & IT är hjärtat i Länsförsäkringsgruppens digitala utveckling. Vi driver den gemensamma digitala transformationen och levererar förstklassiga IT-lösningar, datadrivna insikter och innovativa digitala tjänster som skapar värde för hela verksamheten. Vårt uppdrag är att bygga en robust och framtidssäker IT-miljö – både på plats och i molnet – som möjliggör kundnära och effektiva affärer i hela gruppen.
   

  

 Hos oss möts teknik, affär och innovation. Vi arbetar tvärfunktionellt ute i verksamheten i agila team där utveckling, drift och strategi går hand i hand. Vi ansvarar för allt från IT-styrning, enterprisearkitektur och leverantörshantering till applikationsutveckling, cybersäkerhet och verksamhetsberedskap.

title: Senior Infrastrukturarkitekt
description:
Brinner du för modern IT-infrastruktur och vill vara med och forma framtidens tekniska plattform? Du arbetar nära verksamheten, service managers, tekniska specialister och andra arkitekter för att säkerställa att IT-lösningar utformas enligt verksamhetskrav, regulatoriska krav och etablerade arkitekturprinciper.
 



  





 Du kommer att ha en central roll i att skapa hållbara och effektiva infrastrukturlösningar samt bidra med teknisk rådgivning och beslutsunderlag i strategiska frågor.
 



  





*Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:*

 Vi söker dig som trivs i en roll där du får växla mellan helhetsperspektiv och tekniska detaljer. Du är kommunikativ, självgående och har lätt för att förklara komplexa tekniska lösningar för olika typer av målgrupper. Du uppskattar att arbeta i team där kunskapsdelning och samarbete är en naturlig del av vardagen.
 



  





 Du har tidigare erfarenhet inom infrastrukturområdet och ett genuint intresse för säkerhet, arkitektur och moderna IT-miljöer.
 



  





*Krav:* 



* Minst 8–10 års erfarenhet inom IT-infrastruktur, varav flera år i en ledande eller uttalad arkitektroll
* Djup teknisk kompetens inom komplexa infrastrukturlösningar och enterprise-miljöer
* Gedigen erfarenhet av att designa och implementera lösningar i större On-premises-, hybrid- och Cloud-miljöer
* Erfarenhet av strategiskt arkitekturarbete och tekniska vägval i större organisationer
* Mycket god förståelse för IT-säkerhet, regulatoriska krav och styrande ramverk
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att ta fram tekniska beslutsunderlag och driva arkitekturfrågor
* Van att kommunicera tekniska lösningar med både tekniska och verksamhetsnära intressenter
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift



  





 Uppdraget omfattas av försvarssekretess vilket sätter kvar på arbete på plats fem dagar i veckan. Säkerhetsprövningssamtal och bakgrundskontroll kommer att genomföras. Svenskt medborgarskap är ett krav.
 



  





**Vad vi erbjuder** 




 På Eccera får du de verktyg du behöver för att nå dina mål. Vi erbjuder alla våra konsulter kvalificerade utbildningar och certifieringar inom den senaste tekniken. Vi sätter stort värde på att våra medarbetare hela tiden ska fortsätta att utvecklas. Under din utveckling kommer vi matcha din kompetens mot rätt uppdrag i takt med att du avancerar.

We look forward to meeting you!

title: Simulation Platform & ML Engineer
description:
Turn cutting-edge simulation and ML research into software that engineers can actually use.
  
At GREEN14, we are building simulation technology for complex industrial processes. Our team combines multiphysics models, machine learning and experimental data to understand systems such as plasma reactors and high-temperature metallurgical processes.
  
We can build sophisticated models and fast surrogates. Now we want to turn that capability into robust software that can be used beyond our own research environment.
  
WHAT WE ARE BUILDING
  
GREEN14 started five years ago with a mission to develop emission-free production of critical raw materials using hydrogen plasma.
  
Today, we operate a full-scale plasma reactor in Stockholm. Alongside it, we have built capabilities in multiphysics simulation, AI and surrogate modelling.
  
Our ambition is to connect experiments, physics, simulation, surrogate models and optimization into a continuous learning process.
  
But a great model sitting in a research notebook is not a product. Models need data and pipelines. Experiments need to be reproducible. Software needs APIs. Models need to be tested and versioned. Computation needs to be fast and reliable.
  
That is where you come in.
  
YOUR ROLE
  
You will build the software and computational infrastructure connecting our physics, AI and experimental data.
  
You will work directly with scientists and engineers developing our models and turn research code into software other engineers can reliably use.
  
A typical problem might start with JAX code developed by a researcher. Your job is to ask:
  
How do we make this reliable, testable, reproducible, fast and usable by someone who did not write it?
  
You will have substantial ownership over the technical foundations of our simulation platform.
  
WHAT YOU WILL DO
  
  

Build backend architectures connecting sensor data, physics models, ML models and simulation workflows.
  
  

Turn JAX-based research code into maintainable, production-ready software.
  
  

Build pipelines connecting experimental data, simulation, surrogates and optimization.
  
  

Develop infrastructure for model training, evaluation and reproducibility.
  
  

Build APIs, packages and repositories for long-term production use.
  
  

Establish testing, CI/CD, versioning and monitoring for scientific software.
  
  

Identify computational bottlenecks and improve performance.
  
  

Contribute to deployment and cloud infrastructure as our products mature.
  
  

WHO YOU ARE
  
You have experience taking technically complex software from prototype to something other people can reliably use.
  
You might come from software engineering, ML engineering, scientific computing or data engineering.
  
  

**We are particularly interested in experience with:**  

Python and modern software engineering.
  
  

JAX or other numerical and ML frameworks.
  
  

Backend architectures and APIs.
  
  

Data pipelines and databases.
  
  

ML infrastructure and MLOps.
  
  

Testing, CI/CD and reproducible workflows.
  
  

Computationally intensive workloads.
  
  

Experience with Docker, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, GPU computing, FastAPI or ML tooling is useful. Experience with JAX, scientific computing or simulation software is particularly relevant.
  
We do not expect you to tick every box.
  
THE KIND OF PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR
  
You do not need to be a plasma physicist.
  
What matters is that you enjoy working at the boundary between scientific computing, machine learning and real-world software engineering.
  
You like understanding what researchers are trying to achieve, but your instinct is to turn clever prototypes into systems other people can depend on.
  
You care about architecture, performance and maintainability, but you also write code.
  
You should also be curious about the physical world behind the software. Our code represents real plasma, particles, materials and experiments.
  
WHY GREEN14
  
Many software engineers working in simulation never see the physical system their code represents.
  
Here, the reactor is downstairs.
  
Our engineers run experiments. Sensors generate data. Our simulation team compares results with models. The models improve. You build the infrastructure that makes that loop faster and more reliable.
  
Our ambition is broader than one reactor. We want to help engineers understand, optimize and scale complex high-temperature processes across industries.
  
HOW WE WORK
  
You will join a team of serious engineers and scientists who care about getting things right.
  
We are international, curious and direct. We challenge each other's thinking and change our minds when the data tells us to.
  
There is very little hierarchy. Good ideas matter more than titles.

title: Simulation Product Engineer
description:
Turn complex physics and AI into products engineers actually use. Bridge simulation, software and industrial processes to change how engineers understand and optimize production.
  
At GREEN14, we are building a new generation of simulation technology for complex industrial processes.
  
Our team combines multiphysics models, machine learning and experimental process data to understand systems such as plasma reactors and high-temperature metallurgical processes.
  
We can build sophisticated models and fast surrogates. But for that technology to matter outside a research environment, a process engineer needs to be able to use it.
  
That is where you come in.
  
WHAT WE ARE BUILDING
  
GREEN14 started five years ago with a mission to help Europe develop emission-free production of critical raw materials using hydrogen plasma.
  
Today, we operate a full-scale plasma reactor in Stockholm. Alongside it, we have built capabilities in multiphysics simulation, AI and surrogate modelling.
  
Our ambition is to connect experiments, physics, simulation, surrogate models and optimization into a continuous learning process, and make that capability accessible to the engineer actually running the process.
  
Imagine an engineer trying to understand why yield has changed, how temperature is distributed inside a reactor, what happens if gas flow increases, or which operating parameters could produce a desired output.
  
They should not need to understand our solver architecture or write Python. They should be able to explore the process.
  
That is the product we want you to help us build.
  
YOUR ROLE
  
You will sit between simulation, software, product and industrial process engineering.
  
You will own much of how engineers interact with our technology: how they change process parameters, run scenarios, inspect simulation results, compare operating conditions and use models to make better decisions.
  
That requires more than frontend engineering.
  
You need to understand what the simulation represents, what matters to the engineer using it and how complex physical behaviour can be presented in an intuitive way.
  
You will work directly with our simulation and AI researchers, process engineers and industrial partners. Your job is to connect those worlds.
  
WHAT YOU WILL DO
  
  

Build interactive software for simulation, visualization and industrial process analysis.
  
  

Turn complex simulation outputs into intuitive visualizations.
  
  

Build interfaces for manipulating parameters, running scenarios and comparing results.
  
  

Define workflows from process problem and inputs to simulation, exploration and decision-making.
  
  

Connect applications to simulation and ML backends through APIs.
  
  

Build reusable components and application architecture for different simulation products.
  
  

Work with our simulation team to understand the underlying physics and how it should be exposed to users.
  
  

Help turn internal research tools into software industrial engineers want to use.
  
  

WHO YOU ARE
  
You are a strong software engineer who cares about both technical quality and whether the software actually solves a problem.
  
  

**We are particularly interested in experience with:**  

React, TypeScript or a comparable modern stack.
  
  

Interactive and data-heavy applications.
  
  

Scientific, engineering or time-series visualization.
  
  

APIs and computational backends.
  
  

Application architecture and production software development.
  
  

Experience with Python, FastAPI, WebGL, Three.js, scientific visualization, Docker or cloud infrastructure is useful. Experience building software for engineering, scientific or industrial users is particularly valuable.
  
But technology is only part of the role.
  
THE KIND OF PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR
  
You do not need to be a plasma physicist, but you do need to want to understand the process.
  
If an engineer tells you that pressure drop suddenly increases after twenty minutes, your first instinct should not only be to ask how we visualize the data. You should want to understand why.
  
What changed? What does the model say? Which variables matter? What can the operator control?
  
You enjoy talking to scientists and process engineers and asking questions until you understand the real problem.
  
  

**Then you ask:**  

How do we turn everything we know into something this engineer can actually use?
  
That is the mindset we are looking for.
  
WHY GREEN14
  
Many software engineers building scientific products are several steps removed from the physical system their software represents.
  
Here, the reactor is downstairs.
  
You can talk to the person operating it, look at the experimental data, speak to the scientist modelling it and then build the software connecting those pieces.
  
Our current work is focused on plasma and high-temperature metallurgy, but our ambition is broader. We want to help engineers understand, optimize and scale complex industrial processes.
  
HOW WE WORK
  
You will join a team of serious engineers and scientists who care deeply about getting things right.
  
We are international, curious and direct. We challenge each other's thinking, share what we know and change our minds when the data tells us to.
  
There is very little hierarchy and no room for corporate politics. Good ideas matter more than titles.
  
We are ambitious, but low on ego. We help each other get better because the problems we are solving are genuinely hard.
  
We work hard, but flexibly, and value having a life outside work.
  
THE PRACTICAL STUFF
  
Compensation consists of salary and pension together with qualified employee stock options.
  
We are based at Sweden's leading technical university, close to central Stockholm. We want the people building our products close to the reactor, experiments and engineers using them.
  
If you want to turn sophisticated physics and AI into software that helps engineers make better decisions about real industrial processes, we would like to hear from you.
  
The position will remain open until we find the right person.

title: Senior Critical Environment Technician
description:
Overview
  
As a Senior Critical Environment Technician (CET) within Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) organisation, you will play a key role in maintaining the critical infrastructure that powers Microsoft’s global cloud platform.
  
This hands-on position involves operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting critical facility systems while working closely with vendors, site leadership, and technical teams. You will monitor equipment performance, perform preventative and corrective maintenance, respond to operational incidents, and help ensure the reliability, safety, and efficiency of datacentre operations. You will also share technical expertise and support the development of fellow technicians.
  
CO+I is the organisation behind Microsoft’s cloud services, including Azure, Office 365, Bing, Xbox, and OneDrive. Employees benefit from ongoing training, professional certifications, career development programmes, and opportunities to grow within one of the world’s largest cloud infrastructure organisations.
  
Microsoft operates more than 200 datacentres across 32 countries, supporting over 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses worldwide. Sustainability, innovation, and operational excellence are at the heart of our continued growth and success.
  
Our mission is to empower every person and organisation on the planet to achieve more. Guided by our values of respect, integrity, and accountability, we foster an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.
  
Responsibilities
  
Serve as a technical specialist within a critical environment discipline such as electrical, mechanical, controls, or generator systems.
  
Independently perform advanced operational and maintenance activities.
  
Inspect and monitor critical infrastructure, including HVAC, mechanical, electrical, and control systems, identifying and escalating abnormal conditions.
  
Use Computerised Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) to manage assets, maintenance activities, and work orders.
  
Lead or support onsite incident response activities and coordinate corrective actions to restore operations safely and efficiently.
  
Follow, develop, and enhance Emergency Operating Procedures (EOPs), Methods of Procedure (MOPs), and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  
Perform planned, predictive, and corrective maintenance on critical facility equipment.
  
Troubleshoot complex equipment, systems, subsystems, and components within your area of expertise.
  
Provide technical guidance and mentoring to less experienced technicians.
  
Maintain compliance with safety, security, Environmental Health & Safety (EH&S), and operational standards.
  
Promote a culture of operational excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  
Embody Microsoft’s culture and values in all aspects of work.
  
  

Qualifications
  
Required Qualifications
  
High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent, with significant experience in mission-critical environments such as datacentres, manufacturing facilities, healthcare organisations, pharmaceutical facilities, energy infrastructure, or similar operational settings; or equivalent practical experience.
  
Experience within a specialised technical discipline, including mechanical, electrical, controls, or a related field.
  
  

Security Requirements
  
Candidates must be able to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements, including:
  
Successful completion of the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter.
  
  

Preferred Qualifications
  
Extensive experience working in mission-critical facilities or critical infrastructure environments.
  
Associate’s Degree, technical trade certification, military training, or other relevant technical qualifications.
  
Advanced expertise in a specialised discipline with proven troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
  
Experience supporting high-availability environments and complex facility systems.
  
  

This role offers the opportunity to work on some of the world’s most advanced cloud infrastructure while expanding your technical expertise, developing leadership capabilities, and building a long-term career within Microsoft’s global Cloud Operations & Innovation organisation.
