title: Doctoral student in Electrical Engineering focusing on Applied Cryptography and Privacy
description:
Lund University was founded in 1666 and is repeatedly ranked among the world’s top universities. The University has around 46 000 students and 8 500 staff based in Lund, Helsingborg and Malmö. We are united in our efforts to understand, explain and improve our world and the human condition.

**Description of the workplace**
--------------------------------


The Secure and Networked Systems Division within the Department of Electrical and Information Technology works broadly with research within Cryptography, Computer Security, Wireless and Fixed Networks. The security group within the Division has around 20 members. The main research directions are Cryptography, Privacy and System Security for Connected Systems. The division runs several research projects through different large research collaboration platforms and arranges extensive workshops and seminar series, making the research at the division visible to larger audiences. Cross-disciplinary projects are formed through our research collaboration platforms and national and international research networks, contributing to a dynamic research environment.

**Being a doctoral student**
----------------------------


As a doctoral student, you are both admitted as a student and employed at Lund University.


As a doctoral student, you will be trained in a scientific approach. In short, you will be trained to think critically and analytically, to solve problems independently using the right methods and to develop an awareness of research ethics. In addition, you will have the opportunity to work on projects, to develop your leadership and pedagogical skills. Throughout your studies, you will be guided by supervisors. Doctoral studies end with a thesis and a doctoral degree.  

More about being a doctoral student at LTH on lth.se.

**Subject and project description**
-----------------------------------


Through the Wallenberg AI, Autonomous Systems and Software Program (WASP) we now offer a new doctoral student position in the field of Applied Cryptography and Privacy.
  

WASP is Sweden’s largest individual research program ever, a major national initiative for strategically motivated basic research, education and faculty recruitment. The program addresses research on artificial intelligence and autonomous systems acting in collaboration with humans, adapting to their environment through sensors, information and knowledge, and forming intelligent systems-of-systems.  

More about WASP (wasp-sweden.org).


The primary duties of the doctoral student positions are to perform research and teaching within the Applied Cryptography and Privacy area. The research is devoted to the broader area of privacy-preserving communication and computation outsourcing. Communication over the internet is susceptible to surveillance and censorship. Privacy preserving communication techniques (e.g., Tor, Nym, Snowflake) allow users to circumvent such surveillance and censorship. The research scope would include designing, analysing and implementing such systems; additionally, studying different attacks and countermeasures are expected to be part of the research method.


Privacy-preserving computation outsourcing allows users to outsource computation tasks to a cloud server without revealing to the server anything about the user data or even what kind of computations the user is performing. There are different techniques for such privacy-preserving computation outsourcing such as Trusted Execution Environment (e.g., Intel SGX) and Fully Homomorphic Encryption (TFHE, BGV). Furthermore, the specific functions/tasks can be subject to attacks, and identifying attacks and countermeasures is expected to be studied. The research method will be a combination of system studies, design, and experimental research.

**Work duties**
---------------


You will primarily devote yourself to your doctoral programme, which includes participation in research projects as well as third cycle courses, seminars and conferences.


The work duties include:

* Research in applied cryptography and privacy.
* Contributing to research projects.
* Taking doctoral students courses.
* The duties also include participation in teaching and other departmental work (however, a maximum of 20% of working hours).

**Qualifications**
------------------


To be eligible for admission and employment as a doctoral student, you must fulfil the requirements below.

**Admission requirements**
--------------------------


A person meets the general admission requirements for third-cycle courses and study programmes if the applicant:

* has been awarded a second-cycle qualification, or
* has satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second cycle, or
* has acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad.


A person meets the specific admission requirements for third cycle studies in Electrical Engineering if the applicant has:

* at least 60 second-cycle credits in subjects of relevance to Electrical Engineering, or
* a MSc in Engineering in Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Mathematics, Nanoengineering, Engineering Physics, or Information and Communication Engineering.

**Additional requirements**
---------------------------


In order to complete the doctoral programme in question, the following are also required:

* Good programming skills.
* Good ability to work independently and to formulate and tackle research problems.
* Good written and oral communication skills.
* Good ability to cooperate.
* Very good knowledge of English, spoken and written.

**Other qualifications**
------------------------


For the doctoral programme in question, the following are considered as other qualifications:

* Completed courses and/or master thesis work within Computer Security and/or Cryptology.
* Industrial experience.
* Documented software development skills.
* Documented teaching and communication skills.

**We offer**
------------


Lund University is a public authority which means that employees get particular benefits, generous annual leave and an advantageous occupational pension scheme.  

More about working at Lund University on lu.se.

**About the employment**
------------------------


The employment is a fixed-term employment at full time, starting as soon as possible by agreement, however no later than May 1, 2027.  

Third cycle studies at LTH consist of full-time studies for 4 years. In the case of teaching and other departmental duties, the employment is extended accordingly. Doctoral studentships are regulated in the Higher Education Ordinance (1993:100), chapter 5, 1-7 §§.  

More about terms of employment for doctoral students on Lund University’s Staffpages.

**How to apply**
----------------


Applications shall be written in English and include:

* CV and a cover letter stating the reasons why you are interested in the doctoral programme/ employment and in what way the research project corresponds to your interests and educational background.
* Copies of issued study certificates and/or awarded degree certificates. These must confirm that you meet the general and specific admission requirements for the doctoral programme and show that you have the subject knowledge required for the doctoral programme project.
* Other documents you wish to be considered (grade transcripts, contact information for your references, letters of recommendation, etc.)

  

We welcome your application.

**About the Faculty of Engineering**
------------------------------------

description:
**Regional IT Lead - Southern Europe**
--------------------------------------

  

  

TRATON Financial Services (TFS) is the captive financial arm of the TRATON Group. TFS provides financial services and solutions to all TRATON, Scania, MAN, International and Volkswagen Truck & Bus. Our service includes financing for customers, dealers, and distributors as well as insurance solutions. With presence in over 65 markets, we are already one of the most global actors in the financial services industry and are rapidly growing. Do you want to become a crucial part of this journey?
  

  

**Role Summary**  

  

As TRATON Financial Services continues to expand its global footprint, the IT organization must evolve alongside the business to ensure technology remains a strategic enabler across all markets. To support this growth, six IT Regional Lead positions will be introduced within the global IT organization, each reporting directly to the Chief Digital & Information Officer (CDIO). One of these roles will be responsible for the Northern Europe region. We are open to candidates located in Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Bulgaria and Romania. Please expect app. 20% of international travels.
  

  

Acting as the regional IT leader, the IT Regional Lead will provide functional leadership to local market IT teams, driving collaboration, alignment, and the adoption of best practices across the region. The role combines strategy, operations, stakeholder management, governance, cybersecurity, vendor oversight, and transformation delivery. This position will play a key part in identifying synergies, optimizing resources, and ensuring the effective delivery of IT initiatives in support of both regional and global business objectives.
  

  

**Job Responsibilities**  

  



* IT Strategy - Translate global IT strategy into regional execution plans aligned with business goals.
* Business Partnership - Act as the main IT partner for regional and market business leaders, ensuring technology supports growth, efficiency, and risk management.
* Governance - Ensure compliance with global policies, cybersecurity standards, regulatory requirements, and audit expectations.
* Budget & Cost Control - Oversee market IT budgets, cost optimization, forecasting, and investment prioritization.
* Transformation - Lead digitalization, automation, cloud adoption, system modernization, and process improvement initiatives.
* People Leadership – Steer market IT teams, capability development, performance, and succession planning.
* Risk & Security - Support markets in cyber resilience, business continuity, disaster recovery, access controls, and data protection.
* Vendor Management – Steer regional technology vendors, outsourcing partners, SLAs, contracts, and escalations.
* Change Management - Drive adoption of new tools, systems, processes, and operating models across the region.
**Who you are**

* 10-15 years of professional experience in a corporate environment, with a strong track record of delivering business and technology outcomes.
* University degree together with fluent English.
* Solid hands-on IT background, with expertise across IT operations, software solutions, and/or data processing environments.
* Recent experience supporting and executing global IT strategies and business transformations within group and/or matrix organization.
* Proven ability to drive change, solve complex challenges, and navigate dynamic business environments with a proactive mindset.
* Strong leadership and people management experience, including at least 3-5 years in a managerial role.
* Experience leading geographically dispersed and remote teams, fostering collaboration and alignment across multiple locations.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across business and IT functions.
* Demonstrated capability to identify synergies, promote best practices, and drive standardization across markets and regions.

We believe that different experiences and perspectives create a stronger workplace and better results. With office Hubs in Södertälje and Stockholm, as well as coworking spaces at Sergels Torg and Kungens Kurva, you will have the best preconditions to pick the best workplace for your activities.

title: Paid Social & Creative Specialist
description:
At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds.


We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for a **Paid Social & Creative Specialist** in our Stockholm office. This is a full-time position with a full-time on-site office policy. Are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change?  

  



### **The role**


You will join our Central Performance Marketing team, driving subscriber growth and profitability for Viaplay across our markets. You will own our paid social operations and help develop our approach to performance creatives, working closely with team specialists, local marketing teams, creative teams, our media agency and partners.


As the main point of contact for paid social and performance creatives, you will:


* Own paid social planning, activation and optimization across Meta, TikTok and Snapchat, including Viaplay Store (movie rentals and purchases).
* Analyse and report on CPA, ROI and subscriber growth, adjusting budgets and priorities with the team.
* Improve our creatives through audience insights and tests of messaging, formats and concepts.
* Own creative briefs and orders towards local marketing and creative teams, ensuring creatives meet our needs and are ready for launch.
* Manage and develop automated creative templates and dynamic creative optimization (DCO) workflows in Smartly.
* Work with our agency, partners and team specialists on campaign execution, tracking and new platform features.
### **What we’re looking for**


You combine strong paid social expertise with a good eye for creatives. You take ownership, collaborate well and turn insights into action, while managing multiple campaigns and deadlines.


We understand you may feel confident ticking certain boxes more than others, and we always keep an open mind in our recruitment process. To thrive in this role, we believe you bring:


* A bachelor’s degree in marketing, economics or similar.
* At least 4 years of hands-on paid social experience, with strong knowledge of Meta and experience with TikTok and/or Snapchat.
* Experience developing performance creatives, briefing creative teams and running creative tests.
* Hands-on experience with Smartly, including automated creative templates and DCO.
* Strong analytical skills, using campaign data to improve performance and guide budgets.
* Strong planning, stakeholder management and communication skills.
**It’s a bonus if you have:**


* An interest in sports and knowledge of the streaming or entertainment industry.
* Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud tools such as Photoshop, Premiere Pro and After Effects.
* A can-do attitude, sense of humour and the ability to work humbly with others.
### **What we offer you**


**We’ve got you covered!** 30days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift.
  

  

**Your wellbeing matters.** We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance.
  

  

**A safe space to grow and up-skill.** Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development.  

  

**Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do** . So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including series & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more.  

  



### **Hit play today**


If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position.
  

  

Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

title: Qlikutvecklare till Knowit i Göteborg
description:
**Skapa datadrivna lösningar som gör skillnad**


Är du en erfaren **Qlikutvecklare** som gillar att förvandla data till tydliga insikter och smartare beslut? Vill du kombinera **Qlik**, **Business Intelligence** och **Python** i lösningar som skapar konkret värde för verksamheten?


Till Knowit i **Göteborg** söker vi nu dig som vill arbeta med hela kedjan – från data och integration till visualisering, analys och användarvänliga dashboards. Här får du möjlighet att utvecklas tillsammans med andra specialister och arbeta med varierande kunder, verksamheter och tekniska utmaningar.

**Om rollen som Qlikutvecklare på Knowit**


Som Qlikutvecklare hos Knowit i Göteborg hjälper du våra kunder att få större nytta av sin data. Du arbetar med utveckling av moderna BI- och analyslösningar med Qlik som central plattform och blir en viktig länk mellan data, teknik och verksamhet.


Som konsult arbetar du nära våra kunder och behöver därför både förstå den tekniska lösningen och kunna omsätta verksamhetens behov till användbara och hållbara lösningar.

**Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter inkluderar:**

* Utveckla och vidareutveckla BI- och analyslösningar i **Qlik Sense**.
* Designa dashboards, visualiseringar och rapporter som gör komplex data lättare att förstå och använda.
* Arbeta med datamodellering, transformation, ETL/ELT och integration av data från olika källor.
* Utveckla och optimera Qlik-script, datamodeller och laddningsflöden med fokus på kvalitet och prestanda.
* Använda **Python** för exempelvis databehandling, automatisering, API-integrationer och analys.
* Samarbeta med verksamhet, data engineers, BI-specialister och andra utvecklare för att skapa lösningar som möter kundens behov.
* Bidra med din erfarenhet och samtidigt utforska nya möjligheter inom data, analytics, AI och automatisering.

**Vår teknikstack / verktyg och metoder**


I våra uppdrag varierar teknikerna beroende på kund och behov. Inom Qlik-ekosystemet kan du bland annat komma i kontakt med:

**Qlik & Business Intelligence:** Qlik Sense, Qlik Cloud Analytics, Qlik Application Automation, Qlik Reporting Service, Qlik NPrinting och QlikView.

**Data & integration:** Qlik Data Integration, Qlik Replicate, Qlik Compose, REST API, SQL, ETL/ELT och olika typer av databaser och datakällor.

**Utveckling & analys:** Python, SQL, Qlik Script och moderna arbetssätt för datamodellering och analys.

**Moln & plattform:** Beroende på uppdrag kan lösningarna kombineras med exempelvis Microsoft Azure, AWS eller andra moderna data- och molnplattformar.


Du behöver inte kunna varje teknik eller produkt i Qliks ekosystem. För oss är det viktigare att du har en stabil grund inom Qlik och **Business Intelligence**, förstår hur data hänger ihop och har nyfikenheten att fortsätta utvecklas.

**Vem söker vi?**


Vi söker dig som har arbetat några år som **Qlikutvecklare**, BI-utvecklare eller i en liknande roll och som känner dig trygg med att självständigt utveckla lösningar inom Qlik och Business Intelligence.


Du har god förståelse för datamodellering, datatransformation och visualisering och kan se helheten från datakälla till den insikt som möter användaren. Har du dessutom erfarenhet av **Python**, SQL, API, molnplattformar eller andra delar av en modern dataplattform ser vi det som ett stort plus.


För att trivas som konsult hos oss tror vi att du uppskattar variation och tycker om att lösa problem tillsammans med andra. Du är nyfiken på verksamheten bakom tekniken, gillar kunskapsutbyte och kan kommunicera tekniska lösningar på ett tydligt sätt.


Vi tror också att du vill fortsätta utvecklas. Kanske vill du fördjupa dig ytterligare inom Qlik, bli arkitekt, bredda dig mot data engineering eller utforska hur Python, AI och machine learning kan kombineras med traditionell Business Intelligence.

**Vad erbjuder Knowit i Göteborg?**


Hos Knowit blir du en del av en miljö där data, teknik och problemlösning står i centrum. Du får möjlighet att arbeta i varierande kunduppdrag och tillsammans med kollegor med olika specialistkompetenser inom bland annat BI, data, cloud, platform, AI och systemutveckling.


Vi tror på kunskapsdelning och på att människor utvecklas bäst när de får möjlighet att både använda sin befintliga kompetens och utforska nya områden. Därför vill vi skapa utrymme för dig att påverka din egen utveckling och vilka tekniska områden du vill fördjupa dig inom.


Samtidigt värdesätter vi flexibilitet, samarbete och en hållbar balans mellan arbete och privatliv.

**Vill du ta nästa steg som Qlikutvecklare i Göteborg?**


Oavsett om du redan är specialist inom Qlik eller vill kombinera din BI-erfarenhet med exempelvis **Python**, cloud och modern data engineering vill vi gärna lära känna dig.

**Välkommen med din ansökan till Knowit i Göteborg och bli en del av vårt team inom data och Business Intelligence!**

**Om Knowit**  

Knowit är ett nordiskt konsultbolag som hjälper företag, myndigheter och organisationer att lyckas i den digitala transformationen. Med expertis inom systemutveckling, AI, cybersäkerhet, molntjänster, digitala kundupplevelser och managementkonsulting utvecklar vi lösningar som bidrar till ett mer hållbart och mänskligt samhälle.


Vi är cirka 3 700 medarbetare och arbetar genom våra affärsområden Solutions, Experience, Connectivity, Insight och Products – främst i Norden, men även i Polen, Serbien och Tyskland.

title: Simulation Product Engineer
description:
Turn complex physics and AI into products engineers actually use. Bridge simulation, software and industrial processes to change how engineers understand and optimize production.


At GREEN14, we are building a new generation of simulation technology for complex industrial processes.


Our team combines multiphysics models, machine learning and experimental process data to understand systems such as plasma reactors and high-temperature metallurgical processes.


We can build sophisticated models and fast surrogates. But for that technology to matter outside a research environment, a process engineer needs to be able to use it.


That is where you come in.


WHAT WE ARE BUILDING


GREEN14 started five years ago with a mission to help Europe develop emission-free production of critical raw materials using hydrogen plasma.


Today, we operate a full-scale plasma reactor in Stockholm. Alongside it, we have built capabilities in multiphysics simulation, AI and surrogate modelling.


Our ambition is to connect experiments, physics, simulation, surrogate models and optimization into a continuous learning process, and make that capability accessible to the engineer actually running the process.


Imagine an engineer trying to understand why yield has changed, how temperature is distributed inside a reactor, what happens if gas flow increases, or which operating parameters could produce a desired output.


They should not need to understand our solver architecture or write Python. They should be able to explore the process.


That is the product we want you to help us build.


YOUR ROLE


You will sit between simulation, software, product and industrial process engineering.


You will own much of how engineers interact with our technology: how they change process parameters, run scenarios, inspect simulation results, compare operating conditions and use models to make better decisions.


That requires more than frontend engineering.


You need to understand what the simulation represents, what matters to the engineer using it and how complex physical behaviour can be presented in an intuitive way.


You will work directly with our simulation and AI researchers, process engineers and industrial partners. Your job is to connect those worlds.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

* Build interactive software for simulation, visualization and industrial process analysis.
* Turn complex simulation outputs into intuitive visualizations.
* Build interfaces for manipulating parameters, running scenarios and comparing results.
* Define workflows from process problem and inputs to simulation, exploration and decision-making.
* Connect applications to simulation and ML backends through APIs.
* Build reusable components and application architecture for different simulation products.
* Work with our simulation team to understand the underlying physics and how it should be exposed to users.
* Help turn internal research tools into software industrial engineers want to use.


WHO YOU ARE


You are a strong software engineer who cares about both technical quality and whether the software actually solves a problem.


We are particularly interested in experience with:

* React, TypeScript or a comparable modern stack.
* Interactive and data-heavy applications.
* Scientific, engineering or time-series visualization.
* APIs and computational backends.
* Application architecture and production software development.


Experience with Python, FastAPI, WebGL, Three.js, scientific visualization, Docker or cloud infrastructure is useful. Experience building software for engineering, scientific or industrial users is particularly valuable.


But technology is only part of the role.


THE KIND OF PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR


You do not need to be a plasma physicist, but you do need to want to understand the process.


If an engineer tells you that pressure drop suddenly increases after twenty minutes, your first instinct should not only be to ask how we visualize the data. You should want to understand why.


What changed? What does the model say? Which variables matter? What can the operator control?


You enjoy talking to scientists and process engineers and asking questions until you understand the real problem.


Then you ask:


How do we turn everything we know into something this engineer can actually use?


That is the mindset we are looking for.


WHY GREEN14


Many software engineers building scientific products are several steps removed from the physical system their software represents.


Here, the reactor is downstairs.


You can talk to the person operating it, look at the experimental data, speak to the scientist modelling it and then build the software connecting those pieces.


Our current work is focused on plasma and high-temperature metallurgy, but our ambition is broader. We want to help engineers understand, optimize and scale complex industrial processes.


HOW WE WORK


You will join a team of serious engineers and scientists who care deeply about getting things right.


We are international, curious and direct. We challenge each other's thinking, share what we know and change our minds when the data tells us to.


There is very little hierarchy and no room for corporate politics. Good ideas matter more than titles.


We are ambitious, but low on ego. We help each other get better because the problems we are solving are genuinely hard.


We work hard, but flexibly, and value having a life outside work.


THE PRACTICAL STUFF


Compensation consists of salary and pension together with qualified employee stock options.


We are based at Sweden's leading technical university, close to central Stockholm. We want the people building our products close to the reactor, experiments and engineers using them.


If you want to turn sophisticated physics and AI into software that helps engineers make better decisions about real industrial processes, we would like to hear from you.


The position will remain open until we find the right person.

title: Simulation Platform & ML Engineer
description:
Turn cutting-edge simulation and ML research into software that engineers can actually use.


At GREEN14, we are building simulation technology for complex industrial processes. Our team combines multiphysics models, machine learning and experimental data to understand systems such as plasma reactors and high-temperature metallurgical processes.


We can build sophisticated models and fast surrogates. Now we want to turn that capability into robust software that can be used beyond our own research environment.


WHAT WE ARE BUILDING


GREEN14 started five years ago with a mission to develop emission-free production of critical raw materials using hydrogen plasma.


Today, we operate a full-scale plasma reactor in Stockholm. Alongside it, we have built capabilities in multiphysics simulation, AI and surrogate modelling.


Our ambition is to connect experiments, physics, simulation, surrogate models and optimization into a continuous learning process.


But a great model sitting in a research notebook is not a product. Models need data and pipelines. Experiments need to be reproducible. Software needs APIs. Models need to be tested and versioned. Computation needs to be fast and reliable.


That is where you come in.


YOUR ROLE


You will build the software and computational infrastructure connecting our physics, AI and experimental data.


You will work directly with scientists and engineers developing our models and turn research code into software other engineers can reliably use.


A typical problem might start with JAX code developed by a researcher. Your job is to ask:


How do we make this reliable, testable, reproducible, fast and usable by someone who did not write it?


You will have substantial ownership over the technical foundations of our simulation platform.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

* Build backend architectures connecting sensor data, physics models, ML models and simulation workflows.
* Turn JAX-based research code into maintainable, production-ready software.
* Build pipelines connecting experimental data, simulation, surrogates and optimization.
* Develop infrastructure for model training, evaluation and reproducibility.
* Build APIs, packages and repositories for long-term production use.
* Establish testing, CI/CD, versioning and monitoring for scientific software.
* Identify computational bottlenecks and improve performance.
* Contribute to deployment and cloud infrastructure as our products mature.


WHO YOU ARE


You have experience taking technically complex software from prototype to something other people can reliably use.


You might come from software engineering, ML engineering, scientific computing or data engineering.


We are particularly interested in experience with:

* Python and modern software engineering.
* JAX or other numerical and ML frameworks.
* Backend architectures and APIs.
* Data pipelines and databases.
* ML infrastructure and MLOps.
* Testing, CI/CD and reproducible workflows.
* Computationally intensive workloads.


Experience with Docker, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, GPU computing, FastAPI or ML tooling is useful. Experience with JAX, scientific computing or simulation software is particularly relevant.


We do not expect you to tick every box.


THE KIND OF PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR


You do not need to be a plasma physicist.


What matters is that you enjoy working at the boundary between scientific computing, machine learning and real-world software engineering.


You like understanding what researchers are trying to achieve, but your instinct is to turn clever prototypes into systems other people can depend on.


You care about architecture, performance and maintainability, but you also write code.


You should also be curious about the physical world behind the software. Our code represents real plasma, particles, materials and experiments.


WHY GREEN14


Many software engineers working in simulation never see the physical system their code represents.


Here, the reactor is downstairs.


Our engineers run experiments. Sensors generate data. Our simulation team compares results with models. The models improve. You build the infrastructure that makes that loop faster and more reliable.


Our ambition is broader than one reactor. We want to help engineers understand, optimize and scale complex high-temperature processes across industries.


HOW WE WORK


You will join a team of serious engineers and scientists who care about getting things right.


We are international, curious and direct. We challenge each other's thinking and change our minds when the data tells us to.


There is very little hierarchy. Good ideas matter more than titles.


We are ambitious, but low on ego. We work hard, flexibly, and value having a life outside work.


THE PRACTICAL STUFF


Compensation consists of salary and pension together with qualified employee stock options.


We are based at Sweden's leading technical university, close to central Stockholm and our plasma reactor.


If you want to turn physics, AI and experimental data into software that could change how industrial processes are developed and optimized, we would like to hear from you.


The position will remain open until we find the right person.

title: FP&A Analytics Lead
description:
At Qred, we’re building the world's best bank for small businesses. Since launching 11 years ago, we’ve grown from startup to profitable fintech scale-up, now generating over 1 billion SEK in annual revenue and supporting 50,000+ entrepreneurs across Northern Europe. We combine smart technology, real data, and human judgment to make financing simple, fast, and fair. With bold growth plans and strong momentum across multiple markets, we’re now looking for a FP&A Analytics Lead for the next phase of growth.

##### **About the Role**


As the FP&A Analytics Lead, you will own the end-to-end data strategy, driver-based forecasting models, and team leadership for our FP&A domain. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex cloud data architecture and executive financial strategy, transforming granular transactional data into scalable lifetime value models and strategic business intelligence.

##### **Key responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor, and build a high-performing team of data analysts while owning the FP&A analytics roadmap.
* Architect and maintain rolling forecasting engines, vintage performance curves, and driver-based models for Group revenue.
* Write production-grade SQL and Python scripts to model financial and operational data in AWS Redshift.
* Standardize global data definitions and oversee executive BI scorecards in tools like PowerBI or AWS QuickSight.
* Partner with commercial, product, and operations teams to optimize unit economics, acquisition ROI, and cost-to-serve models.

##### **What we’re looking for**


You bring a structured, mission-oriented mindset and a passion for driving alignment across cross-functional teams. You thrive when translating complex financial datasets into clear strategic narratives, and you are motivated to build scalable frameworks that support rapid scaling in a regulated Fintech context.

##### **Qualifications**

* Several years of progressive experience within data analytics, financial control, or business intelligence, ideally within Fintech or digital banking.
* Demonstrated track record of leading, mentoring, or managing analytics professionals.
* Strong technical capability in SQL, Python, enterprise data warehouses (e.g., Redshift, Snowflake), and modern BI tools.
* Solid grasp of commercial unit economics (CAC, CLV, cohort payback) and core P&L mechanics.
* Degree in a quantitative field such as Engineering, Computer Science, Econometrics, Statistics, or Finance.

##### **Why Qred?**


This is the place to be if you’re looking for a place to grow. Qred is growing fast, and our Qredsters along with it. With a non-bureaucratic organization and delegated responsibilities, we make sure there’s a short path from idea to action. In addition to our great culture, you get to work with the latest cutting-edge techniques, full ownership, and last but not least a bunch of great competent colleagues to learn from!

##### **One Last Thing**


This is a full-time, permanent position based in our headquarters in Stockholm. We believe our culture thrives when we work together, which is why we have an office-first approach. To balance this with some flexibility, we have the option of working remotely one day per week. We review applications on a rolling basis and while the start date is flexible, the right candidate can join us immediately.

*Qred celebrates diversity and does not discriminate based on ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.*

title: Enterprise Sales Development Representative - Finnish Speaking
description:
OPENTEXT - THE INFORMATION COMPANY
  
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  

AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.
  
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  

Commercial Sales Development Representative (SDR)
  
  

**The Opportunity:**  

OpenText has developed global Centres of Excellence for Sales Development to support best-in-class cloud software technology and solutions.
  
You will be joining a social, high-performing team required to collaborate with peers to effectively attract and qualify prospects evaluating the purchase of OpenText solutions. The successful incumbent will be comfortable cold calling, cold emailing and engaging via social media and video. It is important that you have a strong understanding of B2B lead generation and business development.
  
If you are energetic, tech savvy, motivated and creative, this position will challenge and enhance your skillset. This is a quota-carrying role for career-minded individuals that offers a strong introduction and foundation for a future role in Sales, Pre-Sales, Solution Consultancy or Leadership within a global software organisation. You will receive best-in-class onboarding, continuous on-the-job coaching and personalised development to support your professional growth.
  
Commercial SDRs are responsible for partnering with Commercial Solution Sales Executives to develop a territory strategy for discovering, nurturing and qualifying pipeline within Enterprise Clients ( >$1B annual revenue). The focus of the role is to identify and engage whitespace opportunities, convert leads into Sales Qualified Opportunities, and contribute to pipeline growth and revenue generation.
  
Commercial SDRs are also responsible for working with their Sales and Solution Consultant teams to actively support and progress opportunities through the sales pipeline funnel.
  
Their prospecting activity is split between outbound, sales-led prospecting into targeted Enterprise Clients, and following up inbound leads generated from prospect and Client engagement activated by Global Campaigns and Regional Field Marketing. Success in this position is measured by qualified pipeline creation, pipeline acceleration and revenue, with activity-based metrics in place to achieve this outcome.
  
Outbound Prospecting
  
This role supports outbound activity including cold calling, emailing and social outreach into targeted Enterprise Clients and whitespace opportunities.
  
Works alongside Commercial Solution Sales Executives and Solution Sales Executives to engage prospective Clients and introduce OpenText solutions.
  
Inbound Lead Development
  
Responsible for following up and qualifying inbound leads generated through campaigns and marketing activity.
  
Builds understanding of Client needs and passes qualified opportunities to Commercial Solution Sales Executives.
  
Opportunity Progression
  
Supports early-stage opportunities in partnership with Commercial Solution Sales Executives, Solution Sales Executives and Solution Consultants.
  
Maintains engagement with prospects and helps move opportunities through the initial stages of the sales cycle.
  
Prospecting Activity
  
Builds Client relationships through consistent outreach activity across phone, email and social channels.
  
Identifies contacts and maintains accurate data using Salesforce and research tools.
  
All lead generation activity and progress is tracked and managed within Salesforce and Outreach using approved tools and processes. Commercial SDRs provide regular updates on activity and pipeline contribution.
  
Leads are qualified using defined criteria and aligned prospecting processes.
  
  

**What it takes to excel:**  

* Ability to achieve activity and performance targets.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to engage and build rapport with prospects.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Positive, proactive approach to prospecting and learning.
* Ability to adapt in a fast-paced environment.
* Good organisational and time management skills.
* Goal-oriented mindset with attention to detail.
* Willingness to learn and develop within a sales environment.
* Experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce is beneficial but not essential.


This role is ideal for individuals looking to develop expertise in Enterprise prospecting, whitespace Client development and pipeline generation while building a foundation for a future career in software sales.

Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.
  
If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact us athr@opentext.com. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

title: Qlikutvecklare till Knowit i Göteborg
description:
Skapa datadrivna lösningar som gör skillnad
  
Är du en erfaren Qlikutvecklare som gillar att förvandla data till tydliga insikter och smartare beslut? Vill du kombinera Qlik, Business Intelligence och Python i lösningar som skapar konkret värde för verksamheten?
  
Till Knowit i Göteborg söker vi nu dig som vill arbeta med hela kedjan – från data och integration till visualisering, analys och användarvänliga dashboards. Här får du möjlighet att utvecklas tillsammans med andra specialister och arbeta med varierande kunder, verksamheter och tekniska utmaningar.
  
Om rollen som Qlikutvecklare på Knowit
  
Som Qlikutvecklare hos Knowit i Göteborg hjälper du våra kunder att få större nytta av sin data. Du arbetar med utveckling av moderna BI- och analyslösningar med Qlik som central plattform och blir en viktig länk mellan data, teknik och verksamhet.
  
Som konsult arbetar du nära våra kunder och behöver därför både förstå den tekniska lösningen och kunna omsätta verksamhetens behov till användbara och hållbara lösningar.
  
  

**Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter inkluderar:**  

Utveckla och vidareutveckla BI- och analyslösningar i Qlik Sense.
  
  

Designa dashboards, visualiseringar och rapporter som gör komplex data lättare att förstå och använda.
  
  

Arbeta med datamodellering, transformation, ETL/ELT och integration av data från olika källor.
  
  

Utveckla och optimera Qlik-script, datamodeller och laddningsflöden med fokus på kvalitet och prestanda.
  
  

Använda Python för exempelvis databehandling, automatisering, API-integrationer och analys.
  
  

Samarbeta med verksamhet, data engineers, BI-specialister och andra utvecklare för att skapa lösningar som möter kundens behov.
  
  

Bidra med din erfarenhet och samtidigt utforska nya möjligheter inom data, analytics, AI och automatisering.
  
  

Vår teknikstack / verktyg och metoder
  
I våra uppdrag varierar teknikerna beroende på kund och behov. Inom Qlik-ekosystemet kan du bland annat komma i kontakt med:
  
**Qlik & Business Intelligence:** Qlik Sense, Qlik Cloud Analytics, Qlik Application Automation, Qlik Reporting Service, Qlik NPrinting och QlikView.
  
**Data & integration:** Qlik Data Integration, Qlik Replicate, Qlik Compose, REST API, SQL, ETL/ELT och olika typer av databaser och datakällor.
  
**Utveckling & analys:** Python, SQL, Qlik Script och moderna arbetssätt för datamodellering och analys.
  
**Moln & plattform:** Beroende på uppdrag kan lösningarna kombineras med exempelvis Microsoft Azure, AWS eller andra moderna data- och molnplattformar.
  
Du behöver inte kunna varje teknik eller produkt i Qliks ekosystem. För oss är det viktigare att du har en stabil grund inom Qlik och Business Intelligence, förstår hur data hänger ihop och har nyfikenheten att fortsätta utvecklas.
  
Vem söker vi?
  
Vi söker dig som har arbetat några år som Qlikutvecklare, BI-utvecklare eller i en liknande roll och som känner dig trygg med att självständigt utveckla lösningar inom Qlik och Business Intelligence.
  
Du har god förståelse för datamodellering, datatransformation och visualisering och kan se helheten från datakälla till den insikt som möter användaren. Har du dessutom erfarenhet av Python, SQL, API, molnplattformar eller andra delar av en modern dataplattform ser vi det som ett stort plus.
  
För att trivas som konsult hos oss tror vi att du uppskattar variation och tycker om att lösa problem tillsammans med andra. Du är nyfiken på verksamheten bakom tekniken, gillar kunskapsutbyte och kan kommunicera tekniska lösningar på ett tydligt sätt.
  
Vi tror också att du vill fortsätta utvecklas. Kanske vill du fördjupa dig ytterligare inom Qlik, bli arkitekt, bredda dig mot data engineering eller utforska hur Python, AI och machine learning kan kombineras med traditionell Business Intelligence.
  
Vad erbjuder Knowit i Göteborg?
  
Hos Knowit blir du en del av en miljö där data, teknik och problemlösning står i centrum. Du får möjlighet att arbeta i varierande kunduppdrag och tillsammans med kollegor med olika specialistkompetenser inom bland annat BI, data, cloud, platform, AI och systemutveckling.
  
Vi tror på kunskapsdelning och på att människor utvecklas bäst när de får möjlighet att både använda sin befintliga kompetens och utforska nya områden. Därför vill vi skapa utrymme för dig att påverka din egen utveckling och vilka tekniska områden du vill fördjupa dig inom.
  
Samtidigt värdesätter vi flexibilitet, samarbete och en hållbar balans mellan arbete och privatliv.
  
Vill du ta nästa steg som Qlikutvecklare i Göteborg?
  
Oavsett om du redan är specialist inom Qlik eller vill kombinera din BI-erfarenhet med exempelvis Python, cloud och modern data engineering vill vi gärna lära känna dig.
  
Välkommen med din ansökan till Knowit i Göteborg och bli en del av vårt team inom data och Business Intelligence!
  
  

Om Knowit Knowit är ett nordiskt konsultbolag som hjälper företag, myndigheter och organisationer att lyckas i den digitala transformationen. Med expertis inom systemutveckling, AI, cybersäkerhet, molntjänster, digitala kundupplevelser och managementkonsulting utvecklar vi lösningar som bidrar till ett mer hållbart och mänskligt samhälle.
  
Vi är cirka 3 700 medarbetare och arbetar genom våra affärsområden Solutions, Experience, Connectivity, Insight och Products – främst i Norden, men även i Polen, Serbien och Tyskland.
  
We don’t wait for the future. We build it.

title: Financial Controller
description:
**Empower, Connect, Evolve,** and **Inspire -** these are the values that drive us and make **BMI** a company where you can thrive and grow .


**Finance Controller Sweden**
=============================

**Are you interested in taking the next step in your career?**

**Passionate about helping us transform our organisation?**

**Are you open to working close to the business, hands on and with a strategic mindset?**

**This is an outstanding opportunity to help shape the future Nordic BMI business!**

BMI Group delivers truly innovative roofing and waterproofing systems, designed to transform the way people live and work. The roof is not just a shelter. It can be a power centre, a living space, a vertical garden, even a work of art - most importantly - it can be part of our sustainable life.


**The Role:**

As the Finance Controller for Sweden, you will safeguard the financial integrity of BMI Sweden legal entities and align financial operations with overarching business priorities. Serving as a trusted advisor to Senior Management, you will deliver actionable financial insights while ensuring complete adherence to all regulatory and statutory standards.


You will hold primary accountability for internal and external reporting quality, continuously refining systems and workflows to enable prompt data sharing that drives agile, informed business decisions.


Additionally, you will design, implement, and maintain robust accounting policies and financial controls, extending global governance across the broader BMI organization.


**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner closely with the Nordic MD, Nordic Finance Director, Central Finance, and GBS to lead end-to-end financial operations.
* Guide finance functions through organizational transformation, building robust, efficient processes backed by strong internal controls and compliance framework.
* Lead the execution of financial accounting, statutory reporting, technical accounting standards, and operational financial management.
* Direct oversight of all corporate accounts, maintaining accurate, compliant, and properly documented financial transactions.
* Manage and oversee the timely preparation of complete and accurate company financial statements.
* Deliver actionable financial analysis, insights, and reporting to key senior stakeholders on a regular schedule.
* Streamline accounting workflows and reduce month-end closing timelines to improve efficiency.
* Serve as the primary contact for technical accounting inquiries, external auditors, tax consultants, and regulatory bodies.
* Manage external audit processes, building strong relationships with audit partners and resolving all audit findings.
* Implement BMI Core technology and process standards while actively participating in finance governance.
* Strengthen shareholder relationships through collaborative engagement and clear reporting.

**Your Experience:**

* A relevant university degree in Economics, Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline is ideal.
* Proven track record in a comparable finance position, coupled with extensive experience in stakeholder management (a strong B2B background is preferred).
* Experience working within a mature finance organization that incorporates Global Business Services delivery.
* Deep expertise in accounting principles, financial analysis, local and IFRS standards, as well as Swedish tax regulations and accounting.
* Hands-on familiarity with SAP/S4HANA and SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) is highly desirable.

Strong proficiency in modern IT tools (especially Excel and Google Sheets) with comfort operating in a Nordic or international business environment.


**Your Skills:**

* Highly motivated, resilient and comfortable operating in ambiguity.
* Courageous – ability to partner and challenge in a healthy and respectful way, cultivating effective relationships and having empathy for others.
* Ability to build and maintain effective networks and relationships, both internally and externally and use these to inform organisational direction.
* Strong analytical ability to generate insights, business cases and investment decisions.
* The ability to explain complex financial information in a clear way.
* Fluency in Swedish alongside excellent command of English.
* Alignment with our core values and winning mindset: Empower, Connect, Evolve, and Inspire.

**We Offer:**

* Great development opportunities - You will have plenty of influence on how to develop both the job and the organisation.
* An informal work environment that values quality, competences and cooperation.
* Varying and challenging work tasks with a great degree of freedom.

**What you can expect**
=======================

We are designing and building a new organisation in order to become the leading product and service provider in its field of expertise. You become part of an exciting transformation process based on tradition, combining technical knowledge and strong brands with product and process innovation.


You will report to the Nordic Finance Director and you will be working out from our Swedish office in Malmö.


You will find excellent long term career development opportunities, a competitive salary and benefits package, as well as a continuous learning and development culture in a dynamic international environment.


*Are you interested? We will evaluate applications ongoing so please apply asap, latest application date is October 7, 2026. Please apply by sending your CV in English.*

*For more information about us and the role please contact Ingvild Solheim Bobek, Talent Acquisition Manager Nordic, +46 733 667585.*

*A career with BMI Group is more than just a job. We help you to find work you enjoy, to use your skills, and support you to become the best you can be. Working together we can achieve great things. Come and join us.*

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Our Company
  
  

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences! We’re passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.
  
  

We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours!
  
  

The Opportunity
  
  

At Adobe, we help the world's leading brands create exceptional customer experiences. As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to some of the largest and most strategic organisations across the Nordic region.
  
  

You will partner with customers to maximise the value of their Adobe Experience Cloud investment by driving technical readiness, solution adoption, operational excellence, and long-term business outcomes. Acting as an extension of the customer's team, you will provide proactive technical leadership, coordinate technical engagement activities, and help customers navigate complex digital transformation initiatives. As a champion for the customer, you will share personalised knowledge and business-critical insights across people, process, and technology, align Adobe teams on the customer’s behalf, and deliver consistent value across the entire customer journey.
  
  

What You'll Do
  
  

**As a Technical Account Manager, you will:**  

Build positive relationships with customer collaborators ranging from technical practitioners through to senior leadership.
  
Own the technical health of assigned customer accounts and proactively identify risks, opportunities, and optimisation recommendations.
  
Develop and maintain Technical Readiness Roadmaps aligned to customer priorities and business objectives.
  
Lead technical reviews including environment reviews, service reviews, release readiness discussions, and operational health assessments.
  
Coordinate milestone-based engagements such as implementations, migrations, upgrades, integrations, go-lives, and peak-event preparation.
  
Drive adoption of Adobe solutions through best-practice guidance, technical coaching, and use-case activation.
  
Partner with Customer Success Managers, Solution Consultants, Product teams, Support, Engineering, and Technical Account Directors to ensure successful customer outcomes.
  
Act as the customer's technical advocate within Adobe and facilitate appropriate management of blocking issues when required.
  
Deliver regular business and technical insights that demonstrate customer value and support renewal readiness.
  
Contribute to customer retention, growth, and long-term success through proactive engagement and careful planning.
  
Connect customers with the right Adobe resources — such as Professional Services or Integrated Services — when hands-on implementation, development, or deployment work is required.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
Technical Leadership
  
Provide strategic technical guidance across Adobe Experience Cloud solutions.
  
Assess customer environments and recommend improvements to performance, stability, governance, and scalability.
  
Support customers through major business events and digital initiatives.
  
  

Customer Success
  
Drive measurable customer outcomes through structured technical engagements.
  
Help customers realise value from existing investments and identify new opportunities for optimisation.
  
Maintain a deep understanding of customer business objectives and technical priorities.
  
  

Programme Management
  
Coordinate technical activities across multiple collaborators.
  
Track customer objectives, technical achievements, and success plans.
  
Ensure timely execution of agreed actions and commitments.
  
  

Risk Management
  
Identify technical risks before they impact business outcomes.
  
Develop mitigation plans and coordinate resources across Adobe teams.
  
Support executive communications during critical situations when needed.
  
  

What We're Looking For
  
  

Required Experience
  
Experience working in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Consulting, Solution Architecture, Professional Services, Technical Support, or a related customer-facing technology role.
  
Experience managing enterprise customer relationships.
  
Strong understanding of SaaS, cloud technologies, digital platforms, or enterprise software.
  
Excellent communication and collaborator management skills.
  
Ability to understand both business objectives and technical requirements.
  
Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and coordinating multiple collaborators.
  
  

Preferred Qualifications
  
Experience with digital marketing, customer experience platforms, analytics, personalization, ecommerce, or marketing technology ecosystems.
  
Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud solutions.
  
Knowledge of web technologies, APIs, integrations, data flows, and cloud architectures.
  
Experience presenting to executive and senior leadership audiences.
  
Project or programme management experience.
  
Industry insight relevant to the customer’s sector, with the ability to translate market and technology trends into practical recommendations.
  
  

Success in This Role
  
Build executive presence and trusted advisor relationships.
  
Proactively identify risks and opportunities before customers do.
  
Coordinate complex technical initiatives with confidence.
  
Balance technical depth with strong business insight.
  
Drive measurable customer outcomes while maintaining high customer satisfaction.
  
Partner effectively across global and regional Adobe teams.
  
This role sits within Adobe’s Technical Account Manager / Director (TAM/TAD) career framework, offering a clear path for growth as your scope and customer portfolio expand
  
  

As our many awards will tell you, at Adobe you’ll be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. You’ll be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where ongoing feedback flows freely. If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog , https://blog.adobe.com/en/topics/adobe-life and explore the fantastic benefits we offer at Rewards.adobe.com .
  
  

Adobe is an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race or colour , ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We know that when our employees feel appreciated and included, they can be more creative, innovative and successful. This is what it means to be Adobe For All.
  
  

We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours.
  
  

About Adobe
  
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

title: Bid manager - Tieto Caretech (m/f/d)
description:
Malmö, Sweden


* Full-time
* Sales and Business Development
* Hybrid
* Tieto Caretech

  
Job Description **At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide patients and end users with purposeful technology and product offerings that help them in their life. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.**

 **About us**


Through advanced, intuitive technology, Tieto Caretech reduces administrative work, improves decision-making, and strengthens safety and quality in health and social care. With the Lifecare software portfolio we enable health and social care professionals to focus  

on what matters most: people.


We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can be part of advancing societies through purposeful technology and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people.  



**About the role**


In the Welfare Sweden team we provide Lifecare software solutions and related services for Swedish municipalities within social services/family care, elderly care, disability care and municipal health care. Our team consists of professionals in sales, bid management, product management, consulting, implementation and customer success, and we deliver market-leading digital support for municipal welfare operations through close collaboration with customers and internal experts.  

  

We are now looking for a Bid Manager to our Welfare Sweden team to focus on public procurements, tenders and proposal work for Lifecare in the Swedish municipal sector. Your daily work consists of leading and coordinating bid processes, analysing procurement requirements, creating high-quality tender responses, securing input from subject matter experts, managing deadlines and ensuring that our proposals are clear, compliant and competitive. You'll work in close collaboration with sales managers, legal, product specialists, solution consultants, security experts, delivery teams and other key stakeholders across Tieto Caretech.

**In this role you will**

* Lead and coordinate tender and bid processes for Lifecare opportunities in the Swedish municipal welfare market.
* Analyse procurement documents, requirements and evaluation models to ensure compliant and competitive responses.
* Drive the bid timeline, coordinate contributors and secure input from sales, product, legal, security, delivery and consulting teams.
* Write, structure and quality assure proposal content, including descriptions of functionality, implementation, support, security, compliance and customer value.
* Contribute to continuously improving our bid material, reusable content, ways of working and understanding of the Swedish public procurement market.

 **We are looking for someone with**

* Experience from bid management, proposal management, public procurement, tender coordination or a similar commercial role.
* Strong ability to understand complex requirements and turn them into clear, structured and customer-oriented responses.
* Excellent writing and communication skills in Swedish and English.
* A structured way of working, with the ability to manage deadlines, stakeholders and several parallel activities.
* Experience in digital solutions that support municipal welfare area (social care/elderly care/disability care and municipal healthcare).

 **It would be beneficial if you also**

* Have experience from software, SaaS, IT solutions or business-critical systems for the public sector.
* Have knowledge of Swedish public procurement, LOU, GDPR, information security and the municipal welfare processes.
* Are familiar with social services/family care, elderly care, disability care, municipal healthcare
* Are familiar with the Lifecare portfolio from the municipal side

 **AI knowledge requirement**


AI literacy is expected for this role. You will be comfortable using approved AI tools to improve quality and productivity in everyday work (e.g., drafting, summarising, analysing, and automating routine tasks). You can write clear prompts/instructions, critically evaluate and validate AI outputs, and apply sound judgement when results are incomplete, biased, or incorrect. You understand and follow company policies and applicable legal/regulatory requirements for confidentiality, privacy, security, and responsible AI use (including not sharing sensitive data in unapproved tools).

 **What’s in it for you?**

With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing healthcare for all of us. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.


Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. For example, we host a ‘Keep Learning Week’ twice a year, a week where everyone at Tieto has the possibility to join different training courses in a truly global setting.

 **Could you be our new colleague?**


We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Kristoffer Ström (Kristoffer.strom@tieto.com).

*We perform background checks on all final candidates.*

*Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.*

  

Additional Information  

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.  

Diversity, equity and inclusion | Sustainability | Tieto

**Stay alert to recruitment scams:**  

* Tieto only communicates via **@tieto.com** email addresses.
* We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment.
* If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond — verify it via our official careers site.
* For more information visit Important Advisory Regarding Recruitment Fraud | Tieto Blog

  
We provide customers across different industries with mission-critical solutions through our specialized software businesses Tieto Caretech, Tieto Banktech and Tieto Indtech as well as Tieto Tech Consulting business.


Our around 14 000 talented vertical software, design, cloud and AI experts are dedicated to empowering our customers to succeed and innovate with latest technology.


Tieto’s annual revenue is approximately EUR 2 billion. The company’s shares are listed on the NASDAQ exchange in Helsinki and Stockholm, as well as on Oslo Børs.
