title: KRYPTOLOG TILL AVDELNINGEN FÖR KRYPTO OCH IT-SÄKERHET VID MUST
description:
**Vill du ha ett meningsfullt arbete och bidra till ett säkrare Sverige i en osäker värld? Sök dig i så fall till oss på Must! Vi behöver fler kryptologer som vill arbeta med de kryptosystem som skyddar Sveriges säkerhet.**
 Som kryptolog på avdelningen för krypto och IT-säkerhet arbetar du tillsammans med några av Sveriges främsta experter inom både kryptologi och IT-säkerhetsområdet i stort.
   

  

 Must är en kunskapsorganisation och vi lägger stor vikt vid att utbilda vår personal. Som kryptolog får du möjlighet att fördjupa och utbilda dig inom kryptologiområdet. Vi samarbetar aktivt med andra myndigheter samt med universitet och högskolor, i Sverige och utomlands.
   

  

**Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**
 Som kryptolog på Must arbetar du bland annat med att:
   

  

* ta fram och analysera kryptoalgoritmer och kryptoprotokoll
* kravställa och granska kryptosystem
* utveckla policyer, standarder och metoder inom kryptologiområdet
* bedriva kontinuerlig omvärldsbevakning.


 Arbetet bedrivs till stor del i projektform där du arbetar tillsammans med experter inom andra IT-säkerhetsrelaterade områden.
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
 Vi söker dig som:
   

  

* har en civilingenjörs- eller masterutbildning inom matematik, datalogi, teknisk fysik, eller angränsande ämne
* har goda kunskaper inom matematik, samt vissa kunskaper inom programmering
* är van vid att läsa vetenskaplig litteratur och teknisk dokumentation
* är van vid att skriva rapporter och vid att göra muntliga framställningar, på både svenska och engelska
* har en forskarutbildning inom ett för tjänsten relevant ämne alternativt har dokumenterad erfarenhet inom kryptologiområdet.


**Meriterande**
 Det är meriterande om du:
   

  

* har goda kunskaper inom programmering
* har tidigare erfarenhet av att arbeta med säkerhetskritiska system eller signalskyddssystem.


**Personliga egenskaper**
 Du är kunskapstörstig och har rätt bakgrund för att snabbt kunna sätta dig in alla aspekter av kryptologiområdet. Du är intresserad såväl av teoretisk kryptologi som av det praktiska hantverket. Du delar gärna med dig av dina kunskaper och erfarenheter till dina kollegor och gör det på ett bra sätt. Du är bra på att samarbeta med andra, samtidigt som du är drivande och tar ansvar för ditt eget arbete. Du har en god problemlösningsförmåga och är strukturerad, noggrann, prestigelös och lösningsorienterad.
   

  

 Vid urval kommer stor vikt att läggas vid personliga egenskaper.
   

  

 Ovan ställda kvalifikationer ska på begäran kunna verifieras genom intyg, referenser samt arbets- eller urvalstester.
   

  

**Vårt erbjudande**
 Vi erbjuder ett viktigt och stimulerande arbete där du dagligen bidrar till Sveriges säkerhet. Vi erbjuder också mycket goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling. Hos oss finns det friskvårdsmöjligheter som inkluderar träning tre timmar i veckan på arbetstid samt möjlighet att ha balans mellan fritid och arbete.
   

  

*För att myndighetens uppdrag ska vara framgångsrikt förutsätts att alla medarbetare uppträder enligt den värdegrund som finns. Försvarsmaktens värdegrund slår vakt om alla människors lika värde, rättvisa och jämlikhet och främjar demokrati och mänskliga rättigheter (läs mer på www.forsvarsmakten.se).*
**Övrigt**
 Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning som inleds med provanställning om sex månader.
   

  

 Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse.
   

  

 Arbetsort: Stockholm.
   

  

**För upplysningar om befattningen eller rekryteringsprocessen kontakta:**
 hkv-rekrytering-must@mil.se, vänligen skriv ”Kryptolog” i ämnesraden.
   

  

**Fackliga företrädare**
 Fackliga representanter nås via hkv-rekrytering-must@mil.se.
   

  

*Varmt välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-10-07, vi tillämpar löpande urval så inkom gärna med din ansökan så snart som möjligt. I ditt CV och personliga brev vill vi att du beskriver på vilket sätt du uppfyller våra efterfrågade krav och meriter. Du ansöker via* 
*jobb.forsvarsmakten.se.*
 ,
 **Ansökningar till denna befattning kommer endast tas emot via Försvarsmaktens webbplats.** 
 -------------------------------------------------------- Militära underrättelse- och säkerhetstjänsten (Must) är en del av Försvarsmaktens högkvarter i Stockholm. Vi ger regeringen och Försvarsmakten kvalificerade beslutsunderlag om omvärldsutvecklingen och hot mot Sveriges och Försvarsmaktens säkerhet. Vår vision är ”Ett säkrare Sverige i en osäker värld”. title: Systemarkitekt
description:
*Vill du påverka och göra skillnad på riktigt? Här bidrar du till att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen. Det du gör spelar roll* 
*.*
 Din roll
   

  

 Vill du designa ryggraden i Sveriges luftbevakning och stridledning?
   

  

 Sveriges säkerhet vilar på system som fungerar när det gäller som mest. Vi söker nu dig som vill ta rollen som systemarkitekt hos oss. Här får du tekniskt ansvar för några av landets mest kritiska system inom flygstridsledning där du inte bara implementerar lösningar – du definierar hur de ska se ut.
   

  

 I rollen agerar du teknisk ledare. Du ser till helheten och även detaljerna. Ditt uppdrag är att skapa den tekniska lösningen som gör det möjligt för utvecklingsteamen att bygga säkra, effektiva och framtidssäkrade system. Du rör dig obehindrat mellan strategiska diskussioner med kund och djupdykningar i teknisk design tillsammans med ingenjörerna.
   

  

**Detta blir ditt fokus**
* Konceptutveckling: Att transformera visionära behov till konkreta arkitektoniska lösningar.
* Systemintegration: Att säkerställa att integrationen mellan hårdvara och mjukvara är sömlös och robust.
* Tekniskt ledarskap: Att guida teamet genom komplexa designval och säkerställa att vi bygger "rätt sak på rätt sätt".
* Hantering av risker och möjligheter: Att identifiera tekniska risker och möljigheter tidigt i designfasen och skapa strategier för att hantera dem.


 Tjänsten är lokaliserad i Järfälla (flytt till Solna strand är planerad i framtiden), inom avdelning Air C4I, som arbetar med Luftbevaknings- och flygstridsledningssystem. Vi ingår i Business Unit Digital Battlespace Solutions, en del av Saab Surveillance. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta med de mest avancerade teknologierna och vara en del av ett positivt team som i nära kontakt med vår kund verkligen gör skillnad.
   

  

 Din profil
   

  

 Vi söker dig med en gedigen ingenjörsbakgrund och dokumenterad erfarenhet av komplex systemutveckling. Du bör ha en djup förståelse för hur mjukvara och hårdvara interagerar i kritiska miljöer. Erfarenhet av realtidssystem och höga krav på IT- eller funktionell säkerhet är starkt meriterande.
   

  

 Du drivs av komplexitet och har en förmåga att förenkla det svåra. Du är en kommunikatör som kan sälja in en teknisk lösning till kund lika väl som du kan diskutera API-design med en utvecklare.
   

  

 Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.
   

  

 Vad du blir en del av
   

  

 Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.
   

  

 Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med uppdrag att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidrar till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 26,100 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.
   

  

 Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
**Assignment: Senior Backend Engineer**

**About the assignment**  

We are seeking a senior Backend Engineer to work on large-scale distributed platforms for our client, a company operating technology platforms at significant scale. You will design, develop and maintain highly available, performance-critical Java services where security, scalability, reliability and high engineering standards are essential. You will take responsibility across the full software lifecycle, from architecture and implementation through to deployment and production operations.

**Responsibilities**  

You will build fault-tolerant systems focused on performance, reliability and observability, while investigating and resolving complex production issues related to latency, concurrency, scalability and system behaviour under load. The role also includes technical design reviews, architectural decision-making, and collaboration with architects, platform teams, security engineers and product stakeholders. You will help advance engineering practices around automation, automated testing and continuous delivery.


The role suits someone who enjoys complex technical problem-solving, collaborating across engineering disciplines, and taking ownership of systems operating at very large scale.

**Required qualifications**

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills
* Strong practical experience developing RESTful APIs and event-driven architectures
* Expert-level command of Java, including memory management and garbage collection, JVM internals, performance optimisation, asynchronous and reactive programming models, and concurrency/multithreading
* Experience working with customer-facing systems where security, uptime and performance are business-critical
* Strong experience with automated testing, deployment automation and CI/CD pipelines
* Deep understanding of distributed systems, including scalability patterns, partition tolerance, failure recovery, service resiliency, and the trade-offs between availability and consistency
* At least 5 years of experience building and operating production-grade backend systems
* Experience with storage and caching technologies used at high scale, such as Memcached, Cassandra, Redis or comparable distributed data platforms

**Nice to have**

* Experience with machine learning infrastructure or large-scale data platforms
* Experience with cryptography, certificate management, PKI or security-focused systems
* Experience with Java frameworks for asynchronous networking
* Experience with Kubernetes and containerised infrastructure
* Experience with tools such as Maven, Docker, Spinnaker, GitHub or equivalent alternatives

**Scope and location**  

The assignment involves working on large-scale, production-grade backend systems within a global engineering organization. Further details on scope, location/remote arrangements and start date will be shared separately upon interest.

title: Sales Support Engineer
description:

At Cytiva, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

The Sales Support Engineer works closely with the global commercial organization and subject matter experts to analyze technical feasibility in complex deals with the objective of developing the commercial solution and issuing a quote package responding to the customer needs.

* Provide technical and product expertise of Bioprocess hardware and automation solutions during pre-sales and quotation phase
* Receive, analyze, and prioritize quote requests to ensure appropriate, timely quote responses which satisfy customer expectations and meet user requirement specifications (URS)
* Interpret customer specifications, drawings, and process application, and document any deviation from the URS
* Interface with sales, design teams, project management and other key personnel to gather quotation information and evaluate technical feasibility for customization and/or solution
* Work tightly with the project office and design organization to ensure smooth handover to project, design, and manufacturing for awarded customer orders
* Maintenance of your own quote portfolio and adherence to commercial, quality, and regulatory processes and systems. Fulfil compliance according to International Trade Control.

* Demonstrated ability to understand and present complex material in a comprehensible way
* Excellent communicator, communicating professionally with both internal and external stakeholders

* Experience from large Biopharma projects, working at an engineering company or as a customer in commercial manufacturing

* Familiarity with GMP and other relevant standards issued by FDA, ISO, etc.


Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

title: Model-Based Development- Matlab/ Simulink
description:
### **Do you use mathematics as a way to understand reality?**

### **Do you believe that a good solution starts with understanding the problem?**


We are engineers who like to go deep. People who see mathematics as a tool for understanding reality, programming as a way to test ideas, and physics as something that needs to make sense together with the model.


If you enjoy working at the intersection of mathematics, physics, and programming, we would like to get in touch with you!

**We are looking for someone who:**

* Enjoys moving between mathematics, physics, and code
* Wants to understand the connections between models, algorithms, and physical systems
* Enjoys solving difficult problems and understanding why a solution works
* Is curious about new methods, technologies, and tools
* Enjoys working with knowledgeable colleagues who like to test new ideas
* Likes both sharing knowledge and learning from others

 **Which skills do you need to join the team?**  

We are looking for a skilled and motivated System & Software Engineer to join our team. This is a mid- to senior-level role. We are looking for a hybrid profile who can work in the intersection between system, function and implementation.


The work spans several levels:

* **System level** – system design, architecture, requirements decomposition
* **Functional level** – development and validation of functions
* **Technical / software level** – implementation and integration  

  

**Qualifications**
* Experience working as a Systems Engineer, Software Engineer, or in a similar hybrid role
* Strong knowledge of MATLAB/Simulink and model-based development
* Experience with embedded software development
* Experience with requirements engineering

**Desirable Skills**

* Strong experience in requirements management, as the project requires people who understand the full development chain
* Understanding of PLC programming

**What will you work on?**


You will work on technical problems where mathematics, programming, and physics meet. This could involve modelling, simulation, control systems, optimisation and code generation.


In some projects, you may work all the way from understanding and formulating the problem, through mathematical modelling and algorithm development, to implementation and validation. In others, you may go deeper into a specific part of the chain.


We work both on our own in-house projects and on technical challenges together with our customers. As a consultant, you may work closely with customers in areas such as automotive, civil engineering, defence, and medtech. In our in-house projects, you get the opportunity to develop and explore solutions to technical problems together with colleagues who are genuinely interested in the same things.

**What is it like to work at Combine?**


Here, you will work alongside engineers within mathematics, physics, control engineering, programming, AI, and systems development. We work both at customer sites and on our own in-house projects, giving you the opportunity to move between different technical environments and problems.


We like difficult technical problems, deep discussions, and testing whether our ideas actually hold up. We learn from each other, challenge each other's assumptions, and are happy to nerd out until we truly understand the problem.

**Your cover letter matters to us**


We don't want a list of standard qualities such as being driven, social, or solution-oriented.


Instead, tell us:

* What do you find genuinely technically interesting?
* What types of problems do you find particularly stimulating to solve?
* How do you approach a problem you don't know how to solve at first?
* How do you keep up with new methods and technologies?


We would rather read a personal letter that shows us how you think than a perfectly polished one.

**Does this sound like you?**


Do you enjoy understanding **how** things work, rather than simply making them work?


Then we would like to hear from you. We are looking forward to your application!

title: Engineer in Interaction Design with Game Engine knowledge
description:
Autoliv is the worldwide leader in automotive safety systems. We develop, manufacture and market protective solutions such as airbags, seatbelts, and steering wheels for all major automotive manufacturers worldwide, along with advanced safety solutions for new mobility. To strengthen our capabilities within airbag development, we are looking for a Simulation Engineer with Game Engine Expertise to join our team in Vårgårda.
  
About the Role
  
As a Simulation Engineer, you will be part of our airbag folding team, applying knowledge from the gaming industry, in particular physics solvers, to enhance airbag folding technology within Autoliv. The role also supports projects related to data science and advanced simulation.
  
The work includes developing folding technology that mimics physical folding machines (a digital twin) and reducing the time required to simulate the folding of an airbag. You will collaborate primarily with colleagues in Sweden, India and Germany, and contribute to Swedish government-funded projects.
  
Responsibilities

title: Electronics System Engineer
description:
**Challenge the Impossible**

**About Beyond Gravity**


Beyond Gravity, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, is the first space company to combine a startup mindset, agility, speed and innovation with decades of experience and proven quality. Approximately 1800 employees at 12 locations in six countries (Switzerland, Sweden, Austria, USA, Finland and Portugal) develop and manufacture products for satellites and launch vehicles with the goal of advancing humankind and enabling the exploration of the world and beyond. Beyond Gravity is the preferred supplier of structures for all types of launch vehicles and a leading provider of selected satellite products and constellation solutions in the New Space sector. In 2024, the company generated a revenue of around CHF 359 million. More information at: www.beyondgravity.com

  

**Your crew**

  

  

Join a highly collaborative, cross-functional team at the heart of Beyond Gravity’s Electronics business. Working closely with Engineering, Product Management, Programs, Production and other functions, you will contribute to the development of satellite onboard systems, platform and payload products as well as ground electronics products.


As an Electronics System Engineer, you will work at system and architectural level, providing system engineering expertise for electronics hardware systems, embedded processing systems and platform and payload solutions across development projects and series production programs in the satellite electronic solutions domain.


This is a role with significant development potential. You will have the opportunity to take increasing ownership, broaden your technical expertise and grow towards more advanced system engineering responsibilities over time.

  

**Your mission**

  

  

The Electronics System Engineer is responsible for:


* Take ownership of your scope and bring assigned tasks to completion, involving more senior colleagues when needed.
* Develop and maintain satellite onboard systems, platform and payload products as well as ground electronics products at system and architectural level.
* Analyse and understand internal and external customer requirements and translate them into system-level requirements and technical solutions.
* Break down system requirements into subsystem and module requirements and establish corresponding design requirements.
* Develop technical concepts and system designs appropriate to customer and project needs, considering cost, time, quality, performance and technical feasibility.
* Perform and/or assess system-level analyses, including performance, radiation, structural, EMC, reliability, FDIR and HW/FPGA/SW interaction analyses.
* Coordinate development activities with other teams and disciplines to ensure complete and intended implementation of the system.
* Plan and execute your own activities, monitor progress against schedule and budget, and raise awareness of risks and blocking points.
* Support bidding and proposal activities through technical descriptions, concept work, cost and schedule estimates and risk and opportunity assessments.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of products, technologies, processes and ways of working, challenging established solutions where appropriate.
* Interact with customers, suppliers and external stakeholders within your area of responsibility and provide technical know-how to support successful project execution.
* Maintain and develop system-level documentation and ensure compliance with established development processes and standards.
  

Most important outputs:


* Robust and efficient system solutions that meet customer and project requirements.
* Successful delivery of system engineering activities within agreed scope, quality, schedule and budget.
* Continuous development of products, technologies and engineering methods.
  

**Your story**

  

  

We are looking for a technically curious and solution-oriented System Engineer with a strong interest in satellite electronics and system engineering. You take ownership of your work, are comfortable working independently and enjoy finding solutions to complex technical challenges.


You have a collaborative mindset and enjoy working across disciplines, with the ability to communicate clearly with colleagues, customers and external partners. You are motivated by continuous learning and want to develop your expertise and responsibility over time.


This role is a great opportunity for someone with strong potential to grow towards more advanced system engineering responsibilities and, in time, a Senior System Engineer role.

  

Must-haves:


* M.Sc. in Electrical, Software or Aerospace Engineering, or corresponding experience.
* Experience or good knowledge in system engineering, electronics or embedded systems, preferably within the space industry.
* Understanding of requirements engineering, functional decomposition and system design.
* Ability to perform or assess system-level analyses and understand HW/FPGA/SW interactions.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership and deliver within agreed scope, schedule and budget.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills.
* Structured and solution-oriented approach to technical challenges and risk.
* Fluent English, written and spoken.
  

Nice to have’s:


* Experience with satellite onboard systems, platform and payload products or ground electronics.
* Knowledge of FPGA, hardware, RF, signal processing or embedded systems.
* Experience with tools such as MATLAB, DOORS, PSA, FMECA, DOSRAD or Reliability.
* Knowledge of ECSS, agile methods or model-based systems engineering.
* Experience with technical coordination, customer interaction or proposal work.
* Knowledge of product roadmaps and current technology trends.
  

**Why Beyond Gravity**

  

* To work in a growing high technology company with career opportunities within the site or internationally.
* You will be a part of an engaged team with the ambition to innovate space!
* We offer a hybrid work situation, high flexibility and autonomy, and a great team to develop and have fun with!
  

**Are you ready for lift-off?**

Our core values - Passionate, Together, and Curious - transform challenges into opportunities. Embark on a journey to transcend the ordinary with us. We‘re actively reviewing candidates and will promptly select the ideal fit for our team.

title: Doctoral student in Computer Science with focus on AI engineering
description:
Lund University was founded in 1666 and is repeatedly ranked among the world’s top universities. The University has around 46 000 students and 8 500 staff based in Lund, Helsingborg and Malmö. We are united in our efforts to understand, explain and improve our world and the human condition.

**Description of the workplace**
--------------------------------


The doctoral student will be employed at the Department of Computer Science, where research on engineering of large-scale software-intensive systems is conducted in the Software Engineering unit. The unit is a world leader on empirical software engineering. In addition to conventional software, the scope includes engineering of AI enabled systems (primarily ML and LLM), and thus MLOps (Machine Learning Operations), datacentric AI, and legal and ethical aspects of AI.


The empirical research catalyzes industry-academia collaboration and cross-disciplinary initiatives, in which the doctoral student may conduct their studies. Particularly, this position is funded within the ELLIIT strategic research area (Excellence Center at Linköping – Lund in Information Technology) where a twin doctoral student will address the same topic from a business perspective. The student will also be affiliated with the NextG2Com industrial competence center, in the research theme on Integrated Data Engineering and Machine Learning.


More about ELLIIT and the project


More about NextG2Com

**Being a doctoral student**
----------------------------


As a doctoral student, you are both admitted as a student and employed at Lund University.


As a doctoral student, you will be trained in a scientific approach. In short, you will be trained to think critically and analytically, to solve problems independently using the right methods, and to develop an awareness of research ethics. In addition, you will have the opportunity to work on projects, to develop your leadership and pedagogical skills. Throughout your studies, you will be guided by supervisors. Doctoral studies end with a thesis and a doctoral degree.


More about being a doctoral student at LTH on lth.se.

**Subject and project description**
-----------------------------------


The study subject is computer science with a focus on AI engineering, i.e. engineering of systems containing AI-based features (LLM or ML). Application domains range from agentic software engineering to industrial control systems. Specifically, it addresses the issue of using general vs. specialized models (e.g. per task, company, country or domain). From a technical perspective, there are a multitude of factors to trade across the range of generalization–specialization, including model performance, energy consumption, training data supply, and integrity of data. The project aims to address AI engineering in business-to-business (B2B) contexts in various industry domains, as well as open source AI models. We perform empirical studies of industry practice for in-depth problem understanding. The project aims to design solutions for technical specialization and ecosystem governance. In particular, trade-offs between model size, data needs, computing costs, privacy and secrecy will be addressed.

**Work duties**
---------------


You will primarily devote yourself to your doctoral programme, which includes participation in research projects as well as third cycle courses, seminars and conferences. Since the project is conducted in the context of the ELLIIT and NextG2Com initiatives, you will interact with corresponding academic and industrial partners.


The work duties include:

* Research within the project topic
* Collaboration with partners in ELLIIT and NextG2Com
* Participation in international research conferences
* Taking third cycle courses
* Participation in teaching and other departmental work (however, a maximum of 20% of working hours).

**Qualifications**
------------------


To be eligible for admission and employment as a doctoral student, you must fulfil the requirements below.

### **Admission requirements**


A person meets the general admission requirements for third-cycle courses and study programmes if the applicant:

* has been awarded a second-cycle qualification, or
* has satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second cycle, or
* has acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad.


A person meets the specific admission requirements for third cycle studies in Computer Science if the applicant has:

* at least 60 credits from M.Sc. level courses that are relevant for this topic, or
* an MSc in Engineering in Computer Science and Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information and Communication Technology, Engineering Physics or Engineering Mathematics.

### **Additional requirements**


In order to complete the doctoral programme in question, the following are also required:

* very good knowledge of English, spoken and written
* good knowledge about software and AI engineering theory and practice
* good knowledge about machine learning
* ability to collaborate with industry partners
* good written and oral communication skills
* good ability to cooperate
* good ability to work independently and to formulate and tackle research problems.

### **Other qualifications (advantages)**


For the doctoral programme in question, the following are considered as other qualifications:

* relevant industrial experience
* working experience as a software engineer
* contributions to open source software, data commons and open source AI models
* knowledge about qualitative research methods
* knowledge about design science research methods

**We offer**
------------


Lund University is a public authority which means that employees get particular benefits, generous annual leave and an advantageous occupational pension scheme.


More about working at Lund University on lu.se.

**About the employment**
------------------------


The employment is a fixed-term employment at full time, starting as soon as possible, however no later than 2026-12-15. Third cycle studies at LTH consist of full-time studies for 4 years. In the case of teaching and other departmental duties, the employment is extended accordingly. Doctoral studentships are regulated in the Higher Education Ordinance (1993:100), chapter 5, 1-7 §§.


More about terms of employment for doctoral students on Lund University’s Staffpages.

**How to apply**
----------------


Applications shall be written in English and include:

* CV and a personally written cover letter stating the reasons why you are interested in the doctoral programme/employment and in what way the research project corresponds to your interests and educational background.
* Copies of issued study certificates and/or awarded degree certificates. These must confirm that you meet the general and specific admission requirements for the doctoral programme and show that you have the subject knowledge required for the doctoral programme project.
* Other documents you wish to be considered (grade transcripts, contact information for your references, letters of recommendation, etc.)


We welcome your application.


LTH is Lund University’s Faculty of Engineering. At LTH we educate people, build knowledge for the future and work hard for the development of society. We create space for brilliant research and inspire creative advancements in technology, architecture and design. We have nearly 12,000 students. Every year, our researchers – many of whom work in world-leading profile areas – publish around 100 theses and 2 000 scientific findings. In addition, a number of research results and degree projects are transformed into innovations. Together we explore and create – to benefit the world.


We kindly decline all sales and marketing contacts.

title: Master thesis Physical AI Cloud-Controlled Robots
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
 Are you ready to work on a multidisciplinary project on the intersection of artificial intelligence, communication, control, and computation for cloud-controlled robots within a leading industrial research group? This master’s thesis opportunity is offered by the Cyber-Physical Systems research area at Ericsson Research, in the Decision & Control team. The project tackles key challenges in building scalable solutions for offloading data from multi-sensor robots and control the robot over the network with particular focus on the advanced methods from artificial intelligence, communication, control, and computation domains for robotic applications. The project will start in early 2027 and will last for six months. This is an applied research opportunity at the intersection of devices, cloud/edge computing, and networks where you can demonstrate your ideas, energy, and skills to shape future connected devices and machines.
   

  

**What will you do:**
* Research and develop methods on top of the advanced 5G/6G features for robotic systems.
* Develop models and algorithms for real-time data streaming, managing, decision-making, and optimization in multi-sensor robotic systems.
* Integrate perception, planning, and control modules with mobile networks and edge/cloud compute resources.
* Design and run experiments and performance evaluations on cloud-controlled robots in mobile network environments within Kista Innovation Networks to assess advanced 5G/6G features.
* Compare your solution against existing approaches to evaluate effectiveness and trade-offs.


**The skills you bring:**
* MSc studies in either of Computer Science, Mechatronic, Robotics, Telecommunications, Control engineering or a related field.
* Experience with robot autonomy stack (ROS 2, control, perception, SLAM, planning, etc.).
* Hands-on experience with robotic systems, sensors (camera, LiDAR, etc.) or similar.
* Knowledge and practical experience with ML/AI methods and their application in robotics.
* Programming skills in Python and/or C++.
* Ability to formulate research problems and solve them independently as well as collaboratively.
* Analytical skills, quick learning ability, and the willingness to share knowledge with others.
* Excellent written and spoken English and good presentation skills.


**About Ericsson Research:**
 Ericsson Research is the central research organization within Ericsson, comprising over 700 researchers across eight countries. Our mission is to provide system concepts, technologies, and intellectual property that secure Ericsson’s long-term success and competitiveness. World-class innovation is achieved through collaboration within Ericsson and with external partners, customers, universities, and research institutes.
   

  

 We look forward to your application and the opportunity to work together on this exciting master’s thesis project.
